  weather_condition varchar [note: 'Observed weather condition at the time of planting. Supports agronomic analysis of planting conditions versus stand establishment outcomes and crop insurance documentation.   application_end_time timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the crop protection application operation was completed. Combined with application_start_time to calculate total application duration and equipment utilization for OEE reporting.']
  application_method varchar [note: 'The physical method used to apply the crop protection product to the field or crop. Determines equipment calibration requirements, drift risk assessment, and label compliance. Sourced from Trimble Ag VRA prescription or Climate FieldView spraying records.']
  application_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The quantity of crop protection product applied per unit area (e.g., oz/acre, L/ha, kg/ha) as prescribed on the EPA label. Must not exceed label maximum rate. Used for MRL compliance calculation and VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription validation.']
  application_rate_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the application rate field, specifying the quantity and area basis (e.g., oz/acre, L/ha). Required for MRL compliance calculations and cross-regional reporting. Must align with the EPA-registered label unit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oz/acre|fl_oz/acre|lb/acre|kg/ha|L/ha|mL/ha|pt/acre|qt/acre — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  application_start_time timestamp [note: 'Precise timestamp when the crop protection application operation commenced. Used for REI (Restricted Entry Interval) calculation, operator exposure tracking, and OSHA compliance. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center or Trimble Ag telematics.']
  application_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle workflow status of the crop protection application event. Drives PHI compliance checks, agronomist sign-off workflows, and FSMA audit readiness. \'pending_review\' indicates awaiting agronomist approval.']
  application_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the crop protection product by its mode of action or target pest category. Drives IPM program reporting, EPA pesticide use reporting, and GLOBALG.A.P. pesticide audit trail categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: herbicide|fungicide|insecticide|nematicide|rodenticide|plant_growth_regulator|bactericide|acaricide|molluscicide — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this crop protection event record was first captured in the system of record. Supports audit trail requirements under FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., and EPA pesticide recordkeeping regulations.']
  earliest_harvest_date date [note: 'Calculated earliest date on which the treated crop may be harvested in compliance with the PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval). Computed as application_date + phi_days_required. Enforced in harvest scheduling to prevent MRL violations and FSMA non-compliance.']
  epa_registration_number varchar [note: 'EPA registration number of the pesticide product applied, as printed on the product label. Mandatory for FIFRA compliance recordkeeping. Format: registrant-product[-state suffix]. Must match the EPA-registered label used at time of application.']
  event_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this crop protection application event, formatted as CPE-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in audit trails, GLOBALG.A.P. pesticide records, EPA recordkeeping submissions, and FSMA traceability documentation.']
  gps_coverage_polygon varchar [note: 'Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the GPS-tracked coverage polygon for this application event, as recorded by John Deere Operations Center or Trimble RTK positioning. Enables GIS-based spatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS for drift buffer compliance and field coverage verification.']
  ipm_justified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this crop protection application was justified by an IPM (Integrated Pest Management) scouting threshold or economic injury level assessment, rather than a calendar-based schedule. True = IPM threshold-triggered; False = preventive/calendar application. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. IPM program compliance.']
  phi_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Compliance determination for the PHI requirement relative to the planned harvest date. \'compliant\' = harvest date is after earliest_harvest_date; \'non_compliant\' = harvest scheduled before PHI expiry; \'pending\' = harvest date not yet confirmed; \'waived\' = regulatory exemption applied.']
  phi_days_required varchar [note: 'Number of days that must elapse between the last application of this crop protection product and the earliest permissible harvest date, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Core compliance field for FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., and MRL verification.']
  rei_clearance_datetime timestamp [note: 'Calculated datetime after which workers may safely re-enter the treated field, computed as application_start_time + rei_hours_required. Posted at field entry points per EPA Worker Protection Standard. Critical for OSHA and EPA WPS compliance.']
  rei_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Compliance determination for the REI requirement. \'compliant\' = no worker re-entry before rei_clearance_datetime; \'non_compliant\' = documented early re-entry violation; \'pending\' = REI period still active; \'waived\' = PPE exception per label.']
  rei_hours_required decimal(5,1) [note: 'Number of hours that workers must stay out of the treated field following application, as specified on the EPA-registered label under the Worker Protection Standard (WPS). Decimal to support half-hour increments (e.g., 4.0, 12.0, 24.0, 48.0 hours).']
  relative_humidity_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Relative humidity percentage at the time of application. Low humidity increases evaporation and drift risk for certain pesticide formulations. Required for label compliance documentation and GLOBALG.A.P. application condition records.']
  target_pest varchar [note: 'The specific pest, weed, disease, or pathogen that the crop protection application was intended to control, as identified through IPM scouting. Examples: Fusarium head blight, corn rootworm, Palmer amaranth. Supports IPM program efficacy tracking and GLOBALG.A.P. CB 7.2 pest monitoring records.']
  temperature_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of application. High temperatures can increase volatilization and drift risk. Some EPA labels restrict application above threshold temperatures. Sourced from field weather station or Climate FieldView weather data.']
  total_area_treated_ha decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total field area covered by this crop protection application event, measured in hectares. Derived from GPS-tracked equipment coverage via John Deere Operations Center or Trimble RTK positioning. Used for total product quantity reconciliation and EPA pesticide use reporting.']
  total_product_used decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total quantity of crop protection product consumed in this application event (application_rate × total_area_treated). Expressed in the same unit as application_rate_unit. Used for inventory depletion in SAP S/4HANA MM and EPA pesticide use reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this crop protection event record. Required for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and regulatory audit trail completeness.']
  water_volume_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Volume of water carrier used per acre in the spray mixture (gallons/acre or L/ha). Critical for spray efficacy, equipment calibration validation, and label compliance. Sourced from sprayer controller data in John Deere Operations Center or Trimble Ag.']
  wind_direction varchar [note: 'Compass direction of wind at time of application (8-point compass rose). Used for pesticide drift risk assessment, buffer zone compliance, and neighbor notification requirements under EPA label conditions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  wind_speed_mph decimal(5,2) [note: 'Measured wind speed in miles per hour at the time of application. EPA label restrictions typically prohibit application above 10-15 mph to prevent pesticide drift. Sourced from on-field weather station or John Deere Operations Center weather integration.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of a pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, or insecticide application event, capturing application date, agrochemical product reference (EPA registration number, active ingredient), application rate, target pest or disease, application method, equipment used, operator certification number, weather conditions at application, and GPS-tracked coverage area. Includes PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance tracking: PHI days required, calculated earliest harvest date, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) hours required, field re-entry clearance date, compliance status, and responsible agronomist sign-off. Supports IPM program execution, FSMA compliance, EPA pesticide recordkeeping, MRL verification, and GLOBALG.A.P. pesticide audit trails.'
}

  irrigation_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the variable rate application (VRA) prescription or irrigation schedule from Trimble Ag Software or Climate FieldView that directed this irrigation event. Enables planned vs. actual analysis.']
  irrigation_zone_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.irrigation_zone. Water right compliance reporting requires tracking volume applied per zone against pe']

  vra_prescription_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to crop.vra_prescription. Business justification: irrigation_event has no FK to vra_prescription, yet VRA prescriptions can govern variable-rate irrigation applications (input_type on vra_prescription covers irrigation). Adding vra_prescription_id to']
  work_order_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the SAP S/4HANA work order or field operation task that authorized and scheduled this irrigation event.']

  et_trigger_value_inches decimal(8,4) [note: 'Evapotranspiration (ET) deficit value in inches that triggered this irrigation event, as calculated from weather station data or crop model. Core metric for ET-driven irrigation scheduling and water use efficiency reporting.']

  irrigation_method varchar [note: 'Type of irrigation delivery system used for this event.   is_scheduled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this irrigation event was executed as part of a pre-planned schedule (True) or was an unplanned/emergency application (False). Used for schedule adherence reporting and agronomic audit trails.']

  pressure_psi decimal(7,2) [note: 'Operating pressure of the irrigation system in pounds per square inch (PSI) during this event. Used for equipment performance monitoring, uniformity assessment, and maintenance scheduling.']
  rainfall_since_last_event_inches decimal(7,3) [note: 'Total precipitation in inches recorded between the previous irrigation event and this one. Used to adjust effective irrigation need, validate ET-based scheduling decisions, and support water use efficiency reporting.']
  soil_moisture_pct_after decimal(5,2) [note: 'Volumetric soil moisture content (%) recorded by IoT sensors following irrigation application. Used to assess irrigation effectiveness, field capacity attainment, and over-irrigation risk.']
  soil_moisture_pct_before decimal(5,2) [note: 'Volumetric soil moisture content (%) recorded by IoT sensors immediately prior to irrigation application. Used to validate ET-based trigger thresholds and assess irrigation necessity per BMP standards.']
  soil_moisture_sensor_depth_cm varchar [note: 'Depth in centimeters at which the soil moisture sensor reading was taken. Required for agronomic interpretation of moisture data and root zone analysis.']
  start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the irrigation application began. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction, used for ET-driven scheduling analysis, water use reporting, and IoT sensor correlation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this irrigation event record. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  volume_applied_acre_inches decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total volume of water applied during this irrigation event, measured in acre-inches. Primary quantitative outcome for water use reporting, ET-based scheduling validation, and BMP compliance under USDA NRCS standards.']
  volume_applied_gallons decimal(14,2) [note: 'Total volume of water applied during this irrigation event, expressed in US gallons. Supports pump station metering reconciliation, water rights reporting, and utility billing where applicable.']
  water_cost_usd decimal(12,4) [note: 'Estimated or actual cost of water applied during this irrigation event in US dollars, based on metered usage rates, well pumping costs, or municipal water tariffs. Supports COGS allocation and OPEX reporting.']

  water_source_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the water source used for this irrigation event. Required for water rights compliance, environmental reporting, and BMP documentation under USDA and EPA frameworks.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of an irrigation application on a field or zone, capturing irrigation date, method (drip, pivot, flood, sprinkler), water volume applied (acre-inches), ET-based trigger value, soil moisture reading at time of application, water source, pump station reference, and duration. Supports ET-driven irrigation scheduling, water use reporting, and BMP compliance. Integrates with IoT soil moisture sensors and John Deere Operations Center.'
}

Scouting observations are spatially recorded at zone level for precision pest management repor']

  vra_prescription_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Variable Rate Application prescription generated as a result of this scouting observation. Links the observation to precision agriculture intervention decisions in Trimble Ag Software.']
  weather_observation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Scouting observations record weather_conditions as denormalized text. Linking to the actual weather observation record supports pest pressure modeling, disease risk correlation (leaf wetness, humidity']

  observation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the scouting observation record, from initial field capture through agronomist review, action assignment, and closure. Drives workflow routing in Trimble Ag Software and SAP S/4HANA PP.']
  observation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the scouting observation was made in the field or when remote sensing imagery was captured. Principal real-world event time used for IPM decision timing and PHI/REI compliance tracking.']
  observer_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field notes recorded by the agronomist or scout during the observation. Captures qualitative context, unusual conditions, or supplementary observations not captured in structured fields. Stored for audit and agronomic review.']
  pest_common_name varchar [note: 'Common name of the pest, disease, or weed species identified during the scouting observation (e.g., \'Corn Rootworm\', \'Soybean Rust\', \'Waterhemp\'). Complements the scientific code for field-user readability.']
  pest_organism_code varchar [note: 'Standardized scientific or EPPO (European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization) code identifying the pest species, disease pathogen, or weed species observed. Null when observation category is not pest, disease, or weed.']
  photo_reference_url varchar [note: 'URL or file path reference to photographic evidence captured during the scouting observation. Photos are stored in the enterprise document management system and linked here for audit trail and agronomist review purposes.']
  pressure_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative rating of pest or disease pressure intensity observed in the field, ranging from none to severe. Used as the primary IPM decision trigger for crop protection event initiation and economic threshold comparison.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to the scouting observation indicating urgency of follow-up action. Critical and high priorities trigger immediate crop protection event creation or VRA prescription review in the FMIS.']
  recommended_action varchar [note: 'Recommended agronomic action based on the scouting observation findings. Drives downstream workflow creation in SAP S/4HANA PP for crop protection events or Trimble Ag Software for VRA prescriptions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: no_action|monitor|apply_crop_protection|adjust_irrigation|apply_fertilizer|vra_prescription|escalate_agronomist — promote to reference product]']
  review_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the scouting observation was reviewed and validated by the responsible agronomist or supervisor. Part of the IPM audit trail required by GLOBALG.A.P. and FSMA compliance frameworks.']
  sample_count varchar [note: 'Number of individual plant samples, transects, or observation points assessed during the scouting event. Provides statistical context for incidence and severity ratings and supports data quality validation.']
  scouted_area_ha decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total area of the field covered by this scouting observation, expressed in hectares. Used to calculate observation density, extrapolate field-wide pest pressure, and determine VRA prescription zone boundaries.']
  sensor_platform varchar [note: 'The sensor or imaging platform used to capture remote sensing data for this observation (e.g., satellite, drone/UAV, manned aerial, ground-based IoT sensor, handheld device). Null for purely in-person observations without sensor data.']
  severity_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative rating of the severity of damage or infection on affected plants, distinct from incidence (which measures spread). Severity measures the degree of impact on individual plants. Used in conjunction with incidence_pct for full IPM assessment.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording when the scouting observation record was most recently modified. Supports data lineage tracking, change detection in the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit compliance.']
  vegetation_health_class varchar [note: 'Classified vegetation health category derived from NDVI or other spectral indices. Used for field-level health mapping, anomaly detection, and seasonal baseline comparison in Climate FieldView and Esri ArcGIS.']
  weed_density_per_sqm decimal(8,2) [note: 'Count of weed plants per square meter observed in the scouted area. Applicable when observation_category is \'weed\'. Used to determine economic threshold for herbicide application and VRA prescription generation.']

  Note: 'Field observation record capturing crop health assessments from both in-person scouting and remote sensing sources. In-person scouting captures: agronomist or scout identity, pest identification and pressure rating, disease incidence and severity, weed species and density, nutrient deficiency symptoms, crop growth stage (BBCH scale code), GPS coordinates, photo references, and recommended action. Remote sensing captures: NDVI values, vegetation health classification, anomaly detection flags, seasonal baseline comparison, sensor platform (satellite, drone, aerial), and imagery date. Includes observation method type, priority classification, and recommended follow-up actions linking to crop protection events or VRA prescriptions. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software crop scouting module, Esri ArcGIS, and Climate FieldView. Drives IPM decision-making, crop protection event triggers, and variable rate intervention decisions.'
}

  approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the agronomist or authorized reviewer formally approved this VRA prescription for field use. Required for GAP compliance documentation and regulatory audit readiness.']
  controller_upload_status varchar [note: 'Status of the VRA prescription file upload to the RTK-enabled equipment controller (e.g., John Deere Operations Center, Trimble display). \'pending\' = awaiting upload; \'uploaded\' = file transferred; \'confirmed\' = controller acknowledged receipt; \'failed\' = upload error requiring retry.']
  controller_upload_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the VRA prescription file was successfully uploaded to the field equipment controller. Used for operational sequencing, equipment readiness verification, and audit trail documentation.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: soil_sampling|yield_history|ndvi_imagery|ec_survey|scouting|multi_source — promote to reference product if additional source types are needed]']
  default_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Baseline or average application rate for the entire field, expressed in the prescription\'s rate_unit. Used as a fallback rate for zones without specific assignments and as a benchmark for VRA cost-benefit analysis.']

  min_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'Lowest prescribed application rate across all management zones in this VRA prescription, expressed in rate_unit. Used for equipment controller calibration, input cost floor estimation, and environmental compliance (MRL, runoff risk).']

  rate_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for all prescribed application rates in this VRA prescription (e.g., lbs/acre for fertilizer, seeds/acre for seed, gal/acre for liquid crop protection).   source_system_reference varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this VRA prescription record in the originating source system (Trimble Ag Software, Climate FieldView, or John Deere Operations Center). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.']
  target_application_end_date date [note: 'Latest date within the agronomically recommended application window for this VRA prescription. Prescriptions applied after this date may be flagged for agronomic review and compliance documentation.']
  target_application_start_date date [note: 'Earliest date within the agronomically recommended application window for this VRA prescription. Used for field scheduling, equipment dispatch planning, and PHI/REI compliance verification.']
  total_field_area_acres decimal(10,2) [note: 'Total area of the field covered by this VRA prescription, measured in acres. Used to calculate total input quantity required, procurement planning, and cost-per-acre analysis.']
  total_input_quantity decimal(12,4) [note: 'Total quantity of the agricultural input required to execute this VRA prescription across all zones, expressed in rate_unit denominator (e.g., total lbs, total gallons). Used for procurement planning, inventory reservation, and input cost estimation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this VRA prescription record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to rates, zone assignments, or application windows after initial creation.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this VRA prescription, incremented each time the prescription is revised and re-approved. Enables version history tracking and ensures equipment operators apply the most current prescription.']
  zone_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct management zones defined within this VRA prescription. Indicates the spatial complexity of the prescription and correlates with the degree of input variability across the field.']

  Note: 'Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription map generated for a specific field and input type (seed, fertilizer, or crop protection), defining spatially variable application rates across field management zones. Captures prescription creation date, agronomist author, input product, rate units, zone map reference, target application window, and upload status to equipment controller (RTK-enabled). Links to source data (soil sampling results, scouting observations, yield history) that informed zone delineation. Post-application, actual vs. prescribed rate variance is reconciled through linked fertilization_event or protection_event records. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView. Enables precision agriculture, input cost optimization, and environmental compliance documentation.'

Adding yield_record_id to loss_event enables direct linkage between documented l']
  adjuster_inspection_date date [note: 'The date on which the licensed crop insurance adjuster conducted the field inspection to assess the loss event. Required for USDA RMA claim documentation and loss adjustment timeline compliance.']
  adjuster_reference_number varchar [note: 'The adjuster\'s internal reference or case number assigned during the field inspection and loss assessment process. Used for cross-referencing adjuster reports with the insurance claim file.']
  affected_area_acres decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total acreage of the field or portion thereof affected by the crop loss event, measured in acres. Used for indemnity calculation and USDA RMA claim documentation. Aligns with FSA CLU (Common Land Unit) acreage records.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visual_inspection|drone_survey|adjuster_inspection|satellite_imagery|yield_monitor|lab_sample — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the crop loss event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage, SOX compliance, and FSMA record-keeping requirements.']
  crop_growth_stage varchar [note: 'The phenological growth stage of the crop at the time of the loss event (e.g., V6, R3 for corn; Feekes 10.5 for wheat). Critical for determining yield impact severity and insurance coverage applicability under MPCI policy.']

  total_field_acres decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total insured acreage of the field at the time of the loss event. Used to calculate the percentage of field affected and to validate affected_area_acres against the insured unit.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when the crop loss event record was last modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and change management for insurance claim documentation.']
  yield_loss_bu_acre decimal(10,4) [note: 'Estimated yield loss expressed in bushels per acre (BU/acre) resulting from the crop loss event. Primary quantitative metric for MPCI indemnity calculation and agronomic impact assessment. Aligns with YPM reporting standards.']

  Note: 'Record of a crop loss or damage event affecting a field or portion thereof, capturing loss date, cause (hail, drought, flood, frost, pest, disease, wind), estimated yield impact (BU/acre or % loss), affected acreage, loss assessment method (visual, drone survey, adjuster inspection), adjuster reference, crop insurance claim number, policy reference, and final indemnity determination. Table crop.grain_delivery {
  grain_delivery_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the grain_delivery association']
  delivery_location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this grain delivery to the authorized customer receiving location where the grain was delivered.']
  yield_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking this grain delivery to the specific harvest yield record from which the delivered grain originated.']
  allocated_quantity_mt decimal [note: 'Quantity of grain from this yield record allocated and delivered to this specific delivery location, expressed in metric tons. Belongs to the delivery relationship — the same yield record may have different quantities allocated to different locations.']
  cool_origin_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance has been verified for this specific grain delivery. Required for food manufacturing and retail customers under USDA COOL regulations. Belongs to the delivery event as it is verified per shipment, not per yield record or per location.']
  delivery_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the grain was physically delivered to and received at the delivery location. Belongs to the delivery event, not to the yield record (harvest date) or the delivery location (static master).']
  load_ticket_number varchar [note: 'Bill of Lading or scale ticket reference number issued at the time of this specific delivery. Uniquely identifies the physical load movement from the farm/storage to the receiving location. Belongs to the delivery event.']
  moisture_at_delivery decimal [note: 'Grain moisture content percentage as measured by the receiving location at the time of delivery. Used for moisture dockage calculations and settlement. Distinct from moisture_pct_at_harvest on the yield_record, which is measured at the field.']
  quality_grade_at_delivery varchar [note: 'Official grain quality grade assigned by the receiving elevator or inspection point at the time of delivery. May differ from the quality grade recorded at harvest on the yield_record due to storage, blending, or re-grading. Belongs to the delivery relationship.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Grain Delivery event between a yield_record and a delivery_location. It captures the operational record of a specific quantity of harvested grain being allocated and physically delivered from a harvest operation to an authorized customer receiving location. Each record links one yield_record to one delivery_location and carries delivery-specific attributes — quantity, date, load ticket, quality grade at delivery, moisture at delivery, and COOL compliance — that exist only in the context of this specific delivery transaction and cannot reside on either the yield record or the delivery location alone.. Existence Justification: In grain merchandising operations, a single harvest load (yield_record) is routinely split across multiple delivery destinations — a grain elevator, an export terminal, and a food plant dock may all receive portions of the same harvest. Conversely, a customer delivery location receives commodity from many yield records across multiple fields, operators, and seasons. The business actively manages these allocations as \'grain deliveries\' or \'load allocations\', tracking quantity delivered, moisture at delivery, quality grade, load ticket number, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) verification — data that belongs to neither the yield record nor the delivery location alone.'
}

Table crop.prescription_zone_rate {
  prescription_zone_rate_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the prescription_zone_rate association']
  input_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the agricultural input product whose application rate is specified for this zone']
  vra_prescription_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the VRA prescription that contains this zone-level input rate specification']
  application_method varchar [note: 'The specific application method for this input product in this zone within the prescription (e.g., broadcast, banded, foliar). May differ per input within a multi-input prescription.']
  prescribed_rate decimal [note: 'The specific application rate prescribed for this input product in this management zone. Varies by zone and input combination; cannot reside on vra_prescription (varies per input) or input_product (varies per prescription and zone).']
  rate_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the prescribed_rate in this zone-input combination (e.g., lbs/ac, oz/ac, gal/ac). May differ across input products within the same prescription.']
  zone_area_acres decimal [note: 'The area in acres of the management zone covered by this input-prescription combination. Used to calculate total input quantity required for this zone and for cost/compliance reporting.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the zone-level input rate specification between a vra_prescription and an input_product. It captures the operational precision agriculture record that defines exactly how much of a specific input product is prescribed for a specific management zone within a VRA prescription. Each record links one vra_prescription to one input_product for one management zone, carrying the prescribed rate, area, and application method that exist only in the context of this zone-input-prescription combination. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView prescription workflows.. Existence Justification: A VRA prescription is specifically designed to apply multiple input products (e.g., N, P, K fertilizers simultaneously) at spatially variable rates across management zones, and each input product appears in many prescriptions across fields, seasons, and farms. The business actively manages this relationship as a \'prescription line item\' or \'zone-rate specification\' — a recognized operational concept in precision agriculture that carries zone-specific rate, area, and method data. This is not an analytical correlation; agronomists and equipment controllers actively create, update, and execute these zone-rate records as part of the VRA workflow.'
}

Table crop.crop {
  crop_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for crop']
  parent_crop_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on crop (parent_crop_id)']
  average_yield decimal(10,2) [note: 'Historical average yield for this crop expressed in the yield_unit, used for crop planning and forecasting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this crop master record was first created in the system.']
  crop_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the crop type based on agricultural use and market segment.']
  crop_code varchar [note: 'Standardized alphanumeric code used for crop identification in Farm Management Information Systems (FMIS) and regulatory reporting. Externally-known unique identifier.']
  crop_name varchar [note: 'Common name of the crop (e.g., Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, Cotton). Human-readable identifier used across all agronomic systems.']
  crop_type varchar [note: 'Classification based on the crop\'s lifecycle duration: annual (single season), perennial (multi-year), or biennial (two-year cycle).']
  disease_susceptibility varchar [note: 'General susceptibility of the crop to disease infections, used in IPM-based disease management strategies.']
  drought_tolerance varchar [note: 'Crop\'s ability to withstand water stress and drought conditions, critical for irrigation planning.']
  frost_tolerance varchar [note: 'Crop\'s ability to withstand frost conditions during growing season.']
  gmo_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether genetically modified varieties of this crop are available and approved for cultivation.']
  growing_season varchar [note: 'Primary season during which the crop is typically cultivated, used for crop planning and rotation scheduling.']
  harvest_method varchar [note: 'Primary method used for harvesting the crop: manual labor, mechanical equipment, or combination.']
  market_price_per_unit decimal(12,2) [note: 'Current market price per yield unit (e.g., price per bushel, price per kilogram), used for revenue forecasting and crop selection decisions.']
  maturity_days_max varchar [note: 'Maximum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for late-maturing varieties of this crop.']
  maturity_days_min varchar [note: 'Minimum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for early-maturing varieties of this crop.']
  ndvi_threshold_healthy decimal(4,3) [note: 'Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) threshold value indicating healthy crop vigor, used for remote sensing and field health monitoring.']
  nitrogen_requirement_kg_per_hectare decimal(8,2) [note: 'Recommended nitrogen fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield, used in Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescriptions.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional agronomic notes, special cultivation requirements, or regional considerations for this crop.']
  organic_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this crop can be grown under organic certification standards.']
  pest_susceptibility varchar [note: 'General susceptibility of the crop to pest infestations, used in Integrated Pest Management (IPM) planning.']
  phi_days varchar [note: 'Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) - minimum number of days required between last pesticide application and harvest to ensure compliance with food safety regulations.']
  phosphorus_requirement_kg_per_hectare decimal(8,2) [note: 'Recommended phosphorus fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.']
  planting_depth_cm decimal(5,2) [note: 'Recommended seed planting depth in centimeters for optimal germination and establishment.']
  potassium_requirement_kg_per_hectare decimal(8,2) [note: 'Recommended potassium fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.']
  rei_hours varchar [note: 'Restricted Entry Interval (REI) - minimum number of hours workers must wait before entering treated fields after pesticide application, ensuring worker safety compliance.']
  rotation_compatible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this crop is suitable for inclusion in crop rotation schedules to maintain soil health and reduce pest pressure.']
  row_spacing_cm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Recommended distance between crop rows in centimeters for optimal growth and equipment access.']
  scientific_name varchar [note: 'Scientific botanical name of the crop using binomial nomenclature (e.g., Zea mays for corn, Triticum aestivum for wheat).']
  seeding_rate_kg_per_hectare decimal(10,2) [note: 'Recommended seeding rate in kilograms per hectare for standard planting density.']
  soil_ph_max decimal(3,1) [note: 'Maximum soil pH level tolerated by the crop for healthy growth.']
  soil_ph_min decimal(3,1) [note: 'Minimum soil pH level required for optimal crop growth and nutrient availability.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the crop in the master reference system. Active crops are available for planting schedules and field assignments.']
  temperature_max_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum temperature in Celsius tolerated by the crop before heat stress occurs.']
  temperature_min_celsius decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum temperature in Celsius required for crop germination and growth.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this crop master record was last modified.']
  water_requirement_mm decimal(8,2) [note: 'Total seasonal water requirement in millimeters, used for Evapotranspiration (ET)-driven irrigation planning.']
  yield_unit varchar [note: 'Standard unit of measure for crop yield reporting (e.g., bushels per acre for corn, kilograms per hectare for wheat). Used in Yield Per Minute (YPM) calculations.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for crop. Referenced by crop_id.'
}

Table crop.zone_map {
  zone_map_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for zone_map']

  map_code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric business identifier or code for the zone map, used for external reference and system integration.']
  map_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or title assigned to this zone map for identification and reference purposes.']
  map_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the zone map based on the agronomic or environmental attribute it represents (e.g., soil type, yield potential, elevation, NDVI vegetation index, soil moisture, nutrient levels).']
  max_value decimal(15,4) [note: 'Maximum value of the measured attribute observed across all zones in the map. Defines the upper bound of the data range.']
  mean_value decimal(15,4) [note: 'Average or mean value of the measured attribute across all zones in the map. Provides a central tendency measure for the field.']
  min_value decimal(15,4) [note: 'Minimum value of the measured attribute observed across all zones in the map. Defines the lower bound of the data range.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this zone map record was last modified or updated. Audit field for change tracking and data governance.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information about the zone map, such as data quality issues, field conditions during collection, or special considerations.']
  resolution_meters decimal(10,2) [note: 'Spatial resolution of the zone map expressed in meters, representing the grid cell size or minimum distinguishable feature size in the map.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the zone map indicating whether it is in draft, actively used for field operations, archived for historical reference, superseded by a newer version, or deprecated.']
  total_area_hectares decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total area covered by the zone map expressed in hectares. Represents the spatial extent of the mapped field or region.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for the attribute represented in the zone map (e.g., pH units, percent, meters, index value, volumetric water content).']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for the zone map following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Enables tracking of map revisions and updates over time.']
  zone_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct management zones defined within this zone map. Indicates the granularity of the variable rate application (VRA) prescription.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'Username or identifier of the agronomist, precision agriculture specialist, or system user who created or generated the zone map.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for zone_map. Referenced by zone_map_id.'
}

  record_type varchar [note: 'Discriminator field that separates the two concerns managed by this data product: \'breeding_activity\' for actual mating/insemination events, and \'semen_inventory\' for semen or embryo inventory management records.']

  storage_location varchar [note: 'Precise physical location within the storage tank, expressed as canister, goblet, and cane identifiers (e.g., \'C2-G3-CN4\'). Enables rapid physical retrieval of specific semen straws or embryos during AI procedures.']
  synchronization_protocol varchar [note: 'Hormonal synchronization protocol used to coordinate estrus and ovulation timing prior to the AI or ET event. Common protocols include CIDR (Controlled Internal Drug Release), OvSynch, CoSynch, Select-Synch, and MGA (melengestrol acetate). \'none\' indicates natural estrus detection was used. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CIDR|OvSynch|CoSynch|Select_Synch|MGA|none|TAI|FTAI — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this breeding event or inventory record was most recently modified. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.']

  Note: 'Master and transactional record for the breeding program — encompassing both breeding activities and semen/embryo inventory management.   birth_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the parturition by number of offspring born in the event (e.g., single, twin, triplet). Impacts dam recovery protocols, colostrum management, and offspring survival rates.']
  birth_weight_kg decimal(6,2) [note: 'Average birth weight in kilograms across all live offspring born in this parturition event. For individual offspring weights, see the offspring detail records. Used for growth performance benchmarking and genetic evaluation (EPD).']
  breeding_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the dam was bred that resulted in this parturition: natural service, artificial insemination (AI), or embryo transfer (ET). Used for genetic program performance analysis and sire utilization reporting.']
  colostrum_administered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether colostrum was administered to the newborn offspring following birth. Critical for passive immunity transfer and neonatal survival; required for animal welfare compliance documentation.']
  colostrum_source varchar [note: 'Source of colostrum provided to the newborn offspring: from the dam directly, pooled from other animals, commercial colostrum supplement, or frozen colostrum bank. Relevant for biosecurity and disease transmission risk management.']
  colostrum_volume_ml decimal(7,2) [note: 'Volume of colostrum administered to the newborn offspring in millilitres. Used to verify adequate passive immunity transfer per species-specific protocols and animal welfare standards.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this parturition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.']
  dam_body_condition_score decimal(3,1) [note: 'Body Condition Score (BCS) of the dam at the time of parturition, assessed on a standardized scale (e.g., 1–5 for cattle/sheep, 1–9 for swine). Indicates dam nutritional status and predicts post-partum reproductive performance.']
  dam_parity varchar [note: 'The parity number (number of times the dam has given birth, including this event) at the time of parturition. First-parity animals carry higher dystocia risk; used for reproductive lifecycle analytics.']
  dam_post_partum_status varchar [note: 'Health status of the dam immediately following the parturition event. Drives post-partum care protocols, veterinary treatment scheduling, and culling decisions.']
  dystocia_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the parturition involved dystocia (difficult birth requiring intervention). Drives veterinary follow-up workflows and is used in sire EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) calculations.']
  ease_of_birth_score varchar [note: 'Standardized numeric score (typically 1–5 scale) indicating the difficulty of the parturition: 1=No assistance, 2=Easy pull, 3=Hard pull, 4=Mechanical assistance, 5=Caesarean/Veterinary. Used for dystocia tracking, sire selection, and animal welfare compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5 — promote to reference product]']
  event_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the parturition event, used for cross-referencing with farm management systems (e.g., Granular, SAP) and regulatory reporting. Format: PART-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  gestation_length_days varchar [note: 'Number of days from confirmed conception or breeding date to the birth date. Compared against species-standard gestation norms to flag premature or overdue births and assess breeding program accuracy.']
  intervention_type varchar [note: 'Type of veterinary or assisted intervention performed during the parturition event. Used for dystocia severity classification, cost allocation, and sire/dam selection analytics.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for attending staff or veterinarian to record additional observations about the parturition event not captured in structured fields (e.g., unusual presentations, environmental conditions, dam behavior).']
  offspring_born_alive varchar [note: 'Count of offspring born alive during this parturition event. Key metric for reproductive efficiency reporting and herd performance benchmarking.']
  offspring_stillborn varchar [note: 'Count of offspring born dead (stillborn) during this parturition event. Used for mortality analysis, genetic program evaluation, and animal welfare compliance reporting.']
  placenta_expelled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the placenta (afterbirth) was fully expelled following parturition. Retained placenta is a significant post-partum health risk requiring veterinary intervention; tracked for dam health monitoring.']
  placenta_expulsion_hours decimal(5,1) [note: 'Number of hours after birth until the placenta was fully expelled. Values exceeding species-specific thresholds (e.g., >12 hours in cattle) trigger retained placenta alerts and veterinary follow-up workflows.']
  presentation_type varchar [note: 'Describes the position of the fetus at the time of delivery (anterior/normal, posterior/backward, transverse/sideways). Relevant for dystocia risk assessment and veterinary intervention records.']
  record_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of the parturition record within the farm management system. DRAFT indicates pending verification; CONFIRMED indicates validated entry; AMENDED indicates a corrected record; VOIDED indicates a data entry error.']
  season_code varchar [note: 'Agricultural season in which the parturition event occurred. Used for seasonal performance benchmarking, feed planning, and herd management scheduling.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this parturition record originated (e.g., Granular Farm Management, SAP S/4HANA, John Deere Operations Center, or manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  species_code varchar [note: 'Livestock species involved in the parturition event. Determines the applicable regulatory framework (FSIS, APHIS) and terminology (calving, farrowing, lambing, kidding, foaling).']
  total_offspring_born varchar [note: 'Total count of offspring born during this parturition event, including stillborn. Used for litter size analytics and dam reproductive performance KPIs.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this parturition record was most recently modified. Used for change detection in incremental Silver layer loads and audit compliance.']
  veterinary_intervention boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a licensed veterinarian was required to intervene during the parturition event (e.g., caesarean section, manual correction of malpresentation). Drives post-event health monitoring and cost tracking.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing each birth or calving/farrowing/lambing/kidding event. Records dam ID, sire ID, birth date, birth time, number of offspring, individual offspring IDs, birth weight per offspring, birth type (single, twin, triplet), ease of birth score, colostrum administration, dam body condition score at birth, and attending staff. Initiates the animal master record for newborns and feeds into herd performance reporting.'
}

Table livestock.weight_measurement {
  weight_measurement_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each individual weight measurement record. Serves as the primary key for the weight_measurement data product in the livestock domain Silver Layer.']
  animal_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the individual animal record being weighed. Populated for individual-scale measurements; null for group/pen-level measurements. Links to the animal master record in the livestock domain.']
  asset_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the weighing equipment (scale, load cell, or weigh tape device) used to capture the measurement. Links to the equipment asset master for calibration traceability.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the workforce employee or contractor who performed and recorded the weight measurement. Required for audit trail and operator performance tracking.']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the farm, feedlot, barn, or production facility where the weight measurement was taken. Supports geographic and facility-level performance analytics.']
  herd_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: weight_measurement records individual and group weights at production checkpoints. The herd context is essential for herd-level average daily gain (ADG) reporting, performance benchmarking, and market']
  observation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Livestock weight measurements require shrink adjustment based on weather conditions (heat stress causes higher shrink). weight_measurement has shrink_pct and adjusted_weight_kg fields. Linking to weat']
  pen_location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to livestock.pen_location. Business justification: weight_measurement records are taken at specific pen/scale locations within the livestock facility. Adding pen_location_id → livestock.pen_location.pen_location_id enables location-based weight perfor']
  production_group_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the pen, lot, or production group being weighed when measurements are taken at the group level rather than individually. Null for individual animal measurements.']
  adg_kg decimal(6,4) [note: 'Average Daily Gain (ADG) in kilograms per day, calculated as the difference between current and previous body weight divided by the number of days elapsed. A key Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for growth performance tracking and feed conversion ratio (FCR) analysis. Stored as a captured/confirmed value from the source system, not recomputed.']
  adjusted_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'Body weight after applying shrink percentage adjustment, representing the net pay weight used for sale, transfer, or harvest transactions. Calculated as body_weight_kg × (1 - shrink_pct/100) and stored for traceability.']
  age_days varchar [note: 'Age of the animal in days at the time of measurement, calculated from the recorded birth date. Used to compute age-adjusted weight benchmarks, frame scores, and to assess growth performance relative to breed and production stage expectations.']
  body_condition_score decimal(3,1) [note: 'Body Condition Score (BCS) assigned to the animal at the time of weighing, typically on a 1–9 scale for beef cattle or 1–5 scale for dairy/sheep. Assesses fat cover and muscle mass relative to skeletal frame. Critical for animal welfare compliance, breeding readiness, and nutritional management decisions.']
  body_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'The measured live body weight of the individual animal or average body weight per head for a group measurement, expressed in kilograms. This is the principal quantitative outcome of the measurement event. Used in ADG calculations, FCR analysis, and harvest readiness assessment.']
  body_weight_lbs decimal(10,3) [note: 'The measured live body weight expressed in pounds (lbs), the primary unit of measure used in US domestic livestock markets, USDA reporting, and sale/harvest transactions. Maintained alongside kg for dual-unit reporting compliance.']
  breed_code varchar [note: 'Standardized breed code for the animal being weighed (e.g., ANGUS, HEREFORD, DUROC, HOLSTEIN). Used to apply breed-specific growth curves, expected weight benchmarks, and frame score standards in performance analytics.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this weight measurement record was first created in the system of record. Distinct from measurement_timestamp which captures the real-world event time. Required for data lineage and Silver Layer audit trail.']
  days_on_feed varchar [note: 'Number of days the animal or group has been on the current feed ration since feedlot entry or last production stage transition. Used in conjunction with ADG to assess feed conversion efficiency and project harvest readiness date.']
  ear_tag_number varchar [note: 'Visual ear tag identifier recorded at the time of weighing for cross-verification with RFID and as a backup identification method. Used in manual weighing operations and visual lot reconciliation.']
  frame_score decimal(3,1) [note: 'Numerical frame score (typically 1–9 for beef cattle) based on hip height measurement at a standard age, used to predict mature body size and optimal harvest weight. Supports breed selection, feeding program design, and market endpoint targeting.']
  harvest_ready_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator set to True when the animal\'s current body weight, BCS, and days on feed meet the defined harvest readiness criteria for the production program. Triggers harvest scheduling workflow and FSIS pre-harvest notification processes.']
  head_count varchar [note: 'Number of animals included in the measurement event. For individual measurements this is 1. For group/pen measurements this is the total number of animals weighed, used to calculate average body weight per head and total pen weight.']
  hip_height_cm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Measured hip height of the animal in centimeters at the time of weighing, used to calculate frame score and assess skeletal development relative to body weight. Supports growth curve modeling and breed standard compliance.']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Lot Number (LOT) identifying the production batch or consignment group to which the animal belongs at the time of measurement. Enables batch-level traceability from farm through harvest, supporting FSMA and FSIS compliance requirements.']
  measurement_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the weight measurement was taken, stored as a DATE type for day-level partitioning, reporting, and production checkpoint scheduling. Derived from measurement_timestamp but retained for query performance.']
  measurement_method varchar [note: 'The technique or equipment type used to obtain the body weight. Affects measurement precision and confidence. Individual scale and load cell are most accurate; weigh tape and estimated methods carry higher variance and are flagged accordingly in analytics.']
  measurement_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operator observations recorded at the time of weighing, such as animal behavior, equipment anomalies, environmental conditions, or reasons for weight variance. Supports audit trail and veterinary follow-up.']
  measurement_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the weight measurement event, used for cross-referencing with farm management systems, scale printouts, and audit trails. Format: WM-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.']
  measurement_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the weight measurement record. \'recorded\' = initial capture; \'verified\' = validated by supervisor or QA; \'rejected\' = failed validation rules; \'voided\' = cancelled after entry error.']
  measurement_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The exact date and time when the weight measurement was physically taken. This is the principal real-world event timestamp, distinct from record audit timestamps. Critical for Average Daily Gain (ADG) calculations and production checkpoint tracking.']
  previous_measurement_date date [note: 'The date of the immediately preceding weight measurement for the same animal or group. Used to calculate the interval in days for ADG computation and to validate measurement frequency compliance.']
  previous_weight_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'The body weight recorded at the immediately preceding measurement event for the same animal or group, in kilograms. Stored on this record to support ADG validation and trend analysis without requiring a self-join.']
  production_stage varchar [note: 'Defined production checkpoint at which the weight measurement was taken, representing the animal\'s lifecycle stage. Drives growth performance benchmarking, feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculations, and harvest readiness assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: birth|weaning|backgrounding|feedlot_entry|mid_feed|pre_harvest|harvest — promote to reference product]']
  rfid_tag_number varchar [note: 'The Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) electronic tag number read from the animal at the time of weighing, used to confirm animal identity and enable automated data capture from walk-over scales and electronic identification systems. Supports USDA APHIS traceability requirements.']
  sex_code varchar [note: 'Sex classification of the animal: M=Male (intact bull/boar/ram), F=Female (heifer/cow/gilt/ewe), C=Castrated male (steer/barrow/wether), S=Spayed female. Affects expected growth rates, weight benchmarks, and market endpoint targets.']
  shrink_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Estimated or measured percentage of body weight lost due to gut fill, stress, or transit prior to weighing (pencil shrink or actual shrink). Applied in sale weight calculations and market price negotiations. Standard industry practice in US livestock markets.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this weight measurement record was ingested into the Silver Layer (e.g., Granular Farm Management, Climate FieldView, SAP S/4HANA PP, John Deere Operations Center, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.']
  species_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the livestock species being weighed. Determines applicable weight benchmarks, BCS scales, frame score standards, and regulatory reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BEEF|DAIRY|SWINE|SHEEP|GOAT|POULTRY|EQUINE — promote to reference product]']
  total_group_weight_kg decimal(12,3) [note: 'Total combined live weight of all animals in a group measurement event, expressed in kilograms. Null for individual animal measurements. Used for pen-level inventory valuation and feed planning.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The primary unit of measure in which the weight was recorded at the point of capture (kg or lbs). Determines which weight field is the source-of-truth value; the alternate unit field is a conversion.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this weight measurement record was last modified, including status changes, corrections, or verification actions. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer pipeline.']
  weigh_condition varchar [note: 'Describes the gut-fill or fasting condition of the animal at the time of weighing, which directly affects the accuracy and comparability of weight measurements. Used to apply appropriate shrink adjustments and flag outlier weights.']
  weight_variance_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator set to True when the measured body weight deviates from the expected weight by more than the configured tolerance threshold (e.g., ±15% from breed/age/stage benchmark). Triggers data quality review and potential animal health investigation.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of individual or group weight measurements taken at defined production checkpoints (weaning, backgrounding, feedlot entry, pre-harvest). Captures measurement date, animal ID or group ID, scale ID, body weight (lbs/kg), average daily gain (ADG) since last measurement, body condition score (BCS), frame score, measurement method (individual scale, load cell, weigh tape), and operator. Feeds into growth performance tracking, feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculations, and harvest readiness assessment.'
}

  overall_welfare_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite welfare score calculated per the applied protocol methodology, aggregating all scored indicators into a single numeric outcome. Used for trend analysis, certification thresholds, and retailer reporting.']
  respiratory_disease_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of assessed animals showing clinical signs of respiratory disease (e.g., Bovine Respiratory Disease complex). Tracked as a health and welfare outcome indicator per PAACO audit criteria.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this assessment record originated (e.g., SAP QM module, Granular Farm Management, Trimble Ag Software, manual entry, or third-party auditor portal). Supports data lineage in the Silver layer.']
  species_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the animal species being assessed. Determines applicable welfare standards, scoring thresholds, and regulatory requirements.']
  stocking_density_score decimal(4,2) [note: 'Scored evaluation of animal stocking density relative to protocol-defined space allowances (e.g., square feet per animal). Reflects freedom of movement and housing welfare compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp of the most recent modification to this assessment record, supporting audit trail and change management requirements.']
  water_access_score decimal(4,2) [note: 'Scored assessment of animal access to clean, fresh water including drinker availability, functionality, and cleanliness. Reflects Freedom from Thirst under the Five Freedoms framework.']
  welfare_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for assessor observations, contextual notes, environmental conditions at time of assessment, or additional welfare findings not captured in scored indicators.']
  welfare_outcome_rating varchar [note: 'Categorical rating derived from the overall welfare score, classifying the assessment outcome against protocol-defined thresholds. Used for pass/fail determination in certification audits.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of periodic animal welfare evaluations conducted at the pen or herd level. Captures assessment date, location, assessor identity, welfare protocol used (e.g., Five Freedoms, PAACO feedlot audit), scored indicators (body condition, lameness score, cleanliness, injury prevalence, mortality rate), overall welfare score, corrective actions required, and certification body reference. Supports GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, and retailer animal welfare audit requirements.'
}

  epd_marbling decimal(5,2) [note: 'Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for marbling (intramuscular fat), expressed in marbling score units. Drives carcass quality grade outcomes (USDA Choice/Prime) and is a key metric for beef quality programs.']
  epd_milk decimal(5,2) [note: 'Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for milk production, expressed in pounds of weaning weight attributed to the milking ability of daughters. Used for selecting sires whose daughters will be retained as replacement heifers.']
  epd_rea decimal(5,2) [note: 'Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for Ribeye Area (REA) in square inches. Indicates the sire\'s genetic potential to transmit muscle mass to offspring, influencing USDA yield grade and cutability.']
  epd_weaning_weight decimal(5,2) [note: 'Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for weaning weight in pounds. Indicates the sire\'s genetic potential to transmit growth performance to offspring at weaning age (approximately 205 days). Key metric for cow-calf operation profitability.']
  epd_yearling_weight decimal(5,2) [note: 'Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for yearling weight in pounds. Reflects the sire\'s genetic potential for post-weaning growth performance, critical for stocker and feedlot program sire selection.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date after which the semen straws or embryos are no longer certified for use, as specified by the supplier on the COA. Supports inventory expiry management and prevents use of out-of-date genetic material.']
  genomic_enhanced_epd boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the EPD values for this sire have been enhanced using genomic (DNA marker) data, resulting in higher accuracy predictions. Genomic-Enhanced EPDs (GE-EPDs) carry greater reliability, especially for young sires with limited progeny data.']
  goblet_cane_position varchar [note: 'Specific goblet and cane position within the canister where the semen straws or embryos are stored (e.g., \'G2-C3\'). Enables precise physical retrieval and supports inventory audit accuracy.']
  initial_quantity varchar [note: 'Original quantity of semen straws or embryos received at the time of the lot\'s first receipt into inventory. Used as the baseline for consumption tracking, utilization rate analysis, and breeding cost accounting.']
  inventory_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the semen or embryo inventory record. Drives availability for AI scheduling, quarantine holds for health compliance, and depletion tracking. Aligns with Manhattan Associates WMS inventory status and SAP S/4HANA MM stock status.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the semen inventory record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Batch tracking identifier assigned by the semen collection facility or supplier to the specific collection lot. Used for traceability, quality recall, and conception rate analysis by collection batch. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA QM batch management.']
  material_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the biological material stored in inventory. Distinguishes between conventional semen straws, sexed semen straws, and embryos for AI and ET program planning and cost accounting.']
  post_thaw_motility_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of progressively motile sperm cells observed after thawing, as reported on the Certificate of Analysis (COA) from the semen supplier. Primary quality grade indicator; minimum acceptable threshold is typically 30-35% per NAAB standards. Drives AI program quality decisions.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order (PO) number associated with the procurement of this semen lot. Links the inventory record to the procurement transaction for AP invoice matching, GRN reconciliation, and cost accounting.']
  quality_grade varchar [note: 'Overall quality classification of the semen lot based on post-thaw motility, morphology, and concentration assessments from the COA. Used for AI program tier selection and supplier quality management.']
  quantity_on_hand varchar [note: 'Current count of semen straws or embryos physically available in storage. Decremented upon each AI or ET use event. Core inventory metric for AI program planning and reorder decisions.']
  receipt_date date [note: 'Date the semen straws or embryos were physically received into the farm\'s storage facility. Used for Goods Receipt Note (GRN) reconciliation against purchase orders in SAP S/4HANA MM and for storage duration tracking.']
  sex_sort_target varchar [note: 'Target sex for sorted semen straws (female for heifer production, male for bull calf production). Only applicable when sexed_semen is True. Drives replacement heifer program planning and calf crop gender management.']
  sexed_semen boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the semen straws in this inventory lot are sex-sorted (sexed semen), allowing producers to select for heifer or bull calves. Sexed semen commands a premium price and has lower conception rates than conventional semen.']
  sire_name varchar [note: 'Common or registered name of the sire animal from which semen was collected. Used for genetic selection decisions, AI program planning, and breeder communications.']
  sire_registration_number varchar [note: 'Official breed association registration number for the sire (bull or ram) from which semen was collected. Used for genetic pedigree verification, EPD lookup, and regulatory compliance with breed registries (e.g., American Angus Association, Holstein Association USA).']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit in which the genetic material quantity is counted and tracked (straw for semen, embryo for ET material, dose for bulk liquid nitrogen containers). Ensures consistent inventory accounting across material types.']

  Note: 'Master record tracking the inventory of semen straws and embryos held for artificial insemination (AI) and embryo transfer (ET) programs. Captures sire ID, sire name, breed, genetic registration number, EPD values (calving ease, birth weight, weaning weight, yearling weight, milk, marbling, REA), genomic-enhanced EPD flag, semen supplier, collection date, lot number, quantity on hand (straws/embryos), storage tank ID, storage location (canister/goblet/cane), conception rate history, cost per unit, and quality grade (post-thaw motility). Supports genetic selection decisions, AI program planning, and breeding cost accounting.'
}

  origin_country varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country of origin for the animals. Required for COOL compliance, import permit processing, and APHIS international traceability. Populated for all transactions; defaults to USA for domestic transfers.']
  origin_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code of the origin premises from which the animals were shipped. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) chain-of-custody documentation and APHIS interstate movement reporting.']
  price_per_cwt decimal(10,2) [note: 'Purchase or sale price expressed per hundredweight (CWT = 100 lbs) in USD. Standard pricing basis for cattle and hog transactions in North American livestock markets. Populated when the transaction is priced on a weight basis.']
  price_per_head decimal(12,2) [note: 'Purchase or sale price expressed on a per-head basis in USD. Populated when the transaction is priced per individual animal rather than per CWT. Mutually exclusive with price_per_cwt for a given transaction; one or both may be populated depending on transaction channel.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA MM purchase order number associated with this livestock purchase transaction. Populated for inbound (purchase) transactions only. Enables three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in accounts payable processing.']
  quarantine_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days the purchased animals must remain in quarantine isolation before integration into the main herd or flock. Populated only for purchase transactions where quarantine_required = True. Supports antibiotic withdrawal period tracking and biosecurity compliance.']
  quarantine_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the purchased animals are subject to a mandatory quarantine period upon arrival at the receiving premises. Applicable to purchase transactions only. Drives receiving pen assignment and health monitoring workflows.']
  rfid_tag_range varchar [note: 'Range or list of RFID electronic identification tag numbers (e.g., 840 USDA official ear tags) assigned to the animals in this transaction. Supports APHIS electronic animal identification traceability requirements and individual animal tracking.']
  species varchar [note: 'Biological species classification of the animals involved in the transaction (e.g., bovine for cattle, swine for hogs, ovine for sheep). Drives regulatory reporting requirements, withdrawal period tracking, and FSIS/APHIS compliance rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bovine|swine|ovine|caprine|equine|poultry|other — promote to reference product]']
  total_transaction_value decimal(14,2) [note: 'Gross total monetary value of the livestock transfer in USD, representing the full purchase cost (for inbound) or gross sale revenue (for outbound). Used for cost basis accounting, revenue recognition, and enterprise profitability analysis in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.']
  total_weight_lbs decimal(12,2) [note: 'Aggregate live weight in pounds of all animals in the transaction at the time of transfer (purchase weight for inbound; sale weight for outbound). Used for CWT (hundredweight) pricing calculations, cost basis accounting, and yield analysis.']
  transaction_channel varchar [note: 'The commercial channel through which the livestock transfer was executed. Direct = farm-to-farm; Auction = physical livestock auction market; Video Auction = remote video-based auction (e.g., Superior Livestock); Formula = price tied to a market index or formula; Private Treaty = negotiated private sale.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'The principal real-world business event date on which the livestock transfer (purchase or sale) was executed — i.e., the date of ownership transfer or market transaction. Distinct from transport or arrival dates.']
  transaction_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents an inbound livestock purchase (animals acquired from an external party) or an outbound livestock sale (animals transferred to an external buyer). Drives which conditional attributes are populated (e.g., quarantine period for purchases; grade/yield basis for sales).']
  transaction_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the livestock transfer event, typically sourced from SAP S/4HANA (purchase order number for inbound or sales order number for outbound) or the auction/market reference number. Used for cross-system reconciliation and counterparty communication.']
  transaction_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the livestock transfer event. Tracks the lifecycle from initial draft through confirmation, transit, completion, or cancellation. Drives downstream accounting and traceability processes.']
  transport_carrier_name varchar [note: 'Name of the licensed livestock transport carrier responsible for moving the animals between premises. Required for APHIS traceability, FMCSA compliance, and freight cost allocation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this animal transaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail compliance.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of all livestock transfer events — both purchases (inbound) and sales (outbound) — between the operation and external parties. Captures transaction date, transaction direction (purchase/sale), counterparty premises ID (vendor for purchases, buyer for sales), species, breed, head count, weight (purchase weight or sale weight), price per head or per CWT, total transaction value, transaction channel (direct, auction, video auction, formula), origin state/country, health certificate number, brand inspection certificate, import permit (if applicable for purchases), quarantine period required (for purchases), receiving pen assignment (for purchases), transport carrier, BOL reference, grade and yield basis (for sales), and COOL chain-of-custody documentation. Purchase-specific attributes (quarantine period, receiving pen, import permit) are populated only for purchase transactions. Sale-specific attributes (grade/yield basis, sale channel) are populated only for sale transactions. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all livestock commercial transfers. Supports livestock cost basis accounting, revenue recognition, enterprise profitability analysis, COOL compliance, and APHIS traceability. Distinguished from procurement/sales domain records by being animal-specific with livestock traceability attributes (health certificates, brand inspections, premises IDs) that generic commercial transaction records do not carry.'
}

Table livestock.protocol_drug_authorization {

  dosage_uom varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the authorized dosage amount for this drug in this protocol step (e.g., ml/cwt, mg/kg). Moved from health_protocol where it was stored as a single flat value.']
