  is_active boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the sensor is currently active and should be included in data collection and monitoring processes.']
  last_calibration_date date [note: 'Date when the sensor was last calibrated to ensure measurement accuracy and compliance with quality standards.']
  last_maintenance_date date [note: 'Date when the sensor last received maintenance service such as cleaning, battery replacement, or physical inspection.']
  last_reading_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent data reading received from the sensor, used to monitor sensor connectivity and operational status.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the sensor installation location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and weather mapping.']
  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the sensor installation location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and weather mapping.']
  manufacturer varchar [note: 'Name of the company or organization that manufactured the sensor device.']
  measurement_range_max decimal(10,2) [note: 'Maximum value that the sensor is capable of measuring within its operational specifications.']
  measurement_range_min decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum value that the sensor is capable of measuring within its operational specifications.']
  measurement_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure in which the sensor reports its readings, such as Celsius for temperature, percent for humidity, or millimeters for precipitation.']
  model_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer-assigned model number or designation for the sensor device, used for technical specifications and maintenance reference.']
  next_calibration_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next calibration service to maintain sensor accuracy and operational reliability.']
  next_maintenance_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service to ensure continued sensor reliability and data quality.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for recording additional information about the sensor such as installation conditions, known issues, or special configuration details.']
  operational_status varchar [note: 'Current operational state of the sensor indicating whether it is actively collecting data, under maintenance, experiencing faults, or has been retired from service.']
  power_source varchar [note: 'Type of power supply used to operate the sensor device, such as battery, solar panel, or alternating current.']
  sampling_frequency_seconds varchar [note: 'Interval in seconds at which the sensor collects and reports measurements. Lower values indicate more frequent data collection.']
  sensor_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique alphanumeric code or serial number assigned to the sensor device by the manufacturer or deployment system.']
  sensor_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or label assigned to the sensor for identification purposes in field operations and monitoring dashboards.']
  sensor_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the sensor based on the meteorological or environmental parameter it measures. Determines the type of data collected and its application in agricultural decision-making.']
  serial_number varchar [note: 'Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific sensor unit for warranty, support, and traceability purposes.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this sensor record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.']
  warranty_expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the manufacturer warranty coverage for the sensor device expires.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for sensor. Referenced by sensor_id.'
}

Table weather.calibration_standard {
  calibration_standard_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for calibration_standard']
  parent_calibration_standard_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on calibration_standard (parent_calibration_standard_id)']
  accuracy_tolerance decimal(10,6) [note: 'The maximum permissible deviation from the reference value, expressed in the same unit of measure. Defines the acceptable calibration error range.']

  acquisition_date date [note: 'The date on which the calibration standard was acquired or purchased by the organization. Used for asset management and depreciation tracking.']
  applicable_sensor_types varchar [note: 'List of sensor types and models that can be calibrated using this standard, such as thermocouples, resistance temperature detectors, capacitive humidity sensors, or tipping bucket rain gauges.']
  certificate_number varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the calibration certificate issued by the certifying authority. Used for audit and compliance verification.']
  certification_date date [note: 'The date on which the calibration standard was certified by the certifying authority. Marks the beginning of the standards validity period.']
  certifying_authority varchar [note: 'The name of the accredited laboratory, national metrology institute, or certification body that issued the calibration certificate for this standard.']
  compliance_notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes regarding regulatory compliance, special handling requirements, or deviations from standard procedures relevant to this calibration standard.']
  confidence_level_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'The statistical confidence level associated with the uncertainty value, typically expressed as a percentage such as 95% or 99%.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this calibration standard record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.']
  custodian_name varchar [note: 'Name of the person or department responsible for the custody, maintenance, and proper use of this calibration standard.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the calibration certificate expires and the standard must be recertified or retired from use. Critical for maintaining calibration validity.']
  is_primary_standard boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this is a primary calibration standard with direct traceability to national standards, or a secondary/working standard derived from a primary standard.']
  last_verification_date date [note: 'The most recent date on which the calibration standard was verified or checked for continued accuracy and compliance with specifications.']
  location_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the physical location where the calibration standard is stored, such as a laboratory, field station, or calibration facility identifier.']
  manufacturer_name varchar [note: 'The name of the company or organization that manufactured the calibration standard device or reference material.']
  measurement_parameter varchar [note: 'Specific meteorological or environmental parameter that this standard is designed to measure or calibrate, such as air temperature, relative humidity, barometric pressure, or rainfall intensity.']
  model_number varchar [note: 'The manufacturers model or part number for the calibration standard. Used for procurement, maintenance, and replacement planning.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this calibration standard record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.']
  next_verification_due_date date [note: 'The scheduled date for the next verification or recalibration of the standard. Used for maintenance planning and compliance tracking.']
  operating_range_max decimal(18,6) [note: 'The maximum value of the measurement range over which this calibration standard is valid and accurate, expressed in the unit of measure.']
  operating_range_min decimal(18,6) [note: 'The minimum value of the measurement range over which this calibration standard is valid and accurate, expressed in the unit of measure.']
  recalibration_interval_days varchar [note: 'The recommended number of days between recalibrations to maintain the standards accuracy and traceability. Typically ranges from 180 to 730 days depending on standard type and usage.']
  reference_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The certified reference value of the calibration standard. This is the known, traceable value against which field sensors and equipment are calibrated.']
  serial_number varchar [note: 'Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific calibration standard unit. Enables individual asset tracking and history.']
  standard_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique code identifying this calibration standard in laboratory and field systems. Used for traceability and reference in calibration procedures.']
  standard_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the calibration standard used for sensor and equipment calibration in agricultural weather monitoring systems.']
  standard_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the calibration standard indicating whether it is available for use, expired and awaiting recalibration, retired from service, or temporarily suspended.']
  standard_type varchar [note: 'Category of calibration standard indicating which meteorological parameter it is designed to calibrate. Determines applicability to specific sensor types.']
  storage_conditions varchar [note: 'Required environmental conditions for proper storage of the calibration standard when not in use, including temperature range, humidity limits, and protection requirements.']
  traceability_chain varchar [note: 'Documentation of the unbroken chain of calibrations linking this standard to national or international measurement standards, ensuring metrological traceability.']
  uncertainty_value decimal(10,6) [note: 'The quantified uncertainty associated with the reference value, representing the range within which the true value is expected to lie with a specified confidence level.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which the reference value is expressed, such as degrees Celsius, percent relative humidity, millibars, meters per second, or millimeters.']
  usage_instructions varchar [note: 'Detailed instructions for proper use of the calibration standard in field and laboratory calibration procedures, including setup, stabilization time, and handling precautions.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for calibration_standard. Referenced by reference_standard_id.'
}

Table weather.station_network {
  station_network_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for station_network']
  parent_station_network_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on station_network (parent_station_network_id)']

  authentication_method varchar [note: 'Security authentication mechanism required to access the network\'s data feed. API Key for token-based access; OAuth for delegated authorization; Basic Auth for username/password; Certificate for mutual TLS; None for public data sources.']
  calibration_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Standard interval in days between equipment calibration cycles for stations in this network. Critical for maintaining measurement accuracy for precision agriculture applications.']
  contract_end_date date [note: 'Date when the data subscription or partnership agreement with this network provider expires. Null for perpetual or government data sources. Critical for vendor management and budget planning.']
  contract_start_date date [note: 'Date when the data subscription or partnership agreement with this network provider became effective. Applicable for commercial weather data services like DTN.']
  coverage_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or territory covered by the station network. May be global, national, state-level, or localized to specific agricultural zones.']

  data_feed_protocol varchar [note: 'Technical protocol used to receive weather data from the network. API for RESTful services; FTP for batch file transfers; MQTT for IoT sensor streams; HTTP for web services; WebSocket for real-time streaming; proprietary for vendor-specific formats.']
  data_format varchar [note: 'File or message format used by the network to deliver weather data. JSON and XML for web services; CSV for tabular data; GRIB and NetCDF for gridded meteorological data; Proprietary for vendor-specific formats requiring custom parsers.']
  data_latency_minutes varchar [note: 'Average time delay between observation collection at the station and data availability in the feed, measured in minutes. Critical for time-sensitive agricultural decisions like spray window timing.']
  data_parameters_available varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of weather parameters provided by this network (e.g., \'temperature,precipitation,humidity,wind_speed,solar_radiation,soil_moisture,evapotranspiration\'). Defines the analytical capabilities supported by this network.']
  data_update_frequency_minutes varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the network publishes updated weather observations, measured in minutes. Typical values: 5 minutes for real-time IoT sensors, 15 minutes for automated stations, 60 minutes for manual observations.']
  documentation_url varchar [note: 'Web URL pointing to the network\'s technical documentation, API specifications, and data dictionaries. Essential reference for data integration and interpretation.']
  forecast_horizon_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of days into the future for which forecast data is available from this network. Typical values: 7-10 days for operational forecasts, 14-16 days for extended outlooks. Null if network does not provide forecasts.']
  historical_data_start_date date [note: 'Earliest date for which historical weather observations are available from this network. Important for climate analysis, growing degree day (GDD) calculations, and multi-year trend analysis.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this station network record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.']
  measurement_units_system varchar [note: 'Standard system of measurement used by the network for reporting weather data. Metric uses Celsius, millimeters, meters per second; Imperial uses Fahrenheit, inches, miles per hour; Mixed uses combination based on parameter type.']
  network_code varchar [note: 'Unique alphanumeric code identifying the weather station network. Used for external references and integrations with DTN, Climate FieldView, and other weather data providers.']
  network_name varchar [note: 'Full business name of the weather station network (e.g., \'National Weather Service ASOS\', \'DTN Agricultural Network\', \'Climate FieldView Station Grid\').']
  network_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the weather station network. Active networks provide real-time data feeds; inactive networks are temporarily offline; suspended networks have data quality issues; decommissioned networks are permanently retired; pilot networks are in testing phase.']
  network_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the station network by ownership and operational model. Government networks include NWS, NOAA; commercial includes DTN, Weather Underground; cooperative includes CoCoRaHS; private includes on-farm IoT sensor networks; research includes university agricultural research stations.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional information about the network, including special configuration details, known data quality issues, integration challenges, or operational notes for data engineering teams.']
  operator_organization varchar [note: 'Name of the organization that owns and operates the weather station network (e.g., \'National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration\', \'DTN LLC\', \'Climate Corporation\', \'Iowa State University\').']
  primary_contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the primary contact at the network operator organization. Used for technical support requests and service notifications.']
  primary_contact_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary technical or account contact at the network operator organization. Used for issue escalation, contract renewals, and technical support.']
  primary_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number of the primary contact at the network operator organization. Used for urgent technical issues and service outages.']
  primary_country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary country of operation for the network (e.g., \'USA\', \'CAN\', \'BRA\', \'ARG\').']
  quality_assurance_level varchar [note: 'Level of data quality control and validation applied by the network. Basic includes automated range checks; Standard adds cross-validation with nearby stations; Enhanced includes manual review and correction; Research Grade meets scientific publication standards.']
  reliability_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Calculated reliability metric (0-100) based on data availability, uptime, and quality over the past 12 months. Used for vendor performance evaluation and data source prioritization in multi-network environments.']
  spatial_resolution_km decimal(8,2) [note: 'Average distance in kilometers between stations in the network, representing the spatial granularity of coverage. Lower values indicate denser station placement and more localized weather data. Critical for field-level precision agriculture.']
  station_count varchar [note: 'Total number of active weather stations currently operating within this network. Updated periodically as stations are added or decommissioned.']
  supports_alerts boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the network provides automated weather alerts and warnings (e.g., frost alerts, severe weather warnings, spray window notifications). Critical for risk management and operational decision support.']
  supports_forecast_data boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the network provides forecast data in addition to historical and real-time observations. True for networks like DTN and NOAA that include predictive models; False for observation-only networks.']
  terms_of_use_url varchar [note: 'Web URL pointing to the legal terms of use, licensing restrictions, and data redistribution policies for the network\'s data. Critical for compliance with data usage agreements.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for station_network. Referenced by network_id.'
}

  last_activity_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, task) associated with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to identify dormant contacts, measure engagement health, and trigger re-engagement workflows.']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Family (last) name of the individual contact person. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for reporting and correspondence.']
  lead_source varchar [note: 'The originating channel or event through which this contact was first acquired or identified. Used for marketing attribution, ROI analysis of lead generation programs, and sales pipeline reporting in Salesforce CRM.']
  linkedin_profile_url varchar [note: 'URL to the contact\'s LinkedIn professional profile. Used by sales and account management teams for relationship intelligence, prospecting, and partner engagement via Salesforce CRM integration.']
  marketing_opt_in boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the contact has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications (newsletters, product promotions, agricultural insights). Required under GDPR for international operations and CAN-SPAM for US contacts. True = opted in; False = opted out or no consent given.']
  marketing_opt_in_date date [note: 'Date on which the contact provided explicit marketing consent. Required for GDPR audit trail demonstrating lawful basis for processing personal data for marketing purposes.']
  marketing_opt_out_date date [note: 'Date on which the contact withdrew marketing consent or requested opt-out. Triggers suppression from all marketing campaigns. Required for GDPR compliance and CAN-SPAM unsubscribe processing.']
  mobile_phone varchar [note: 'Mobile/cell phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for SMS alerts, two-factor authentication, and field-level communications with agronomists or logistics coordinators.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for account managers and sales representatives to capture qualitative context about the contact, including relationship history, communication preferences, and strategic account notes. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business relationship details.']
  phone varchar [note: 'Primary business phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent supply chain communications, food safety alerts, and account management calls.']
  preferred_communication_channel varchar [note: 'The contact\'s preferred channel for receiving business communications. Drives outreach strategy for sales, compliance notifications, and marketing campaigns. Aligns with GDPR consent management.']
  salesforce_contact_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this contact record in Salesforce CRM, used for bidirectional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record for sales pipeline and partner management.']
  salutation varchar [note: 'Formal salutation or honorific prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Used in formal correspondence, contract documents, and regulatory communications.']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'IANA time zone identifier for the contact\'s location (e.g., America/Chicago, Europe/London). Used to schedule communications, meetings, and automated alerts at appropriate local times for global agricultural supply chain partners.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the contact record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer pipeline, data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance.']

  Note: 'Individual contact persons associated with a customer account — including procurement managers, food safety officers, agronomists, and buying agents at food manufacturers, distributors, and retail chains. Stores full name, job title, department, primary phone, email, preferred communication channel, LinkedIn profile, Salesforce CRM contact ID, FSMA point-of-contact flag, HACCP coordinator flag, and opt-in/opt-out marketing consent status per GDPR requirements for international operations.'
}

Table customer.account_hierarchy {
  account_hierarchy_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each inter-account relationship record within the customer network hierarchy. Primary key for the account_hierarchy data product.']
  child_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the account that occupies the subordinate or child position in this relationship record (e.g., regional subsidiary, cooperative member, buying group affiliate, toll processor, or franchisee). Paired with parent_account_id to define the directed relationship.']
  parent_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the account that occupies the superior or parent position in this relationship record (e.g., global parent corporation, cooperative headquarters, buying group administrator, or broker principal). Supports multi-tier food manufacturer and cooperative grain marketing network structures.']
  primary_account_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the internal employee or sales representative designated as the accountable relationship manager for this inter-account link. Supports CRM pipeline management, account review scheduling, and escalation routing in Salesforce CRM.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which this inter-account relationship was formally approved by the designated approver. Used for governance audit trails and SOX compliance documentation.']
  buying_group_code varchar [note: 'Identifier for the buying group or purchasing alliance to which this relationship belongs. Applicable when relationship_type is \'buying_group\'. Used for aggregated volume discount calculation, group pricing tier assignment, and consolidated purchase order management.']
  consolidation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this relationship participates in enterprise-wide credit limit and volume discount aggregation (True). When True, the child account\'s credit exposure and purchase volumes are rolled up to the parent account for consolidated limit management and tiered pricing eligibility across the agricultural commodity trading network.']
  contractual_basis_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this inter-account relationship is underpinned by a formal executed contract (True) or is an informal/operational affiliation without a binding legal agreement (False). Critical for credit limit consolidation eligibility and volume discount aggregation authorization.']
  cool_preference varchar [note: 'Indicates the Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) preference for this account relationship. \'required\' means COOL documentation is contractually mandated for all shipments; \'preferred\' means requested but not contractually binding; \'not_required\' means no COOL documentation needed. Supports USDA COOL compliance under the Agricultural Marketing Act.']
  cooperative_membership_number varchar [note: 'Formal membership identifier assigned by the cooperative organization to the member account. Applicable when relationship_type is \'cooperative_member\'. Used for grain marketing cooperative patronage tracking, equity allocation, and USDA cooperative reporting under the Agricultural Marketing Act.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and GDPR data retention management.']
  credit_limit_consolidated decimal(18,2) [note: 'The enterprise-wide consolidated credit limit amount (in base currency) applicable to this relationship node when consolidation_flag is True. Represents the maximum aggregate credit exposure permitted across the parent-child account group for agricultural commodity trading and supply chain transactions.']
  credit_limit_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the consolidated credit limit amount (e.g., \'USD\', \'EUR\', \'CAD\'). Required for multi-currency agricultural commodity trading operations.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which this inter-account relationship became or becomes legally and operationally effective. Used for time-bounded hierarchy queries, credit consolidation windows, and volume discount eligibility calculations.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which this inter-account relationship ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended relationship with no defined termination. Used for time-bounded hierarchy queries and contract renewal management.']
  franchise_agreement_number varchar [note: 'Formal agreement number for franchise network relationships. Applicable when relationship_type is \'franchise\'. Used for franchise royalty tracking, territory management, and compliance monitoring under franchise disclosure regulations.']
  gfsi_certification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account in this relationship is required to hold a valid GFSI-recognized food safety certification (e.g., SQF, BRC, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P.) as a condition of the relationship. Used for supplier and co-packer qualification management and food safety compliance monitoring.']
  globalg_ap_member_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the child account holds active GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification or membership. Relevant for cooperative member and co-packer relationships where GAP certification is a qualification criterion for agricultural commodity supply chain participation.']
  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'Numeric depth of the child account within the overall account hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate global parent. Used for multi-tier roll-up reporting, credit limit consolidation, and volume discount aggregation across food manufacturer enterprise account structures and cooperative grain marketing networks.']
  hierarchy_path varchar [note: 'Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from the ultimate global parent down to the child account in this relationship (e.g., \'/1001/1045/1089\'). Enables efficient subtree queries for network-level analysis of customer interdependencies in agricultural commodity trading without recursive joins.']
  last_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent periodic review of this inter-account relationship by the relationship manager or account governance team. Used for relationship health monitoring and scheduling of next review cycles.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this inter-account relationship. Drives CRM task generation and relationship manager workflow in Salesforce CRM.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or operational notes about this inter-account relationship that are not captured in structured fields. Examples include co-packer capacity constraints, cooperative grain marketing special terms, or broker-buyer exclusivity clauses.']
  ownership_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent account in the child account for parent_subsidiary relationship types. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 51.00 for 51%). Used for financial consolidation reporting under IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements and GAAP ASC 810.']
  primary_relationship_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the primary or dominant relationship for the child account when multiple parent relationships exist (True). Ensures unambiguous hierarchy resolution for credit consolidation, volume discount roll-up, and single-path reporting in multi-affiliation scenarios such as cooperative members who also belong to buying groups.']
  relationship_category varchar [note: 'Broad categorical grouping of the relationship for analytics and reporting segmentation. Distinguishes B2B enterprise corporate hierarchies from cooperative grain marketing networks, buying group affiliations, co-packer/toll processing partnerships, and distribution network linkages.']
  relationship_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric business code uniquely identifying this relationship record within the CRM and ERP systems (e.g., Salesforce Account Relationship ID or SAP SD Partner Function Code). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.']
  relationship_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates the directionality of the relationship between the two account parties. \'parent_to_child\' denotes a vertical downward link (e.g., global parent to regional subsidiary), \'child_to_parent\' denotes an upward reference, and \'lateral\' denotes a peer-to-peer affiliation (e.g., co-packer partnership, buying group membership at the same tier).']
  relationship_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive label for this inter-account relationship (e.g., \'AgriCorp Global — Midwest Grain Cooperative Membership\', \'FreshPack Co-Packer Agreement\'). Used in CRM displays, reporting dashboards, and relationship manager communications.']
  relationship_start_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason or event that initiated this inter-account relationship. Used for relationship lifecycle analytics, M&A integration tracking, and cooperative membership growth reporting.']
  relationship_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the inter-account relationship record. \'active\' indicates the relationship is in force; \'pending\' indicates awaiting approval or contract execution; \'suspended\' indicates temporarily halted; \'terminated\' indicates permanently ended.']
  relationship_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the inter-account relationship. Drives business rules for credit consolidation, volume discount aggregation, and reporting roll-ups. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent_subsidiary|cooperative_member|buying_group|co_packer|toll_processing|broker_buyer|franchise|distributor_affiliate — promote to reference product]']
  salesforce_relationship_code varchar [note: 'External system identifier for this relationship record as assigned by Salesforce CRM (15 or 18-character Salesforce ID). Used for bi-directional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the Salesforce CRM operational system of record.']
  sap_partner_function_code varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA SD partner function code that classifies the role of the child account in relation to the parent within SAP (e.g., \'AG\' for sold-to party, \'WE\' for ship-to party, \'RE\' for bill-to party, \'RG\' for payer). Enables ERP-aligned relationship classification for order processing and invoicing.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason for the termination or expiry of this inter-account relationship. Populated when relationship_status is \'terminated\'. Used for churn analysis, cooperative exit tracking, and M&A divestiture reporting.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'Sales territory or geographic region code associated with this account relationship. Used for territory-based sales reporting, relationship manager assignment, and regional agricultural market analysis aligned with USDA Agricultural Statistics Districts.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this account hierarchy relationship record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.']
  volume_discount_tier varchar [note: 'Pricing tier assigned to this relationship node for consolidated volume discount eligibility. Aggregated purchase volumes across the parent-child account group determine tier qualification. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD condition records for automatic pricing determination on agricultural commodity sales orders.']

  Note: 'Defines all inter-account relationships within the customer network — including parent-child corporate structures (global parent to regional subsidiary), cooperative membership networks, buying group affiliations, co-packer relationships, toll processing partnerships, broker-buyer relationships, and franchise networks. Captures both hierarchical (vertical) and lateral (peer-to-peer) relationships with relationship type, direction, hierarchy level, effective and expiry dates, contractual basis flag, hierarchy path, consolidation flag for enterprise-wide credit limit and volume discount aggregation, relationship manager, and both account party references. Supports multi-tier food manufacturer account structures, cooperative grain marketing networks, and network-level analysis of customer interdependencies critical for agricultural commodity trading. This is the single authoritative source (SSOT) for ALL inter-account relationships — vertical hierarchies, lateral affiliations, cooperative memberships, co-packer partnerships, and broker-buyer linkages. No other product in this domain models inter-account relationships.'
}

Table customer.address {
  address_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each address record associated with a customer account or contact. Serves as the primary key for the address entity in the customer domain Silver layer.']
  account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the customer account this address belongs to. Links the address record to the parent customer entity in the customer domain.']
  contact_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the individual contact person this address is associated with, when the address belongs to a specific contact rather than the overall account. Nullable for account-level addresses.']
  parent_address_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on address (parent_address_id)']
  address_source varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this address was originally sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution during master data management synchronization across Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, and Granular Farm Management.']
  address_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the functional purpose of the address. \'billing\' is the invoicing address; \'shipping\' is the delivery destination; \'registered\' is the legal business registration address; \'farm_gate\' is a pickup point at the farm; \'cold_storage\' is a refrigerated facility address; \'mailing\' is for general correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|shipping|registered|farm_gate|cold_storage|mailing|warehouse|processing_plant — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  city varchar [note: 'City, town, municipality, or locality name of the address. For rural agricultural addresses, may reference the nearest incorporated municipality.']
  cool_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code designating the country of origin for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance purposes. May differ from the physical address country for re-export or processing facility scenarios. Mandatory for USDA COOL compliance on covered commodities including beef, pork, lamb, chicken, fish, shellfish, perishable agricultural commodities, peanuts, pecans, ginseng, and macadamia nuts.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the address (e.g., \'USA\', \'CAN\', \'MEX\', \'BRA\'). Used for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, international shipping documentation (BOL, AWB), and FDA/USDA import/export regulatory reporting.']
  county varchar [note: 'County or parish name of the address. Critical for USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) county-level agricultural program eligibility, crop insurance administration, and state agricultural reporting. Also used for EPA and APHIS county-level regulatory compliance tracking.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under FSMA, GDPR, and SOX financial reporting controls.']
  delivery_instructions varchar [note: 'Free-text field for special delivery instructions specific to this address. Includes gate access codes, dock numbers, receiving hours, refrigeration requirements for cold chain deliveries, and farm-specific access directions not captured in structured address fields. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS and TMS delivery notes.']
  do_not_ship boolean [note: 'Indicates that shipments must not be dispatched to this address. May be set due to regulatory restrictions, customer request, failed delivery history, or compliance holds. Enforced during order fulfillment in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA SD.']
  duns_number varchar [note: 'Dun & Bradstreet DUNS (Data Universal Numbering System) nine-digit identifier for the business entity at this address. Used for supplier qualification, credit risk assessment, USDA program eligibility verification, and federal procurement compliance.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this address record is valid and effective for business use. Supports time-bounded address management for seasonal farm gate locations, temporary cold storage facilities, and lease-based distribution points.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Nullable for indefinitely active addresses. Used to manage seasonal farm gate closures, facility relocations, and lease expirations for distribution network addresses.']
  facility_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the type of physical facility at this address. Supports logistics planning, cold chain management, and regulatory compliance routing. \'farm\' indicates a production site; \'cold_storage\' indicates temperature-controlled facility relevant to food safety (FSMA, HACCP); \'cooperative\' indicates an agricultural cooperative location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: farm|warehouse|distribution_center|cold_storage|processing_plant|retail_store|office|cooperative|grain_elevator|packing_house — promote to reference product]']
  fips_code varchar [note: 'Five-digit FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) county code assigned by the U.S. Census Bureau. Used for USDA program administration, FSA county office routing, crop insurance mapping, and federal agricultural subsidy eligibility determination.']
  geocode_accuracy varchar [note: 'Precision level of the latitude/longitude geocoding result from Esri ArcGIS. \'rooftop\' indicates exact parcel-level match; \'range_interpolated\' is street-level interpolation; \'geometric_center\' is centroid of a polygon; \'approximate\' is postal code or city centroid; \'unverified\' means coordinates have not been validated.']
  gln varchar [note: 'GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) — a 13-digit identifier uniquely identifying this physical location in the global supply chain. Used for EDI transactions, traceability in food supply chains, GLOBALG.A.P. location registration, and GS1-compliant logistics documentation including BOL and ASN.']
  is_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this address record is currently active and usable for business operations. Inactive addresses are retained for historical audit and traceability but excluded from operational address selection for orders, invoices, and shipments.']
  is_primary boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is the primary address for the customer account or contact. Only one address per customer per address type should be flagged as primary. Used to determine the default address for billing, shipping, or correspondence when multiple addresses exist.']
  is_residential boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a residential address as opposed to a commercial or agricultural business address. Affects carrier surcharge calculations, delivery scheduling windows, and B2C vs B2B routing logic for direct-to-consumer agricultural product deliveries.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), sourced from Esri ArcGIS geocoding. Supports GIS-based spatial analysis, delivery route optimization via TMS, farm gate proximity calculations, and precision agriculture field mapping. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000.']
  line1 varchar [note: 'Primary street address line including street number and street name. For farm gate addresses, may include rural route or farm road designation.']
  line2 varchar [note: 'Secondary address line for suite, unit, building, floor, dock number, or additional location detail. Commonly used for distribution center dock numbers or warehouse unit identifiers.']
  line3 varchar [note: 'Tertiary address line for additional location detail such as industrial park name, complex name, or rural delivery instructions. Used primarily for international addresses requiring additional lines.']
  loading_dock_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a loading dock is available at this address for freight deliveries. Critical for logistics planning of bulk agricultural inputs (fertilizers, seeds, pesticides) and large-volume produce shipments requiring dock-height unloading.']
  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), sourced from Esri ArcGIS geocoding. Supports GIS-based spatial analysis, delivery route optimization, and proximity-based territory management. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000.']
  postal_code varchar [note: 'ZIP code or postal code for the address. Supports USPS ZIP+4 format for domestic addresses and international postal code formats. Used for delivery routing, sales territory assignment, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance zone mapping.']
  refrigeration_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether refrigerated or cold storage receiving capability is available at this address. Essential for cold chain compliance when delivering perishable agricultural commodities, fresh produce, dairy, and meat products per FSMA and HACCP requirements.']
  salesforce_address_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this address record in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Databricks Silver layer and Salesforce for sales pipeline management, partner relationship tracking, and customer account maintenance.']
  sap_address_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this address record in SAP S/4HANA Business Partner (BP) address management. Used for reconciliation between the enterprise ERP and the lakehouse Silver layer for billing, shipping, and procurement address data.']
  state_province varchar [note: 'State, province, territory, or administrative region of the address. Stored as ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., \'US-IA\' for Iowa, \'CA-ON\' for Ontario). Critical for USDA state-level agricultural reporting and regulatory compliance.']
  timezone varchar [note: 'IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., \'America/Chicago\', \'America/Los_Angeles\'). Used for scheduling delivery windows, coordinating harvest pickup times, and aligning order cutoff times across multi-timezone distribution networks.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this address record was last modified. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline and audit compliance under GDPR and SOX.']
  validation_date date [note: 'Date on which the address was last validated against postal authority databases or geocoding services. Used to schedule re-validation cycles and assess address data freshness for logistics and compliance purposes.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current validation status of the address record against postal authority databases. \'validated\' confirms the address is deliverable per USPS CASS certification or international equivalent; \'unvalidated\' has not been checked; \'invalid\' failed validation; \'pending_review\' requires manual verification. Critical for ensuring delivery accuracy for agricultural inputs and produce shipments.']

  Note: 'Physical and mailing addresses associated with customer accounts and contacts — including billing addresses, shipping/delivery locations, farm gate pickup points, cold storage facility addresses, and registered business addresses. Stores address type (billing, shipping, registered, farm gate), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude from Esri ArcGIS), COOL country of origin code, address validation status, and primary address flag. Supports multi-location customers such as retail chains and distribution networks.'
}

Table customer.segment {

  commodity_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Agriculture customer segments are defined by commodity focus (grain buyers, produce buyers, livestock processors). Segment-based pricing tiers, campaign targeting, and agronomic service tier assignmen']
  parent_segment_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on segment (parent_segment_id)']
  payment_term_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: Customer segments in agriculture define tier-level payment terms (e.g., cooperative members get harvest deferral). Replacing denormalized payment_terms_code with a FK to payment_term enables segment-d']
  account_manager_pool varchar [note: 'Name or code of the designated account manager team or pool responsible for accounts in this segment (e.g., Enterprise Ag Sales Team, Export Markets Group, Cooperative Relations Team). Used for Salesforce CRM territory assignment and SAP SuccessFactors workforce planning.']
  agronomic_service_tier varchar [note: 'Level of agronomic advisory and technical support services allocated to accounts in this segment. PREMIUM = dedicated agronomist, field visits, VRA prescriptions; STANDARD = shared agronomist pool, periodic consultations; BASIC = self-service digital tools only; NONE = no agronomic services provided.']
  assignment_method varchar [note: 'Method by which customer accounts are assigned to this segment. MANUAL = assigned by account manager or sales operations; RULE_BASED = automatically assigned based on defined criteria (revenue band, geography, certification); ML_SCORED = assigned via machine learning scoring model based on behavioral and transactional data.']
  campaign_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether accounts assigned to this segment are eligible for Salesforce CRM marketing campaigns and targeted outreach programs. True = eligible for campaign inclusion; False = excluded from campaign targeting (e.g., inactive or archived segments).']
  cool_labeling_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) documentation and labeling compliance is required for products supplied to accounts in this segment. Mandatory for retail and export segments under USDA COOL regulations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this customer segment record was first created in the Agriculture data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.']
  credit_limit_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Default credit limit in USD applied to accounts assigned to this segment. Used as the baseline credit exposure threshold in SAP S/4HANA FI credit management (FD32) and Oracle NetSuite AR. Individual account credit limits may override this segment-level default.']
  crm_segment_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this segment as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Agriculture data platform (Silver Layer) and Salesforce CRM for pipeline targeting and account management. Null if not yet synchronized.']

  globalg_ap_cert_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification is a mandatory requirement for customer accounts assigned to this segment. True = certification required for onboarding and retention; False = certification not mandated.']
  gmo_preference varchar [note: 'Segment-level GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) supply preference governing product catalog eligibility and sourcing requirements. GMO_ACCEPTED = standard supply accepted; NON_GMO_REQUIRED = non-GMO verified supply mandatory; NO_PREFERENCE = no restriction applied.']
  incoterms_code varchar [note: 'Default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) applicable to sales transactions for accounts in this segment. Governs risk transfer and freight responsibility. Particularly relevant for export distributor segments. Drives SAP SD delivery and billing document configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  last_reviewed_date date [note: 'Date on which this segment definition was most recently reviewed and validated by the sales operations or data governance team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale segment definitions requiring refresh.']
  max_segment_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum ML-derived or rule-based score threshold (0.00–100.00) defining the upper bound for account assignment to this segment. Null indicates no upper bound (e.g., top-tier strategic segment). Used with min_segment_score to define the qualifying score range.']
  min_segment_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum ML-derived or rule-based score threshold (0.00–100.00) required for a customer account to qualify for assignment to this segment. Used in conjunction with max_segment_score to define the score band for this segment.']
  ml_model_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the ML scoring model used when assignment_method is ML_SCORED. Enables reproducibility, model governance, and audit traceability for AI-driven segment assignments. Null when assignment_method is MANUAL or RULE_BASED.']
  organic_cert_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification is required for accounts in this segment. Applies to organic produce buyers and specialty food manufacturers requiring certified organic supply.']
  pricing_tier_code varchar [note: 'SAP SD pricing condition tier code applicable to all accounts assigned to this segment (e.g., PT-GOLD, PT-SILVER, PT-STANDARD). Drives price list determination, volume discount schedules, and contract pricing in SAP S/4HANA SD module.']
  revenue_band_max_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum annual revenue threshold (in USD) for a customer account to qualify for this segment. Null indicates no upper bound (e.g., for the highest-tier strategic segment). Used in conjunction with revenue_band_min_usd for rule-based segment assignment.']
  revenue_band_min_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Minimum annual revenue threshold (in USD) for a customer account to qualify for this segment. Used as a rule-based assignment criterion alongside revenue_band_max_usd. Supports SAP SD pricing tier determination and Salesforce CRM pipeline segmentation.']

  gfsi_audit_relevant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this case is relevant for inclusion in GFSI audit documentation and customer complaint trend analysis. True for cases involving food safety, quality, or regulatory compliance issues that must be reported during GFSI certification audits.']
  haccp_corrective_action_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this case has triggered a formal HACCP corrective action record in the quality management system. True when the case involves a food safety hazard requiring documented corrective action per HACCP protocols.']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'The human-readable batch or lot number (LOT) of the commodity or product referenced in this case, as printed on packaging or shipping documents. Supports FSMA traceability and HACCP corrective action tracking.']
  mrl_exceedance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this case involves a claim or confirmed finding of pesticide or chemical residue exceeding the Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) as regulated by the EPA and FDA. Triggers regulatory notification workflows.']
  opened_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the customer case was officially opened and entered into the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for SLA calculation and regulatory traceability.']
  origin_channel varchar [note: 'The communication channel through which the customer submitted the case (e.g., email, phone, web portal, EDI). Supports channel analytics and customer experience reporting.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Business priority level assigned to the case, determining SLA targets and escalation thresholds. Critical cases typically involve food safety risks such as MRL exceedances or HACCP corrective actions.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'The customer\'s Purchase Order (PO) number associated with the transaction or shipment referenced in this case. Links the case to the commercial transaction for dispute resolution and credit processing.']
  regulatory_body_notified varchar [note: 'Identifies the specific regulatory authority notified in connection with this case when regulatory_notification_flag is True. Supports compliance audit trails and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|USDA|EPA|FSIS|APHIS|OSHA|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  regulatory_notification_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a regulatory authority (FDA, USDA, EPA, FSIS, or APHIS) has been notified about this case. Required for food safety incidents, MRL exceedances, and FSMA mandatory reporting events.']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the corrective action taken and resolution provided to the customer, including any product replacements, credits, process changes, or regulatory notifications made.']
  resolution_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of how the case was resolved (e.g., product replacement, credit memo issued, corrective action implemented, regulatory escalation). Supports resolution trend analytics and GFSI audit reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: replacement|credit_memo|refund|corrective_action|information_provided|no_action|escalated_to_regulator — promote to reference product]']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Categorized root cause of the customer issue as determined during case investigation. Supports HACCP corrective action tracking, trend analysis, and GFSI audit readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: packaging_defect|contamination|mrl_exceedance|labeling_error|transport_damage|storage_failure|documentation_error|other — promote to reference product]']
  root_cause_detail varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative providing detailed explanation of the identified root cause, including contributing factors, investigation findings, and supporting evidence. Complements the root_cause_category with granular context.']
  salesforce_case_code varchar [note: 'The native Salesforce CRM case record identifier (15 or 18 character Salesforce ID) for this case. Enables bidirectional integration between the lakehouse silver layer and Salesforce CRM for sales pipeline and partner management.']
  sap_qm_notification_number varchar [note: 'The SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM) module notification number linked to this case when a formal quality notification has been raised. Supports cross-system traceability between customer-facing cases and internal QM processes.']
  sla_actual_hours varchar [note: 'The actual number of hours taken to resolve this case from opening to closure. Compared against sla_target_hours to determine SLA compliance and populate the sla_breach_flag.']
  sla_breach_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this case breached the agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA) response or resolution time. True when the case was not resolved within the contracted SLA window. Supports KPI reporting and customer satisfaction management.']
  sla_target_hours varchar [note: 'The contracted SLA target resolution time in hours for this case, determined by case priority and customer account tier. Used to calculate SLA compliance and breach status.']
  subject varchar [note: 'Brief, human-readable title or subject line summarizing the nature of the customer case, used for quick identification in case lists and dashboards.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Audit timestamp recording when this case record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing.']

  Note: 'Customer service and support case records capturing complaints, quality disputes, delivery issues, COA (Certificate of Analysis) discrepancies, MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) exceedance claims, FSMA traceability requests, and general inquiries raised by food manufacturers, distributors, and retail customers. Stores case number, case type, priority, status, associated account and contact, commodity lot (LOT) reference, COA reference, root cause category, resolution description, SLA breach flag, and Salesforce CRM case ID. Supports HACCP corrective action tracking and GFSI audit readiness. Owned by the customer domain as the SSOT for customer-facing service interactions — distinct from the quality domain\'s non-conformance records which track internal production quality events, and distinct from the sales domain\'s order dispute records which track commercial transaction disputes.'
}

  preference_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this COOL preference record. \'active\' indicates the record is in force; \'pending_review\' indicates it is under compliance review; \'suspended\' indicates a temporary hold pending regulatory clarification.']
  preferred_origin_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customer\'s single most preferred country of origin for the specified commodity when a preference ranking is required (e.g., \'USA\' for domestically sourced product).']
  regulatory_notification_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether USDA or other regulatory bodies must be formally notified in the event of a COOL compliance breach for this customer and commodity. True = regulatory notification is mandatory; False = internal resolution only.']
  restricted_origin_countries varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing countries of origin that this customer explicitly prohibits for the specified commodity. Supports compliance screening and order validation workflows.']
  salesforce_record_code varchar [note: 'The corresponding record identifier in Salesforce CRM for this COOL preference record, enabling bidirectional synchronization between the lakehouse and the CRM system of record for customer relationship management.']
  supplier_affidavit_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this customer requires a signed supplier affidavit attesting to the country of origin for each commodity lot delivered. True = affidavit required per shipment or lot; False = not required. Supports USDA COOL audit trail requirements.']

Supports FSMA Section 204 traceability lot code requirements and integration with Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA QM.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this COOL preference record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and compliance review workflows.']

  Note: 'Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) preference and compliance record for customer accounts — particularly food manufacturers, retailers, and distributors subject to USDA COOL regulations. Captures required origin countries per commodity type, labeling format preference (full origin, mixed origin, derived from), COOL audit frequency, last COOL compliance review date, acceptable origin country list, restricted origin country list, and COOL documentation requirement flag. Directly supports USDA COOL regulatory compliance for agricultural commodity sales.'

Table customer.consent_record {
  consent_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each consent record. Primary key for the consent_record data product within the customer domain.']
  account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the customer account (B2B food manufacturer, distributor, wholesaler, retailer, cooperative) or B2C individual buyer for whom this consent record applies. Links to customer.account.']
  contact_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific individual contact person within the account who provided or withdrew consent. Applicable for B2B accounts where consent is captured at the contact level.']
  parent_consent_record_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on consent_record (parent_consent_record_id)']
  preference_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to customer.preference. Business justification: Consent records govern the legal basis for acting on customer preferences — e.g., a marketing opt-in consent record authorizes the corresponding communication preference, or a COOL data processing con']
  privacy_notice_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific privacy notice or consent notice document that was presented to the data subject at the time of consent collection. Links to the privacy notice repository for audit and compliance purposes.']
  regulatory_change_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Business justification: Customer consent records (GDPR, CCPA, FSMA traceability consent) are created or updated in response to regulatory changes. Linking consent_record to regulatory_change documents which regulation drove ']
  ccpa_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) applies to this consent record (True), based on the data subject being a California resident. Relevant for US domestic agricultural operations serving California-based food manufacturers and consumers.']
  channel varchar [note: 'The specific communication channel for which consent is being granted or managed. Distinct from collection_method — this represents the channel the data subject is consenting TO receive communications through (e.g., email marketing, SMS alerts for crop advisory, postal mail for regulatory notices).']
  collection_method varchar [note: 'The mechanism through which consent was collected from the data subject. Includes digital web forms (e.g., Salesforce CRM portal), signed physical or electronic documents, verbal consent with a recording reference, email confirmation links, API-based integrations, or paper-based forms used in field operations.']
  consent_date timestamp [note: 'The exact date and timestamp when the data subject granted consent. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent lifecycle and is critical for GDPR audit trails and consent validity calculations.']
  consent_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the consent record. \'granted\' indicates active consent; \'withdrawn\' indicates the data subject has revoked consent; \'pending\' indicates consent request sent but not yet responded to; \'expired\' indicates consent has lapsed past its validity period; \'refused\' indicates the data subject explicitly declined.']
  consent_type varchar [note: 'Category of consent being recorded. Covers marketing email communications, SMS marketing, data sharing with logistics partners (e.g., TMS/WMS providers), agronomic advisory communications, third-party analytics sharing, and customer profiling activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_email|marketing_sms|data_sharing_logistics|agronomic_advisory|third_party_analytics|profiling — promote to reference product]']
  consent_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the consent notice or privacy policy under which consent was collected (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables tracking of consent obtained under different versions of privacy notices, which is critical when privacy policy updates require re-consent.']
  cool_preference_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the customer has provided consent for sharing Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) data with downstream supply chain partners (True). Relevant for agricultural commodity traceability and compliance with USDA COOL regulations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and timestamp when this consent record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is immutable after initial record creation. Aligns with GDPR accountability requirements.']
  data_retention_period_days varchar [note: 'The number of days for which personal data processed under this consent will be retained after consent withdrawal or expiry. Supports GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation compliance and automated data deletion workflows.']
  data_subject_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the data subject whose consent is being recorded. Distinguishes between individual B2C consumers, B2B business contacts (food manufacturers, distributors, retailers), employees, supplier contacts, and cooperative members — each subject to different regulatory obligations.']
  document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or document number for the signed physical or electronic consent document. Applicable when collection_method is \'signed_document\' or \'paper_form\'. Enables retrieval of the original signed consent artifact for audit purposes.']
  double_opt_in_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a double opt-in confirmation process was completed (True), where the data subject confirmed their consent via a secondary verification step (e.g., email confirmation link). Double opt-in provides stronger evidence of consent validity for marketing communications.']
  double_opt_in_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and timestamp when the data subject completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides audit evidence for the confirmation event.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed. Supports time-limited consent policies required for GDPR compliance and internal data governance standards. Null for open-ended consents that do not have a defined expiry.']
  fsma_traceability_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent record is associated with data processing required for FSMA Section 204 food traceability compliance (True). FSMA traceability data sharing may have a separate legal basis (legal obligation) distinct from marketing consent.']
  gdpr_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GDPR applies to this consent record (True) based on the data subject\'s jurisdiction and the nature of data processing. Critical for international agricultural trade operations where EU/EEA customers are involved.']
  ip_address varchar [note: 'IP address of the device from which consent was submitted via a web form or digital channel. Captured as evidence of consent origin for GDPR audit purposes. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.']
  jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or regional code (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, EU). Determines which privacy regulation governs the consent (e.g., GDPR for EU/EEA, CCPA for California, PIPEDA for Canada). Critical for international agricultural trade operations.']
  legal_basis varchar [note: 'The lawful basis under which personal data is processed as defined by GDPR Article 6. For international agricultural trade operations, this determines whether processing relies on explicit consent, contractual necessity (e.g., FSMA traceability obligations), legal obligation (e.g., USDA/FDA reporting), or legitimate interest.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes or context related to this consent record, such as special handling instructions, compliance officer annotations, or details about unusual consent collection circumstances.']
  opt_in_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the consent was obtained through an affirmative opt-in action (True) versus a pre-ticked box or implied consent mechanism (False). GDPR requires explicit opt-in for consent to be valid; this flag supports compliance validation and audit.']
  purpose_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the specific data processing purpose for which consent was obtained. Provides granular detail beyond the consent_type classification, such as \'Sharing harvest yield data with logistics partner for route optimization\' or \'Sending weekly agronomic advisory newsletters on IPM practices\'.']
  recording_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the audio recording or call log where verbal consent was captured. Applicable when collection_method is \'verbal_recording\'. Links to the call recording system for audit retrieval. Null for non-verbal consent collection methods.']
  renewal_reminder_sent_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a consent renewal reminder communication has been sent to the data subject prior to expiry (True) or not yet sent (False). Supports consent lifecycle management workflows.']
  renewal_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent record requires active renewal before the expiry_date (True) or is open-ended without a renewal requirement (False). Drives automated consent renewal workflows and customer communications in Salesforce CRM.']
  salesforce_consent_code varchar [note: 'External identifier for this consent record in Salesforce CRM, which serves as the operational system of record for customer management and sales pipeline. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and Salesforce for consent status updates.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this consent record originated. Salesforce CRM is the primary source for customer consent management; SAP S/4HANA may originate consents related to procurement or supplier data sharing; web portal and mobile app cover direct digital channels.']
  third_party_category varchar [note: 'Category of the third party involved in data sharing under this consent. Supports GDPR Article 13 disclosure requirements and enables analytics on consent patterns by partner type across the agricultural supply chain.']
  third_party_name varchar [note: 'Name of the third-party organization with whom data will be shared under this consent, if applicable. Relevant for consents covering data sharing with logistics partners (TMS/WMS providers), agronomic advisory services, or market data providers (e.g., DTN). Null for consents that do not involve third-party data sharing.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and timestamp when this consent record was last modified. Tracks any updates to consent status, withdrawal, or metadata. Essential for GDPR audit trails and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  user_agent varchar [note: 'Browser or application user agent string captured at the time of digital consent submission. Provides technical evidence of the device and browser environment used during consent collection, supporting GDPR accountability requirements.']
  withdrawal_date timestamp [note: 'The date and timestamp when the data subject withdrew their previously granted consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Upon withdrawal, all downstream data processing activities relying on this consent must cease per GDPR Article 7(3).']
  withdrawal_method varchar [note: 'The mechanism through which the data subject withdrew their consent. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn.']
  withdrawal_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or categorized reason provided by the data subject for withdrawing consent. Supports customer relationship management, compliance reporting, and analysis of consent withdrawal patterns to improve data practices.']

  Note: 'Tracks customer and contact consent for data processing, marketing communications, and third-party data sharing in compliance with GDPR (for international operations) and applicable US privacy regulations. Captures consent type (marketing email, SMS, data sharing with logistics partners, agronomic advisory communications), consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent date, withdrawal date, consent collection method (web form, signed document, verbal with recording reference), and data processing legal basis. Essential for GDPR-compliant international agricultural trade operations.'
}

  Note: 'This association product represents the Procurement Agreement (Contract) between a customer account and an agricultural commodity. Replaces the denormalized preferred_commodity_categories string field on the account record.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity trading, a buyer account actively purchases and maintains procurement relationships with multiple commodities (e.g., a food manufacturer buys corn, soybeans, and wheat), and each commodity is purchased by many different accounts. This relationship is operationally managed as a named business concept — a \'Commodity Preference\' or \'Procurement Agreement\' — with its own attributes including volume commitments, pricing tiers, GMO/organic requirements, and effective date ranges that belong to neither the account nor the commodity alone.'

  opt_out_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether customers have the option to opt out of the data practices described in this notice.']

  publication_url varchar [note: 'Web URL where the full privacy notice is published and accessible to customers.']
  regulatory_framework varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory or compliance framework this notice supports (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA, LGPD, HIPAA).']
  retention_period_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of how long data is retained under this notice (e.g., \'7 years from last transaction\', \'duration of customer relationship plus 2 years\').']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the privacy notice.']
  third_party_sharing boolean [note: 'Indicates whether customer data may be shared with third parties under this privacy notice.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Semantic version number of the privacy notice (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1) to track revisions and updates.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for privacy_notice. Referenced by privacy_notice_id.'
}
