  Note: 'Daily or intraday commodity market price reference sourced from DTN, CME futures, WASDE reports, and local elevator bids — capturing commodity code, price date, price type (cash, futures, basis, FOB, CIF), market location or exchange, unit of measure, bid/ask/settlement values, crop year, and data source.   primary_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Primary telephone number for the broker contact. Used for urgent sales negotiations, logistics coordination, and commission payment inquiries.']
  relationship_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the broker relationship with the enterprise. Controls whether the broker can be assigned to new sales orders, contracts, or commission transactions. Managed in Salesforce CRM partner lifecycle workflow.']
  salesforce_partner_code varchar [note: 'External system identifier linking this broker master record to the corresponding partner account record in Salesforce CRM.   Note: 'Master record for agricultural commodity brokers and independent sales agents who act as intermediaries in the sales channel. Includes commission transaction management: calculation rules, earned amounts per sales order/contract, payment status, settlement periods, and commission history. Brokers facilitate transactions between the enterprise and buyers but are neither customers nor suppliers. SSOT for broker identity, performance, and commission lifecycle.'

  Note: 'Seasonal and forward-looking demand forecast for agricultural commodities by customer segment, channel, and geography. Drives sales planning, inventory pre-positioning, and contract negotiation strategy.'

  export_zone varchar [note: 'Designated export zone or international trade region for territories covering cross-border agricultural commodity sales (e.g., \'NAFTA\', \'EU\', \'Asia-Pacific\'). Relevant for FOB/CIF pricing terms and export compliance under USDA APHIS and FDA regulations.']
  fsma_compliance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) compliance requirements apply to sales activities in this territory, particularly for territories covering food manufacturers and processors subject to FSMA Produce Safety Rule and Preventive Controls.']
  gis_boundary_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or URL to the GIS boundary layer in Esri ArcGIS that defines the precise geographic polygon of this territory.   globalg_ap_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification is required for customers or products sold within this territory. Relevant for export territories and territories serving European retail chains with GLOBALG.A.P. mandates.']
  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'Numeric level of this territory within the sales territory hierarchy (e.g., 1=National, 2=Regional, 3=District, 4=Local). Supports hierarchical roll-up reporting and quota cascading.']
  incoterms varchar [note: 'Standard trade terms (Incoterms) governing delivery responsibility and risk transfer for sales in this territory. FOB (Free On Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight) are most common in agricultural commodity export territories. Drives BOL generation and logistics cost allocation.']
  is_export_territory boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this territory covers international/export sales. When true, additional export compliance requirements apply including USDA APHIS phytosanitary certificates, FDA prior notice, and COOL labeling obligations.']
  last_realignment_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent territory boundary or assignment realignment. Tracks when the territory was last restructured for sales force optimization, market coverage adjustments, or organizational changes.']
  market_penetration_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Estimated percentage of the addressable market within this territory currently served by the company. Calculated as current customer base acreage divided by total farmland acres. Used for strategic market coverage planning and sales force sizing.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, strategic context, or special instructions relevant to managing this territory (e.g., seasonal access restrictions, key account relationships, competitive landscape notes).']
  pricing_strategy varchar [note: 'Primary pricing strategy applied to sales within this territory. \'spot\' = current market price; \'forward\' = pre-agreed future delivery price; \'futures_linked\' = price tied to CBOT/CME futures contracts via DTN feed; \'contract\' = fixed-price annual contract; \'negotiated\' = case-by-case negotiation.']
  region varchar [note: 'Broad geographic sales region to which this territory belongs (e.g., \'Midwest\', \'Southeast\', \'Great Plains\', \'Pacific Northwest\', \'International\'). Used for regional roll-up reporting and management hierarchy.']
  sap_distribution_channel varchar [note: 'Two-character SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel code for this territory. Determines pricing procedures, order types, and delivery conditions applicable to sales transactions originating from this territory.']
  sap_sales_org_code varchar [note: 'Four-character SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization code associated with this territory. Aligns the territory to the SAP organizational structure for pricing, order management, and revenue reporting.']
  state_province varchar [note: 'State or province code(s) covered by this territory (e.g., \'IA\', \'IL\', \'MN\'). May contain a comma-separated list for multi-state territories. Used for geographic coverage mapping in Esri ArcGIS and regulatory jurisdiction alignment.']
  territory_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the sales territory, used in SAP S/4HANA SD and Salesforce CRM for cross-system reference and reporting. Serves as the business identifier for the territory across operational systems.']
  territory_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the territory\'s geographic scope, customer segments covered, and strategic purpose within the sales organization.']
  territory_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the sales territory (e.g., \'Midwest Grain Belt\', \'Southeast Poultry Region\'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and sales force alignment communications.']
  territory_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the sales territory. \'active\' indicates the territory is currently assigned and operational; \'inactive\' indicates it has been decommissioned; \'pending\' indicates it is being set up; \'suspended\' indicates temporarily paused coverage.']
  territory_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the territory by its primary segmentation basis — geographic (state/county boundary), customer segment (large grower, cooperative, distributor), commodity focus, distribution channel, or export zone. Drives sales force alignment strategy.']
  total_farmland_acres decimal(14,2) [note: 'Total estimated farmland acreage within the territory boundary. Sourced from USDA FSA records and Esri ArcGIS land mapping. Used for market penetration analysis, yield potential estimation (YPM), and variable rate application (VRA) planning.']

  Note: 'Sales territory master defining geographic and customer-segment-based sales coverage areas — capturing territory code, territory name, geographic boundaries (state, county, region, export zone), assigned sales representative, commodity focus, channel coverage, annual volume target, and active status. Supports sales force alignment, performance tracking, and market coverage planning.'

Table sales.contract_certification_verification {
  contract_certification_verification_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the contract_certification_verification association']
  certification_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the specific customer certification record that was verified against the contract requirement.']
  sales_contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the sales contract whose certification requirement this verification satisfies.']
  verified_by_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the internal compliance officer or trade documentation specialist who performed the certification verification. Provides audit trail accountability for the verification event.']
  cert_type_required varchar [note: 'The specific certification type that the contract mandates (e.g., GLOBALG.A.P., FSMA, USDA Organic NOP, ISCC). Captures which of the contract\'s certification obligations this verification record addresses, since a single contract may require multiple cert types verified separately.']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'The outcome of the verification: whether the certification record was deemed to fully satisfy, conditionally satisfy, or fail to satisfy the contract\'s certification requirement at the time of verification. Belongs to the verification event.']
  verification_date date [note: 'The date on which the compliance officer verified that the certification record satisfies the contract\'s certification requirement. Belongs to the verification event, not to the cert record or the contract alone.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Verification Event between a customer certification_record and a sales contract. It captures the operational compliance-verification process by which a specific certification is confirmed as satisfying a specific contract\'s certification requirements. Each record links one certification_record to one contract and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this verification: when it was verified, by whom, what certification type was required by the contract, and whether the certification was deemed compliant. Critical for GFSI-aligned supply chain qualification, FSMA audit trails, and GLOBALG.A.P. contract compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity trading, a single sales contract routinely requires multiple certifications (e.g., GLOBALG.A.P. + FSMA + Organic NOP simultaneously), and a single certification record (e.g., a buyer\'s USDA Organic certificate) can satisfy compliance requirements across multiple contracts within its validity period. The business actively manages which certifications have been verified against which contracts, tracking verification date, compliance status, and the specific cert type required by each contract — this is an operational compliance-verification process, not a derived analytical correlation.'
}

  bol_number varchar [note: 'Bill of Lading number associated with the shipment of the commodity billed on this line. Provides logistics traceability and supports freight reconciliation and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance.']
  contract_number varchar [note: 'Reference to the underlying sales or forward contract (grain marketing contract, livestock purchase agreement, or service agreement) that governs the pricing and terms for this invoice line.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD, BRL). Completes the MONETARY_TRIPLET currency dimension. Typically USD for domestic US agricultural transactions.']
  delivery_date date [note: 'Date on which the commodity, livestock, or service was delivered or performed, establishing the revenue recognition trigger date per GAAP ASC 606 / IFRS 15 performance obligation satisfaction.']
  discount_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total discount or price reduction applied to this line item, expressed in the invoice currency. Includes trade discounts, volume rebates, quality deductions, and dockage adjustments for commodity grading deficiencies.']
  dockage_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage deduction applied to the billed quantity for foreign material, moisture excess, or quality deficiencies per USDA grain inspection standards. Drives quantity and price adjustments on the invoice line.']
  futures_contract_ref varchar [note: 'CME/CBOT futures contract month and symbol used as the pricing reference for this line when pricing_basis is \'futures\' or \'formula\' (e.g., \'ZC-DEC24\' for December 2024 Corn futures). Null when pricing_basis is spot or contract.']
  gross_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross billed amount for this line before discounts and adjustments, calculated as quantity × unit_price. Expressed in the invoice currency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for revenue recognition.']
  is_gmo boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commodity billed on this line contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for labeling compliance under USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard and export documentation.']
  is_organic_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commodity billed on this line is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Affects pricing premiums, labeling requirements, and COA documentation.']
  is_taxable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this invoice line item is subject to sales tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes. Drives tax calculation logic in SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite Tax modules.']
  line_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the commodity, crop product, livestock, or service being billed on this line (e.g., \'Yellow Corn No. 2 - Harvest 2024\', \'Feeder Cattle - 500-600 lb\', \'Custom Application Service\').']
  line_number varchar [note: 'Sequential position of this line item within the parent invoice. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-line invoices. Satisfies LINE_SEQUENCE category.']
  line_status varchar [note: 'Current processing status of this invoice line item within the AR lifecycle. Drives workflow routing, dispute management, and revenue recognition timing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|billed|disputed|cancelled|credited|settled — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]']
  line_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the invoice line item indicating whether it represents a commodity sale, livestock transaction, service charge, freight, storage, handling fee, penalty, or credit memo. Drives revenue recognition category assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commodity|livestock|service|freight|storage|handling|penalty|credit_memo — promote to reference product]']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Batch or lot number identifying the specific production lot of the commodity or product billed. Enables traceability from invoice line back to field harvest, processing batch, or animal group per FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.']
  moisture_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Moisture content percentage of the grain or commodity at time of delivery/billing. Used to calculate moisture dockage adjustments and shrinkage deductions applied to the billed quantity and price.']
  net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net billed amount for this line after discounts and before tax, calculated as gross_amount minus discount_amount. Represents the taxable base for this line. Satisfies LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT and MONETARY_TRIPLET categories.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the commodity billed, required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance under USDA Agricultural Marketing Act.']
  purchase_order_number varchar [note: 'Customer\'s purchase order number referencing this invoice line. Required for three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite procurement workflows.']
  quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'Quantity of the commodity, livestock, or service units billed on this line. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in uom. Satisfies LINE_QUANTITY category. For grain: bushels (BU); for livestock: head; for bulk commodities: metric tons (MT) or hundredweight (CWT).']
  revenue_category varchar [note: 'Revenue recognition category assigned to this line for GL posting and financial reporting under GAAP ASC 606 / IFRS 15. Drives the revenue account mapping in SAP S/4HANA CO module and Oracle NetSuite GL.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Tax amount assessed on this line item (sales tax, VAT, excise tax, or agricultural levy), expressed in the invoice currency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.']
  test_weight decimal(7,2) [note: 'Test weight of the grain commodity in pounds per bushel (lb/BU) as measured at delivery. A key quality parameter affecting grade assignment and price adjustments for corn, soybeans, wheat, and other grains.']
  unit_price decimal(18,6) [note: 'Price per unit of measure for this line item. Expressed in the invoice currency. May reflect spot market price, futures-based contract price, or negotiated contract price depending on pricing_basis.']
  uom varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the billed quantity. Agricultural-standard units include BU (Bushel), CWT (Hundredweight), MT (Metric Ton), LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), HEAD (livestock count), TON (short ton), GAL (gallon), L (liter), ACRE, EA (each for services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|KG|HEAD|TON|GAL|L|ACRE|EA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this invoice line record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, dispute resolution, and SOX audit requirements.']
  weight_ticket_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number of the scale/weight ticket used to verify the quantity of grain or bulk commodity billed on this line. Critical for weight-ticket reconciliation in agricultural commodity billing. Links to the physical scale ticket from the elevator or processing facility.']

  Note: 'Line-item detail for each AR invoice, representing individual commodity lots, crop products, livestock, or service charges billed. Captures line number, commodity code, crop/livestock description, quantity (BU, CWT, MT, head), unit of measure, unit price, pricing basis (spot, futures, contract), gross amount, discount, net amount, tax amount, GLN/lot reference, weight-ticket reference, and revenue recognition category. Supports commodity-based pricing and weight-ticket reconciliation per agricultural billing standards.'
}

  payment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment by its business purpose and timing relative to the invoice. \'standard\' = payment against an existing invoice; \'advance\' = prepayment before invoice issuance (crop pre-purchase, seed advance, input supply advance); \'deposit\' = security or storage deposit; \'installment\' = partial payment under a deferred or seasonal payment plan.']

  value_date date [note: 'The bank value date on which funds are credited to the company\'s account. May differ from payment_date for wire transfers and ACH batches. Critical for accurate cash position reporting and bank reconciliation.']

Specific to agricultural commodity billing where payment is based on scale-verified weight at elevator or processing facility.']

  term_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the payment term configuration, as defined in SAP S/4HANA FI/SD module (e.g., NET30, DEFGRAIN90, LSTK45). Used on invoices, sales orders, and purchase orders for term lookup.']
  term_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the payment term, including applicable conditions, seasonal rules, commodity restrictions, and any special settlement provisions relevant to agricultural billing scenarios.']

  term_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the payment term configuration. Inactive or deprecated terms are retained for historical invoice reference but cannot be assigned to new transactions.']
  term_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment term by its structural type. Supports agricultural-specific types including deferred seasonal programs (post-harvest grain payment windows), commodity-price-based settlement, and livestock consignment settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_net|early_payment_discount|deferred_seasonal|installment|consignment_settlement|commodity_price_based|prepayment — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment term configuration record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.']
  weight_ticket_reconciliation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether payment under this term requires reconciliation against a weight ticket (scale ticket) before the invoice due date is triggered.   Note: 'Reference master defining payment term configurations applicable to agricultural billing including standard net terms, seasonal deferred payment programs, and commodity-specific settlement schedules. Captures term code, term description, net days, discount days, early payment discount percentage, seasonal deferral rules (e.g., post-harvest payment windows), installment schedule flag, installment count, and applicable commodity types.   pricing_method varchar [note: 'The method used to determine the commodity price for invoice calculations.   seasonal_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this price basis is seasonal in nature (True) or applies year-round (False). Seasonal bases are common in grain marketing where harvest-time basis levels differ significantly from pre-harvest or post-harvest periods.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The originating operational system from which this price basis record was sourced (e.g., SAP_SD for SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution pricing conditions, GRANULAR for Granular Farm Management, DTN for DTN market data feed). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  standard_moisture_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The reference moisture percentage at which no moisture adjustment is applied (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13.0% for soybeans). Moisture readings from weight tickets above this level trigger discounts; below may trigger premiums per the moisture_adjustment_rate.']
  standard_test_weight_lbs decimal(5,2) [note: 'The reference test weight in pounds per bushel at which no test weight adjustment is applied (e.g., 56 lbs/BU for corn, 60 lbs/BU for soybeans, 60 lbs/BU for wheat). Deviations from this standard trigger price adjustments per test_weight_adjustment_rate.']
  test_weight_adjustment_rate decimal(6,4) [note: 'The per-unit price adjustment applied per pound below the standard test weight (e.g., -0.01 USD/BU per pound below 56 lbs/BU for corn). Test weight is a key quality factor in grain pricing that affects invoice amounts.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit of measure against which the basis amount is applied (e.g., BU for bushel in grain, CWT for hundredweight in livestock, MT for metric ton in export contracts). Aligns with USDA and exchange standard units for the commodity type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|TON|KG|OZ — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this price basis record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']

  Note: 'Reference table defining commodity pricing bases used in agricultural invoice calculations including futures-based pricing, basis contracts, spot pricing, and formula pricing. Captures basis code, commodity type (corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton, cattle, hogs), pricing method (CBOT futures, CME futures, spot market, DTN market data, WASDE-referenced), basis amount (premium/discount over futures), effective date, expiry date, delivery location, and applicable contract types. Essential for accurate commodity invoice pricing in grain and livestock billing.'

Supports reconciliation between the financing batch and the underlying invoice pool, particularly relevant for agricultural commodity trading where multiple weight-ticket-backed invoices may be bundled.']
  factoring_fee_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total fee charged by the financing institution for the receivable financing service. Includes service fees, discount charges, and any other financing costs. Recognized as a financing cost in the income statement per GAAP ASC 860 and IFRS 9.']
  factoring_fee_rate_pct decimal(7,6) [note: 'The fee rate applied to the total invoice face amount to calculate the factoring fee. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.015000 = 1.5%). May be a flat rate or tiered based on invoice age, customer credit quality, or commodity type.']
  financing_institution_code varchar [note: 'Internal or industry-standard code identifying the financing institution. Used for system integration, GL posting, and counterparty reporting. May correspond to a bank identifier code (BIC/SWIFT) or internal vendor code in SAP FI.']
  financing_institution_name varchar [note: 'Legal name of the financial institution (bank, factor, or special purpose vehicle) to which the receivables are sold or pledged. Critical for counterparty risk management and financial statement disclosure under GAAP ASC 860 derecognition assessment.']
  financing_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the receivable financing arrangement, used for communication with the financing institution and internal tracking. Corresponds to the facility or transaction reference in SAP FI or Oracle NetSuite AR modules.']
  financing_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the receivable financing transaction, tracking progression from initiation through settlement. Values: draft (being prepared), submitted (sent to institution), approved (institution confirmed), active (funds disbursed), settled (fully reconciled), cancelled (voided).']
  financing_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the receivable financing arrangement. Factoring involves outright sale of AR; invoice discounting retains collection responsibility; supply chain finance is buyer-led; asset-backed lending pledges AR as collateral; forfaiting is used for medium-term trade receivables. Common in agricultural commodity trading for seasonal cash flow management.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'General ledger account code used to post the receivable financing transaction in the enterprise accounting system. Typically maps to a factored receivables or short-term financing liability account per the chart of accounts in SAP S/4HANA FI or Oracle NetSuite GL.']
  gl_posting_date date [note: 'Date on which the receivable financing transaction is posted to the general ledger. May differ from disbursement_date due to period-end cut-off requirements. Critical for accurate period-end financial reporting and SOX compliance.']
  is_derecognized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the financed receivables have been removed from the agricultural enterprise balance sheet per GAAP ASC 860 or IFRS 9 derecognition criteria. True = receivables derecognized (off-balance-sheet); False = receivables remain on balance sheet (secured borrowing treatment).']
  maturity_date date [note: 'Date by which the underlying customer invoices are expected to be paid and the financing arrangement is expected to be fully settled. Used for aging analysis, liquidity forecasting, and monitoring of overdue financing positions.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to the receivable financing transaction. May include details about seasonal payment terms, commodity-specific conditions, or financing institution special requirements.']
  notification_sent_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the customer (invoice obligor) has been formally notified of the assignment or sale of their receivable to the financing institution. Notification is legally required in many jurisdictions for the assignment to be enforceable against the debtor. True = notification sent; False = not yet notified.']
  profit_center_code varchar [note: 'Profit center associated with the receivable financing transaction for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables attribution of financing costs to specific commodity trading or agricultural business segments.']
  recourse_limit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum monetary exposure retained by the agricultural enterprise under a partial recourse arrangement. Null for full recourse or without recourse transactions. Used for contingent liability disclosure in financial statements per GAAP ASC 460.']
  recourse_type varchar [note: 'Defines the credit risk allocation between the agricultural enterprise and the financing institution. Full recourse: enterprise bears all credit risk; partial recourse: shared risk up to a defined limit; without recourse: financing institution assumes all credit risk. Determines whether the receivable qualifies for derecognition under GAAP ASC 860 and IFRS 9.']
  reserve_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount withheld by the financing institution as a reserve against potential dilution, disputes, or credit losses. Released to the agricultural enterprise upon confirmed customer payment. Equals total_invoice_face_amount minus advance_amount minus factoring_fee_amount.']
  reserve_released_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount of the withheld reserve that has been remitted back to the agricultural enterprise following confirmed customer payment collection by the financing institution. Supports reconciliation of the total financing cycle.']
  settlement_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the financing arrangement was fully settled, including remittance of reserve amounts and reconciliation of all fees. May differ from maturity_date if customers pay early or late. Null if not yet settled.']
  settlement_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the settlement process for this financing transaction. Tracks whether the financing institution has remitted reserve amounts back to the enterprise following customer payment collection. Overdue indicates maturity_date has passed without full settlement.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this receivable financing record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite are the primary source systems for AR financing transactions.']
  total_invoice_face_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Aggregate face value of all AR invoices included in this financing transaction before any advance rate, fees, or deductions. Represents the gross receivables pool being financed. Used for GAAP ASC 860 derecognition and IFRS 9 impairment calculations.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this receivable financing record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage requirements for financial reporting controls.']

  Note: 'Tracks receivables financing, factoring, and assignment transactions where the agricultural enterprise sells or pledges AR invoices to financial institutions for early cash conversion. Captures financing arrangement reference, factored invoice references, advance rate, factoring fee, recourse type (with/without recourse), financing institution, disbursement date, maturity date, and settlement status. Common in agricultural commodity trading where seasonal cash flow gaps require receivables monetization between harvest delivery and customer payment.'
}

  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the vendor invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency procurement under FOB/CIF contract terms with international agricultural input suppliers. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET.']
  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this invoice is currently under formal dispute with the vendor. True when a dispute has been raised; False when no dispute is active. Triggers dispute management workflow within the procurement domain.']

  dispute_root_cause varchar [note: 'Root cause classification for the invoice dispute, used for supplier performance analytics and process improvement. Examples include vendor billing error, receiving discrepancy, contract interpretation, quality failure, or documentation non-compliance (missing COA/SDS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vendor_billing_error|receiving_discrepancy|contract_interpretation|quality_failure|documentation_noncompliance|pricing_error|other — promote to reference product]']
  dispute_type varchar [note: 'Category of dispute raised against the vendor invoice. Includes quantity discrepancy (invoiced vs received), price variance (invoiced vs PO price), quality rejection (input failed QA/COA), duplicate invoice, and missing Certificate of Analysis (COA) or Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for regulated agricultural chemicals. Null if no dispute.']
  disputed_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The portion of the invoice amount currently under dispute, expressed in the invoice currency. May be less than the total invoice amount for partial disputes. Used for AP aging and cash flow forecasting.']
  due_date date [note: 'Calculated date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Net 90). Derived from invoice date plus payment term days but stored as a business field for AP aging and cash flow planning.']

  early_payment_discount_pct decimal(5,4) [note: 'Percentage discount offered by the vendor for early payment (e.g., 0.02 = 2% discount if paid within the early payment discount window). Used for cash flow optimization and dynamic discounting decisions in agricultural input procurement.']
  grn_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number confirming physical receipt of agricultural inputs at the warehouse or farm location. Used for three-way match documentation and audit trail.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seeds|fertilizers|crop_protection|feed_ingredients|fuel|parts|equipment|services|other — promote to reference product]']
  invoice_date date [note: 'The date printed on the vendor\'s invoice document, representing the principal real-world business event date. Used for payment term calculation, aging analysis, and period accruals. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.']
  invoice_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice within the procurement workflow. Drives routing, escalation, and payment eligibility. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|matched|approved|disputed|on_hold|cancelled — promote to reference product]']
  invoice_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the invoice document type. Distinguishes standard vendor invoices from credit notes (issued after quality rejection or dispute resolution), debit notes, prepayments, and intercompany transactions for agricultural input procurement.']
  match_discrepancy_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Monetary value of the discrepancy identified during three-way match validation, expressed in the invoice currency. Positive value indicates over-invoicing; negative indicates under-invoicing. Used to determine dispute escalation thresholds.']
  match_discrepancy_type varchar [note: 'Type of discrepancy identified during three-way match validation. Quantity variance indicates invoiced quantity differs from GRN quantity; price variance indicates invoiced unit price differs from PO price. Drives dispute initiation and resolution workflow.']
  net_payable_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net amount payable to the vendor after applying taxes, discounts, and any credit adjustments, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the final obligation amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.']
  netsuite_ap_doc_ref varchar [note: 'Oracle NetSuite internal AP document reference number assigned upon invoice entry into the AP sub-ledger. Used for cross-system reconciliation between procurement and finance domains.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes entered by procurement staff during invoice processing, dispute resolution, or match exception handling. Captures context for audit trail, vendor communications, and escalation documentation.']
  payment_terms_code varchar [note: 'Vendor-agreed payment terms code as configured in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle NetSuite (e.g., NET30, NET60, NET90, 2/10NET30). Governs due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility for agricultural input supplier invoices.']
  po_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable Purchase Order (PO) number as printed on the vendor invoice and procurement documents. Used for cross-referencing with SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing documents and vendor communications.']
  receipt_date date [note: 'Date the vendor invoice was physically or electronically received by the procurement team. Used to calculate processing lead time and determine payment due date under net payment terms.']
  sds_received_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the vendor\'s Safety Data Sheet (SDS) has been received for hazardous agricultural inputs (crop protection chemicals, pesticides, herbicides). SDS is mandatory under EPA and OSHA regulations for chemical handling and storage compliance.']
  tax_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total tax amount charged on the invoice (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax), expressed in the invoice currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for tax reporting and AP ledger posting by the Finance domain.']
  three_way_match_status varchar [note: 'Result of the three-way match validation comparing the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt Note (GRN), and vendor invoice for quantity and price alignment. Core procurement control for agricultural input invoice processing. Matched invoices are eligible for payment approval.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks changes during dispute resolution, match correction, and approval workflows.']
  vendor_invoice_number varchar [note: 'The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor\'s invoice document. Used for duplicate invoice detection, vendor reconciliation, and dispute resolution. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.']

  Note: 'Accounts payable invoice record received from a vendor following delivery of agricultural inputs. Captures vendor invoice number, invoice date, PO reference, GRN reference, invoiced line items with quantities and amounts, tax amount, currency, payment terms (net 30/60/90, early payment discount percentage), due date, three-way match status (PO-GRN-invoice), match discrepancy details, and Oracle NetSuite AP document reference. Includes dispute management: dispute type (quantity discrepancy, price variance, quality rejection, duplicate invoice, missing COA/SDS), disputed amount, resolution status, credit note reference, and root cause category. Procurement-side SSOT for vendor invoice processing and three-way match validation. BOUNDARY: Procurement owns invoice receipt, three-way match validation, and dispute resolution. Finance domain owns payment disbursement, AP ledger posting, and cash management. Three-way match failures escalate within procurement; payment failures escalate to finance.'
}

Required for OSHA HazCom compliance, EPA regulatory reporting, GAP certification, and HACCP compliance.'

  Note: 'Procurement budget allocation record by input category, cost center, farm enterprise, and fiscal period.   approved_date date [note: 'Date on which this specific vendor-product pairing was formally approved for procurement use. Captured from detection phase relationship data.']
  approved_input_categories varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of agricultural input categories this vendor is approved to supply (e.g., \'seeds,NPK_fertilizers,herbicides\'). Restricts PO creation to approved categories only. Managed as part of the vendor qualification record. [Moved from vendor: This comma-delimited string in vendor is a denormalized approximation of the vendor-product approval relationship. The structured vendor_product_approval association supersedes this field by providing proper per-product approval records with full qualification attributes. The approved_input_categories field should be deprecated in favor of querying this association.]']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard_unit_price on this vendor-product pairing. May differ from the vendor\'s default invoicing currency for specific product agreements.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date from which this vendor-product approval is effective for use in purchase orders. Supports time-bounded approval management.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which this vendor-product approval expires and must be re-evaluated. Null if the approval has no defined expiry.']
  preferred_vendor_rank varchar [note: 'Ordinal ranking of this vendor relative to other approved vendors for the same input product (1 = primary/preferred, 2 = secondary, etc.). Belongs to the pairing — the same vendor may be ranked 1 for one product and 3 for another.']
  quality_acceptance_rate decimal [note: 'Historical quality acceptance rate (as a percentage) for receipts of this specific input product from this specific vendor. Belongs to the pairing — the same vendor may have different quality performance across different products.']
  standard_lead_time_days varchar [note: 'Standard number of calendar days from purchase order placement to expected delivery for this specific vendor-product combination. Varies by vendor-product pairing and is used in procurement planning.']
  standard_unit_price decimal [note: 'Negotiated or catalog unit price for this input product from this specific vendor. Belongs to the pairing — the same product may have different prices from different vendors.']
  supply_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or territory from which this vendor is approved to supply this input product. A vendor may supply the same product from different regions under different terms.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal approval contract between an agricultural input product and a qualified vendor. It captures the operational Approved Vendor List (AVL) entry that procurement teams actively create, maintain, and revoke as part of supplier qualification processes. Each record links one input_product to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific vendor-product qualification pairing — including approval status, preferred rank, negotiated pricing, lead time, and quality performance history.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, an approved vendor list (AVL) is a formally managed operational construct where each input product (fertilizer, pesticide, seed treatment) is qualified against multiple approved vendors, and each vendor is approved to supply multiple input products. The business actively creates, maintains, and revokes these vendor-product approvals with specific terms (pricing, lead time, preferred rank, approval status) that belong to neither the input product nor the vendor alone. This is a classic supply agreement / vendor qualification pattern that is operationally managed, not analytically derived.'
}

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal approval contract between a vendor and a commodity within the agricultural procurement domain. Each record links one commodity to one approved vendor and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific vendor-commodity supply relationship. This is the operational record that governs sourcing decisions and supplier qualification at the commodity level.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, vendors are formally approved to supply specific commodities under defined terms — a vendor supplies multiple commodities (corn, soybeans, wheat) and each commodity is sourced from multiple approved vendors. The business actively manages this relationship as a \'Vendor-Commodity Approval\' or \'Approved Supplier List\' entry, tracking grade standards, pricing basis, lead times, preferred rank, and organic supply eligibility per vendor-commodity pair. These attributes cannot reside on either the vendor or commodity master alone because they are specific to the intersection of a particular vendor supplying a particular commodity.'

  yield_result decimal [note: 'Measured yield outcome (bushels per acre or kg/ha) for this variety in this specific trial environment. Core performance metric used in variety registration and commercial release decisions.']

Table research.experimental_design {
  experimental_design_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each experimental design record in the research domain. Primary key for the experimental_design data product.']

  cv_threshold_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable Coefficient of Variation (CV) percentage for yield or primary response variable measurements. Trials exceeding this CV threshold are flagged for review before inclusion in variety performance databases.']
  data_collection_method varchar [note: 'Primary method used to collect trial plot observations and measurements. Determines data pipeline integration (e.g., Climate FieldView for combine monitor, John Deere Operations Center for IoT/telematics, Trimble for digital tablet).']
  data_quality_acceptance_criteria varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the data quality thresholds and acceptance rules for this experimental design (e.g., maximum allowable CV%, missing data tolerance, outlier exclusion rules). Governs which plot observations are included in final analysis.']
  design_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this experimental design across systems (e.g., FMIS, Trimble Ag, Granular). Used for cross-system referencing and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS.']
  design_description varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative describing the scientific objectives, hypotheses, and key design decisions for this experimental design. Provides context for agronomists, statisticians, and regulatory reviewers.']
  design_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name for the experimental design (e.g., \'Corn Hybrid Yield Trial RCBD 2024 - Iowa\'). Used in reports, dashboards, and regulatory submissions.']
  design_software varchar [note: 'Name and version of the statistical software used to generate the experimental design and randomization (e.g., \'R v4.3.1 - agricolae package\', \'SAS v9.4 PROC PLAN\', \'Agrobase Generation II\'). Required for reproducibility.']
  design_type varchar [note: 'Statistical design type governing plot layout and treatment randomization. RCBD = Randomized Complete Block Design; CRD = Completely Randomized Design. Determines blocking structure and analysis model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RCBD|CRD|Latin_Square|Split_Plot|Strip_Trial|Augmented|Alpha_Lattice — promote to reference product]']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date from which this experimental design protocol version becomes operative and governs trial execution. Used to determine which protocol version applies to a given planting season.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date after which this protocol version is no longer valid and must be superseded. Null indicates the protocol remains in effect until explicitly superseded.']
  fertilizer_schedule_ref varchar [note: 'Reference code or document identifier for the standardized NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) fertilizer application schedule prescribed for this experimental design. Links to the nutrient management plan.']
  gap_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this experimental design protocol has been verified as compliant with GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) standards. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. certification and USDA organic program eligibility.']
  gmo_trial_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this experimental design involves GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) traits or biotech events. When True, triggers mandatory USDA APHIS BPRE/BRS regulatory submission workflow and containment protocol requirements.']
  gmp_compliant_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this experimental design protocol meets GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) requirements for research-grade data integrity and documentation. Required for FDA-regulated crop research and food safety submissions.']
  harvest_procedure_ref varchar [note: 'Reference code to the standardized harvest procedure document specifying plot combine settings, moisture adjustment protocols, and yield data capture requirements for this experimental design.']
  irrigation_management_rule varchar [note: 'Irrigation management protocol applied uniformly across all trial plots. ET (Evapotranspiration)-based and soil moisture-triggered rules require IoT sensor integration. Rainfed indicates no supplemental irrigation.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this experimental design record was most recently updated. Supports change detection, audit trail, and protocol version management in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  min_plot_size_sqm decimal(10,2) [note: 'Minimum acceptable plot size in square meters as specified by the experimental design protocol. Plots below this threshold are flagged as non-compliant and excluded from statistical analysis.']
  planting_window_end date [note: 'Latest acceptable planting date for trial plots under this experimental design protocol. Planting outside this window invalidates the trial data per protocol acceptance criteria.']
  planting_window_start date [note: 'Earliest acceptable planting date for trial plots under this experimental design protocol. Defines the opening of the planting date window to ensure agronomic validity of results.']
  primary_response_variable varchar [note: 'The principal agronomic measurement or outcome variable that this experimental design is powered to detect (e.g., \'grain yield BU/acre\', \'plant stand count\', \'disease severity rating\'). Drives statistical power calculations and analysis model selection.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the experimental design protocol document (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.3\'). Enables version control and audit trail for protocol amendments. Required for USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions.']
  randomization_seed varchar [note: 'Numeric seed value used by the design generation software to produce the treatment randomization sequence. Enables exact reproducibility of the randomization for audit and re-analysis purposes.']
  replication_count varchar [note: 'Number of replications (blocks or repetitions) specified in the experimental design. Directly determines statistical power and the minimum number of trial plots required.']
  scouting_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Minimum required interval in days between crop scouting observations for trial plots under this design. Governs IPM (Integrated Pest Management) monitoring cadence and data collection scheduling.']
  seeding_rate_target decimal(10,2) [note: 'Standardized target seeding rate specified in the protocol for all trial plots, expressed in seeds per acre. Deviations beyond the tolerance threshold trigger a data quality flag.']
  seeding_rate_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the target seeding rate specification (e.g., seeds per acre, kg per hectare). Ensures consistent interpretation across geographies and reporting systems.']
  sop_reference varchar [note: 'Reference code to the governing Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document that defines execution procedures for this experimental design. Links to the document management system.']
  statistical_power_target decimal(5,4) [note: 'Target statistical power (1 - beta) for the experimental design, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 = 80%). Used to validate that replication count is sufficient to detect the minimum detectable difference.']
  treatment_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct treatments (including controls) defined in this experimental design. Governs the number of treatment randomization assignments per replication.']

  Note: 'Captures the statistical design, standardized operating protocol (SOP), and execution procedures for each trial. Includes design type (RCBD, CRD, Latin Square, Split-Plot, Strip Trial), number of replications and treatments, blocking structure, randomization seed, statistical power target, alpha level, and design generation software. Governs trial execution protocols: planting date windows, seeding rate specifications, fertilizer application schedules, irrigation management rules, scouting frequency, data collection methods, harvest procedures, and data quality acceptance criteria. Captures protocol version, effective date, approval status, approving agronomist, SOP reference, and GMP/GAP compliance flags. Links to the parent trial and governs how trial_plot assignments and treatment randomization are structured. SSOT for trial methodology, protocol, and standard operating procedures in the research domain.'
}

Table research.statistical_result {
  statistical_result_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each statistical analysis output record stored in the research domain. Primary key for the statistical_result data product.']

  experimental_design_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the experimental design specification (e.g., RCBD, CRD, Alpha-lattice, Split-plot) used for the trial from which this result was generated. Governs the statistical model applied.']

Business justification: Statistical results analyze the performance of specific crop varieties across trial environments. statistical_result has check_variety_name (STRING for the check/control variety) but no FK to the prim']
  trial_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the field trial or experiment from which this statistical result was derived. Links the analytical output back to its source experimental design and plot data.']
  alpha_level decimal(5,4) [note: 'The significance threshold (alpha level) used for hypothesis testing and mean separation in this analysis (e.g., 0.05 for 5%, 0.10 for 10%). Determines the critical values for LSD, HSD, and significance codes.']
  analysis_run_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the statistical analysis was executed. Used for versioning analytical outputs and tracking when results were generated relative to trial completion.']
  analysis_run_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when the statistical analysis job was executed, including timezone offset. Enables exact reproducibility tracking and audit of analytical pipeline runs.']
  analysis_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the statistical method category applied to generate this result. ANOVA = Analysis of Variance; MET = Multi-Environment Trial analysis; GGE biplot = Genotype plus Genotype-by-Environment biplot for stability analysis; mean_separation = LSD/HSD/Tukey post-hoc tests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANOVA|regression|mean_separation|MET|GGE_biplot|stability|correlation|descriptive|mixed_model|path_analysis — promote to reference product]']
  check_variety_mean decimal(18,6) [note: 'Mean value of the response variable for the check variety in this analysis. Provides the absolute performance baseline against which experimental varieties are compared. Expressed in the same units as response_variable_unit.']
  check_variety_name varchar [note: 'Name of the check or control variety used as the performance benchmark in the trial. Variety performance is often expressed relative to the check. Required for commercial variety release decisions and seed selection recommendations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this statistical result record was first created and persisted in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.']
  crop_year varchar [note: 'The agricultural crop year (e.g., 2024) in which the trial data was collected. Used for temporal stratification of variety performance benchmarks and multi-year trend analysis.']
  cv_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Coefficient of Variation expressed as a percentage (CV%), calculated as (standard deviation / grand mean) × 100. Measures experimental precision and data quality. CV% values above 20% for yield trials typically indicate poor experimental control per USDA guidelines.']
  disease_resistance_rating decimal(5,2) [note: 'Aggregated disease resistance performance rating for the variety or treatment derived from the statistical analysis, typically on a 1-9 scale (1=highly susceptible, 9=highly resistant) or 0-100 percent scale. Supports IPM (Integrated Pest Management) efficacy studies and variety release decisions.']
  environment_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct environments (location-year combinations) included in a Multi-Environment Trial (MET) analysis. A higher count increases the reliability of stability estimates. Applicable when analysis_type is MET, GGE_biplot, or stability.']
  f_statistic decimal(18,6) [note: 'The F-statistic value from the ANOVA table for the primary treatment effect. Ratio of treatment mean square to error mean square. Used to assess whether treatment differences are statistically meaningful.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or agro-ecological zone where the trial was conducted (e.g., \'Corn Belt\', \'Delta\', \'Northern Plains\', \'Southeast\'). Used for MET (Multi-Environment Trial) regional performance benchmarking and seed selection recommendations by geography.']
  grand_mean decimal(18,6) [note: 'Overall mean value of the response variable across all treatments and replications in the analysis. Serves as the baseline for interpreting treatment effects and computing relative performance metrics.']
  hsd_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Tukey\'s Honestly Significant Difference (HSD) value at the specified alpha level. More conservative than LSD; used when all pairwise comparisons are of interest. Stored alongside LSD to support different reporting standards.']
  is_publication_ready boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this statistical result has been reviewed, approved, and is ready for inclusion in external publications, regulatory submissions, or public trial reports. True = approved for publication; False = internal use only or pending review.']
  lsd_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'Fisher\'s Least Significant Difference (LSD) value at the specified alpha level. Two treatment means differing by more than this value are considered statistically different. Standard mean separation metric in agronomic variety trials.']
  p_value decimal(10,8) [note: 'Probability value (p-value) for the primary treatment effect in the ANOVA or regression analysis. Values below the significance threshold (typically 0.05 or 0.10) indicate statistically significant treatment differences. Core output for publication-ready trial reporting.']
  r_squared decimal(8,6) [note: 'Coefficient of determination (R²) from the statistical model, ranging 0 to 1. Indicates the proportion of total variation in the response variable explained by the model. Used to assess model fit quality in regression and ANOVA analyses.']
  replication_count varchar [note: 'Number of replications per treatment in the experimental design. Directly affects statistical power and the reliability of mean estimates. Standard field trials use 3-4 replications per USDA protocols.']
  response_variable varchar [note: 'The dependent variable or agronomic trait being analyzed (e.g., \'yield_bu_acre\', \'plant_height_cm\', \'test_weight_lbs_bu\', \'disease_severity_pct\', \'standability_score\'). Defines what outcome the statistical model is measuring.']
  response_variable_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for the response variable (e.g., \'BU/acre\', \'MT/ha\', \'kg/ha\', \'cm\', \'score 1-9\', \'percent\'). Required for correct interpretation of all quantitative result fields. Aligns with BU (Bushel) and MT (Metric Ton) standard agricultural units.']
  result_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this statistical result record, following the format SR-{DOMAIN}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE} (e.g., SR-YIELD-2024-00042). Used for cross-referencing in publications, regulatory submissions, and internal reports.']
  result_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for analyst annotations, data quality observations, model assumptions, outlier notes, or contextual information relevant to interpreting this statistical result. Supports scientific rigor and peer review processes.']
  result_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the statistical result record. Draft indicates in-progress analysis; preliminary indicates initial outputs pending peer review; final indicates approved and publication-ready; superseded indicates replaced by a newer analysis run; retracted indicates withdrawn due to data quality issues.']
  significance_code varchar [note: 'Conventional significance notation derived from the p-value: ns = not significant (p>0.10); * = significant at p≤0.05; ** = highly significant at p≤0.01; *** = very highly significant at p≤0.001. Standard notation used in agronomic publication tables.']
  software_name varchar [note: 'Name of the statistical software platform used to execute the analysis (e.g., SAS, R, JMP). Required for reproducibility documentation and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAS|R|JMP|Genstat|ASReml|Python|SPSS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  software_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the statistical software used (e.g., \'SAS 9.4\', \'R 4.3.1\', \'JMP Pro 17\'). Critical for reproducibility — different versions may produce slightly different numerical outputs.']
  stability_index decimal(18,6) [note: 'Quantitative stability index value for variety performance across environments, derived from Finlay-Wilkinson regression (regression coefficient b) or Eberhart-Russell variance of deviations. Values near 1.0 (Finlay-Wilkinson) indicate average stability. Critical for commercial variety release decisions and seed selection recommendations.']
  stability_method varchar [note: 'The specific stability analysis method used to compute the stability_index. Finlay-Wilkinson and Eberhart-Russell are regression-based; GGE biplot and AMMI are multivariate. Required to correctly interpret the stability_index value.']
  standability_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Statistical mean standability score for the variety or treatment, measuring resistance to lodging (stalk or root). Typically rated on a 1-9 scale. Critical agronomic trait for commercial variety release and harvest efficiency assessment.']
  standard_error decimal(18,6) [note: 'Standard error of the treatment mean for the response variable. Quantifies the precision of the mean estimate. Published in trial result tables alongside treatment means for scientific reporting.']
  statistical_method varchar [note: 'Specific statistical procedure or algorithm applied (e.g., \'Two-way ANOVA with interaction\', \'Finlay-Wilkinson regression\', \'REML mixed model\', \'Tukey HSD\', \'Fisher LSD\', \'Eberhart-Russell stability\', \'AMMI\'). Provides methodological detail beyond the analysis_type classification for reproducibility and publication.']
  treatment_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct treatments or varieties included in the analysis. Used to contextualize degrees of freedom, mean separation results, and the breadth of the comparative study.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this statistical result record. Tracks revisions to analytical outputs, corrections, or re-analysis events.']

  Note: 'Stores all statistical analysis outputs, performance benchmarks, and derived metrics generated from trial data. For individual trial analyses: ANOVA tables, LSD/HSD mean separation results, regression coefficients, treatment means, standard errors, CV%, p-values, and significance codes. For multi-environment trial (MET) analyses and performance benchmarks: aggregated variety performance including mean yield (BU/acre or MT/ha), yield stability index (Finlay-Wilkinson, GGE biplot), disease resistance performance ratings, standability score, geographic region, crop year, and comparison to check variety. Captures analysis run date, statistical method, software reference (SAS/R/JMP), response variable, trial and experimental design reference, and analyst ID. Supports publication-ready trial reporting, seed selection recommendations, commercial variety release decisions, and internal crop improvement decision-making. SSOT for all analytical outputs, derived performance benchmarks, and MET summary statistics in the research domain.'

  study_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the IPM efficacy study, tracking progression from planning through completion or cancellation.']
  study_title varchar [note: 'Descriptive title of the IPM efficacy study, summarizing the target pest or disease, treatment product, and crop system under evaluation.']
  target_organism_name varchar [note: 'Common or scientific name of the pest, disease pathogen, or weed species targeted by the IPM treatment in this study (e.g., \'Botrytis cinerea\', \'Western Corn Rootworm\', \'Palmer Amaranth\').   target_organism_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the target organism category for the IPM study. Drives resistance management strategy, MRL compliance requirements, and EPA registration data submission grouping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insect|fungal_pathogen|bacterial_pathogen|nematode|weed|rodent|mite|virus — promote to reference product]']
  threshold_exceeded_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the observed pest density exceeded the economic threshold at the time of treatment application (True = threshold exceeded; False = below threshold). Validates IPM decision compliance and supports program optimization reporting.']
  untreated_control_efficacy_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The pest or disease incidence level observed in the untreated control plots, expressed as a percentage. Used as the baseline denominator for calculating relative efficacy rating and validating study integrity.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this IPM efficacy record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and data quality monitoring.']

  Note: 'Captures the results of Integrated Pest Management (IPM) efficacy studies, recording pest or disease target organism, efficacy rating (% control), treatment product and rate, application timing relative to pest threshold, economic threshold comparison, resistance management classification, and MRL compliance status. Links to trial_plot and treatment_application records. Supports EPA registration data submissions and internal IPM program optimization.'

Table research.telemetry_event {
  telemetry_event_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for telemetry_event']
  growing_season_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Precision ag telemetry events occur within a commercial growing season. Linking enables season-level aggregation and analysis of sensor data for pilot evaluation reports and precision ag ROI calculati']
  management_zone_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.management_zone. Business justification: Telemetry events (sensor readings, drone scans, VRA controller logs) are collected at GPS coordinates that fall within management zones. Linking telemetry_event to management_zone enables zone-level a']
  precision_ag_pilot_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the precision agriculture pilot program under which this telemetry event was generated. Links the event to its governing research pilot context.']
  precision_device_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Internet of Things (IoT) device, sensor, or telematics unit that generated this event. Supports device-level performance tracking and calibration audit trails.']
  treatment_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to research.treatment_application. Business justification: Telemetry events during precision ag operations can be linked to specific treatment applications (e.g., VRA application events, real-time sensor data during spraying).']
  trial_plot_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific field trial plot where this telemetry event was recorded. Enables spatial correlation of sensor readings to experimental plot boundaries.']
  vra_prescription_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription that was active or being executed at the time of this telemetry event. Enables reconciliation of actual application rates against prescribed rates for agronomic compliance and efficacy analysis.']
  air_temperature_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the sensor or equipment location at the time of the telemetry event. Supports growing degree day (GDD) accumulation calculations and environmental context for agronomic analysis.']
  battery_level_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Remaining battery charge percentage of the IoT sensor or device at the time of the telemetry event. Used for predictive maintenance scheduling and to flag readings that may be unreliable due to low-power device states.']
  calibration_status varchar [note: 'Calibration status of the sensor or device at the time the telemetry event was recorded. \'calibrated\' indicates the device was within its valid calibration window; \'due\' indicates calibration is approaching expiry; \'overdue\' indicates calibration has lapsed; \'uncalibrated\' indicates no calibration record exists. Affects data quality scoring and regulatory compliance.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (UTC) when this telemetry event record was first ingested and persisted in the Silver Layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp which captures the real-world observation time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  data_quality_flag varchar [note: 'Quality control flag assigned to the telemetry event record indicating the outcome of automated data quality checks. \'pass\' indicates all checks passed; \'out_of_range\' indicates the reading_value exceeded agronomic thresholds; \'sensor_fault\' indicates device self-diagnostic failure; \'gps_degraded\' indicates positioning accuracy below threshold; \'duplicate\' indicates a suspected duplicate transmission; \'missing_context\' indicates required reference data is absent.']
  data_source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this telemetry event was ingested into the lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking, source system reconciliation, and multi-platform precision agriculture pilot analysis.']
  event_code varchar [note: 'Structured alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the type of telemetry event (e.g., SOIL_MOIST_READ, NDVI_SCAN, VRA_CMD, RTK_FIX, EC_READ). Used for programmatic event classification and downstream routing.']
  event_status varchar [note: 'Current processing lifecycle status of the telemetry event record. \'raw\' indicates unprocessed ingestion; \'validated\' confirms quality checks passed; \'flagged\' indicates anomaly detection triggered; \'rejected\' indicates the record failed quality thresholds; \'processed\' indicates downstream consumption complete.']
  event_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (UTC) at which the telemetry event was recorded by the device or sensor. This is the principal real-world observation time, distinct from ingestion or processing timestamps. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  event_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the telemetry event discriminating the kind of observation or command captured. Drives downstream processing pipelines and analytics segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: soil_moisture|electrical_conductivity|temperature|ndvi_scan|vra_command|rtk_position|equipment_position|canopy_reflectance|rainfall|wind_speed|humidity|pressure|leaf_wetness|flow_rate|battery_voltage — promote to reference product]']
  gps_altitude_m decimal(8,2) [note: 'Altitude in metres above mean sea level (MSL) recorded by the GPS receiver at the time of the telemetry event. Relevant for drone-based NDVI scans and terrain-adjusted VRA prescriptions.']
  gps_latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'WGS-84 decimal degree latitude coordinate of the device or sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Supports geospatial mapping, plot boundary validation, and precision agriculture spatial analytics via Esri ArcGIS and GIS platforms.']
  gps_longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'WGS-84 decimal degree longitude coordinate of the device or sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Used in conjunction with gps_latitude for precise geospatial positioning of sensor readings and equipment operations.']
  heading_degrees decimal(5,2) [note: 'Direction of travel of the equipment or drone in degrees from true north (0–360°) at the time of the telemetry event. Used for pass-by-pass field operation mapping and VRA swath alignment analysis.']
  is_outlier boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether the telemetry event reading_value was identified as a statistical outlier by automated anomaly detection algorithms (e.g., z-score or IQR-based methods). True indicates the value deviates significantly from the expected distribution for this sensor and event type.']
  ndvi_value decimal(5,4) [note: 'Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) value derived from drone or satellite multispectral imagery at the event location, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Values above 0.5 indicate healthy dense vegetation. Null for non-NDVI event types. Supports crop health monitoring and yield prediction models.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for agronomist or field technician annotations associated with this telemetry event, such as observed field conditions, equipment anomalies, or protocol deviations noted at the time of data collection.']
  quality_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric quality score (0.00–100.00) assigned to the telemetry event based on multi-dimensional quality checks including GPS accuracy, sensor calibration status, signal strength, and value range validation. Supports tiered data confidence levels for AI/ML model training.']
  reading_depth_cm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Depth in centimetres at which the soil sensor reading was taken (e.g., 15 cm, 30 cm, 60 cm for soil moisture or EC probes). Null for surface or aerial measurements such as NDVI drone scans or equipment position events.']
  reading_unit varchar [note: 'The unit of measure associated with the reading_value (e.g., pct for soil moisture percentage, ds_m for Electrical Conductivity (EC) in dS/m, celsius for temperature, ndvi for Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), kg_ha for Variable Rate Application (VRA) rate). Ensures dimensional correctness in analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pct|ds_m|celsius|ndvi|kg_ha|l_ha|mm|m_s|degrees|mbar|lux|mv — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  reading_value decimal(18,6) [note: 'The principal quantitative measurement or observed value captured by the sensor or device for this telemetry event (e.g., soil moisture percentage, EC in dS/m, temperature in °C, NDVI index value, VRA application rate). The unit of measure is captured in reading_unit.']
  relative_humidity_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Ambient relative humidity percentage recorded at the sensor or equipment location at the time of the telemetry event. Used for disease pressure modelling, spray application condition assessment (REI compliance), and evapotranspiration (ET) calculations.']
  rtk_accuracy_cm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Horizontal positioning accuracy in centimetres as reported by the Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS receiver at the time of the event. Values below 2.5 cm indicate RTK-fixed precision; higher values indicate degraded or float solutions. Critical for VRA prescription accuracy validation.']
  rtk_fix_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the GPS/GNSS positioning solution quality at the time of the event. \'fixed\' indicates centimetre-level RTK accuracy; \'float\' indicates sub-decimetre; \'dgps\' indicates differential correction; \'autonomous\' indicates standard GPS; \'none\' indicates no fix. Drives data quality scoring for precision agriculture analytics.']
  scan_altitude_m decimal(6,2) [note: 'Altitude above ground level (AGL) in metres at which the drone or UAV conducted the NDVI or multispectral scan. Affects image resolution and NDVI calculation accuracy. Null for ground-based sensor events.']
  signal_strength_dbm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Wireless signal strength in decibels relative to one milliwatt (dBm) at the time of the telemetry event transmission. Used to assess data transmission reliability and identify connectivity dead zones in field operations.']
  soil_temperature_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Soil temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by an in-field sensor at the time of the event. Used in conjunction with soil moisture and EC readings for comprehensive soil health assessment and planting condition evaluation.']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native record identifier assigned by the originating operational system (e.g., John Deere Operations Center event UUID, Trimble Ag log entry ID). Enables traceability back to the source system for audit, reconciliation, and duplicate detection.']
  speed_km_h decimal(6,2) [note: 'Ground speed of the equipment in kilometres per hour at the time of the telemetry event. Used to validate application uniformity for VRA operations and to detect equipment anomalies such as stalls or over-speed conditions.']
  transmission_latency_ms varchar [note: 'Time in milliseconds between the event timestamp recorded by the device and the timestamp of receipt by the data ingestion platform. Used to assess real-time data pipeline performance and identify network latency issues in precision agriculture IoT deployments.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (UTC) when this telemetry event record was last modified in the Silver Layer, such as after quality flag updates, outlier re-scoring, or calibration status corrections. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  vra_actual_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The actual application rate recorded by the VRA controller at the time of the event (in units defined by reading_unit). Compared against vra_target_rate to assess application accuracy and controller performance. Null for non-VRA event types.']
  vra_target_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The prescribed target application rate from the active VRA prescription at the time of the event (in units defined by reading_unit). Null for non-VRA event types. Used to compute rate deviation and application accuracy metrics.']

  Note: 'Captures IoT and telematics data events generated during precision agriculture pilot operations, including GPS-tagged equipment position, sensor readings (soil moisture, EC, temperature), NDVI drone scan results, VRA controller logs, and RTK positioning accuracy records. Captures event timestamp, device or sensor ID, pilot reference, plot reference, reading type, value, unit, and data quality flag. Supports real-time and post-season analysis of precision ag technology performance.'
