True = all criteria satisfied; False = one or more criteria not met.']
  selection_criteria_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the specific selection criteria evaluated at this stage gate, including any criteria that were not met or required waiver. Supports transparent R&D decision documentation and regulatory audit readiness.']
  stage_entry_date date [note: 'Date on which this pipeline entry was formally entered into its current pipeline stage. Used to calculate stage duration, pipeline velocity metrics, and cycle time KPIs for R&D portfolio management.']
  target_geography varchar [note: 'Primary geographic region or market for which this pipeline entry is being developed (e.g., \'US Corn Belt\', \'Southeast Asia\', \'Sub-Saharan Africa\'). Drives trial site selection, regulatory submission routing, and commercial launch planning.']
  trait_stack_description varchar [note: 'Description of the genetic trait stack incorporated in this pipeline entry, including herbicide tolerance, insect resistance, yield enhancement, and quality traits (e.g., \'RR2Y + Bt CRW + DT\'). Supports IP management, regulatory submissions, and commercial positioning.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this breeding pipeline record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  yield_potential_bu_ac decimal(10,2) [note: 'Estimated or observed yield potential of this pipeline entry expressed in bushels per acre (BU/AC) under optimal conditions, based on trial data to date. Key quantitative metric for advancement decisions and commercial value assessment. Derived from statistical_result records; stored here as the current best estimate for portfolio reporting.']

  Note: 'Tracks the internal crop improvement and breeding pipeline stages from early-generation selection through commercial variety release. Captures pipeline entry name, crop, breeding cycle year, current pipeline stage (F2/F3/BC/PYT/AYT/EYT/pre-commercial), advancement decision, advancement date, decision maker, selection criteria met, estimated commercial release year, and linked variety and germplasm accession records. Supports strategic R&D portfolio management and innovation pipeline visibility.'
}

Table research.variety_license {
  variety_license_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the variety_license association']
  account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the customer account that holds this variety license.']
  ip_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to research.ip_record. Business justification: Variety licenses are based on IP protection (patents, PVP certificates). ip_record tracks IP assets; variety_license tracks commercial licensing agreements. Links licensing to underlying IP.']
  program_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Variety licenses are commercial outcomes of breeding programs. Links licensing agreements to the originating research program that developed the variety.']
  research_variety_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the research variety being licensed to the account.']
  end_date date [note: 'The date on which the variety license expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null if the license is open-ended or perpetual. Belongs to the license relationship.']
  exclusivity_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this account holds exclusive rights to the variety within the licensed geography. When true, no other account may be licensed for the same variety in the same geographic scope.']
  licensed_geography varchar [note: 'The geographic scope within which the account is authorized to use or distribute the variety. May be expressed as country codes, state/province codes, or a named region. Unique per account-variety license agreement.']
  royalty_rate_pct decimal [note: 'The royalty percentage owed by the account per unit sold or used of the licensed variety. This rate is negotiated per account-variety pair and cannot reside on either the account or the variety alone.']
  start_date date [note: 'The date on which the variety license becomes effective and the account is authorized to use or distribute the variety. Belongs to the license relationship, not to the account or variety independently.']
  variety_license_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the variety license agreement. Controls whether the account currently holds active authorization for the variety.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the formal licensing Contract between a customer account and a research variety. It captures the commercial terms under which an account is authorized to use, sell, or distribute a specific crop variety, including royalty obligations, geographic scope, exclusivity rights, and license duration. Each record links one account to one variety and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific licensing relationship — they cannot reside on the account or variety alone.. Existence Justification: In the agricultural seed industry, customer accounts (food manufacturers, distributors, cooperatives) actively license specific crop varieties from the research organization under formal licensing agreements that carry distinct commercial terms per account-variety pair. A single account may license multiple varieties (e.g., a food manufacturer licensing several soybean and corn varieties), and a single variety may be licensed to multiple accounts under different royalty rates, geographies, and exclusivity arrangements. This is an operationally managed business relationship — licensing teams create, negotiate, renew, and terminate these agreements as a core commercial process.'
}

Table research.trial_treatment {
  trial_treatment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the trial_treatment association']
  agrochemical_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the agrochemical product master record being evaluated as a treatment in this trial']
  treatment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to research.treatment. Business justification: trial_treatment is an association product linking agrochemical_product to trial, but it should also link to the treatment entity which defines the experimental treatment protocol. Removes redundant tr']
  trial_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the field trial or R&D experiment in which this agrochemical product is being evaluated']
  application_date date [note: 'The actual calendar date on which the agrochemical product was applied in this trial treatment. Used for PHI compliance calculation and for correlating application timing with crop growth stage observations.']
  efficacy_rating decimal [note: 'Quantitative efficacy rating (percentage control, 0-100) observed for this specific agrochemical product in this specific trial. This is the per-product-per-trial efficacy measurement, distinct from any trial-level aggregate. Belongs to the treatment record, not to either master entity alone.']
  number_of_applications varchar [note: 'The number of times this agrochemical product was applied within this trial treatment arm. Relevant for multi-application protocols and for verifying compliance with max_seasonal_applications on the product master.']
  phi_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the pre-harvest interval (PHI) requirement for this agrochemical product was met given the trial\'s actual harvest_date and the application_timing. Compliance is determined at the treatment level, not at the trial or product level alone.']
  resistance_management_class varchar [note: 'The resistance management group or classification applied to this treatment within the trial\'s IPM rotation strategy. Captures how this product\'s mode of action is being managed for resistance in the context of this specific trial design.']
  treatment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this treatment record within the trial. Tracks whether the treatment has been planned, applied, data-collected, or completed.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Treatment Application event between agrochemical_product and trial. It captures the operational record of a specific agrochemical product being applied as a treatment arm within a field trial or IPM efficacy study. Each record links one agrochemical product to one trial and carries the treatment-specific application rate, timing, observed efficacy, PHI compliance status, and resistance management classification — data that exists only in the context of this specific product-trial combination and cannot reside on either master record alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural research operations, a single field trial evaluates multiple agrochemical products across different treatment arms (e.g., a fungicide efficacy trial may test 4-6 different products at varying rates), and a single agrochemical product is evaluated across many trials over its registration lifecycle and across different crops, geographies, and pest targets. The relationship itself is a recognized operational concept — a \'Treatment Application\' or \'Trial Treatment\' — that carries its own data: the specific application rate used in that trial, application timing, observed efficacy rating, PHI compliance status, and resistance management classification. These attributes belong neither to the agrochemical product master nor to the trial master alone, but to the specific combination.'
}

  assignment_start_date date [note: 'The date on which the employee\'s active involvement in this trial commenced. Used for labor cost period allocation and regulatory personnel records.']
  contribution_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the employee\'s intellectual or operational contribution to the trial.   hours_allocated decimal [note: 'Total labor hours allocated to this employee for this trial assignment. Used for SAP cost center labor allocation and research program budget tracking. Belongs to the assignment, not to the employee or trial alone.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the Role-based assignment between a research trial and an employee. It captures the operational record of each person\'s specific role, date range, allocated hours, and contribution type on a given trial. Each record links one trial to one employee in one role, with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment — not on the trial or the employee alone. Used for labor cost allocation, publication authorship attribution, and regulatory submission personnel records.. Existence Justification: In agricultural research organizations, a single field trial requires multiple personnel in distinct, simultaneous roles — a principal investigator, co-investigators, field technicians, data managers, and statisticians — all actively working on the same trial at the same time. Conversely, each employee participates in multiple trials across seasons and years. The existing trial.employee_id FK captures only the lead PI, which is structurally insufficient to represent the full staffing reality of a research program.'
}

  osha_safety_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employee holds a current OSHA safety certification (e.g., OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour General Industry or Construction card). Required for supervisory roles and equipment operators in farm and processing facility environments.']
  pay_type varchar [note: 'Compensation structure for the employee. Salaried = fixed annual compensation; Hourly = paid per hour worked; Piece_Rate = paid per unit of agricultural output (e.g., per bin of fruit picked); Daily = fixed daily rate. Piece-rate is common in harvest operations and has specific FLSA compliance requirements.']
  personal_email varchar [note: 'Personal email address of the employee. Used for communications with seasonal and H-2A workers who may not have enterprise email, and for post-termination correspondence.']
  pesticide_applicator_license_number varchar [note: 'State-issued pesticide applicator license number for employees authorized to apply restricted-use pesticides (RUPs). Required by EPA and state lead agencies for compliance with FIFRA. Null for employees not performing pesticide applications.']
  pesticide_license_expiry_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the employee\'s state-issued pesticide applicator license. Triggers recertification workflows to ensure continuous compliance with EPA FIFRA and state regulations. Null for non-applicator employees.']
  preferred_name varchar [note: 'The name the employee prefers to be called in day-to-day operations. May differ from legal name. Used in operational communications and scheduling systems.']
  primary_language varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1/639-2 language code for the employee\'s primary spoken language. Critical for ensuring GAP, HACCP, and pesticide safety training is delivered in the worker\'s language as required by OSHA and EPA Worker Protection Standard. Examples: es (Spanish), en (English), ht (Haitian Creole).']
  successfactors_employee_code varchar [note: 'The employee identifier assigned in SAP SuccessFactors HR system. Used for cross-system integration with payroll, talent management, and labor cost allocation modules. This is the system-of-record identifier from the HR platform.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date the employee\'s employment was formally ended. Null for active employees. Used for final pay calculations, benefits termination, access revocation, and seasonal rehire eligibility assessment.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for the employee\'s departure from the enterprise. Critical for seasonal rehire eligibility, unemployment insurance claims, and workforce planning analytics. End_of_season is common for H-2A and seasonal agricultural workers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|end_of_season|layoff|termination_for_cause|retirement|death|contract_end — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  work_authorization_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the employee\'s legal authorization to work in the United States. H-2A is the primary agricultural guest worker visa program. Drives compliance workflows for USCIS, DOL, and APHIS requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|h2a_visa|ead|tn_visa|other_visa|asylum|daca — promote to reference product]']
  work_email varchar [note: 'Official enterprise email address assigned to the employee. Primary digital contact channel for HR communications, system access notifications, and training assignments.']
  work_location_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the primary farm, field complex, or processing facility where the employee is assigned. Used for labor cost allocation by location, OSHA site-specific recordkeeping, and field operations scheduling. Aligns with Granular Farm Management location hierarchy.']

  Note: 'Master record for all agricultural enterprise personnel — permanent staff, seasonal farm workers, agronomists, equipment operators, livestock technicians, processing facility workers, and administrative staff. Captures full identity, employment classification (H-2A visa, migrant, domestic, salaried, hourly), job title, department, hire date, termination date, employment status, work authorization type, I-9 verification status, emergency contact, and SAP SuccessFactors employee ID. SSOT for all workforce identity data across farm operations and processing facilities. Supports E-Verify compliance, MSPA worker disclosure, and seasonal rehire tracking.'
}

Table workforce.position {
  position_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each authorized headcount position within the agricultural enterprise organizational structure. Primary key for the position data product.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'FK to finance.cost_center']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the farm operation, processing facility, grain elevator, or distribution center to which this position is physically assigned.']

  parent_position_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing identifier pointing to the supervisory position directly above this position in the organizational hierarchy, enabling reporting line traversal.']
  budgeted_headcount varchar [note: 'Number of authorized headcount slots budgeted for this position within the current fiscal planning period. Supports workforce planning, labor budget management, and variance analysis against actual staffing levels.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this position record was first created in the system, used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance recordkeeping purposes.']
  eeo_job_category varchar [note: 'EEO-1 job category classification for this position as defined by the EEOC, required for annual EEO-1 Component 1 workforce data reporting.   effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this position becomes or became effective within the organizational structure, marking the start of its authorized existence for headcount planning, DOL H-2A job order validity, and labor compliance purposes.']
  employment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the employment arrangement for this position, distinguishing between permanent year-round roles, seasonal agricultural positions, temporary placements, contract workers, and H-2A guest worker positions under the DOL temporary agricultural worker program.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which this position is scheduled to expire or be eliminated from the authorized headcount plan. Nullable for permanent positions; populated for seasonal, temporary, or project-based roles with a defined end date.']
  flsa_exemption_status varchar [note: 'Classification of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt, non-exempt, or qualifies for the agricultural exemption under FLSA Section 13(b)(12), which affects overtime pay eligibility and minimum wage requirements.']
  fte_allocation decimal(5,2) [note: 'Budgeted Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) allocation for this position, expressed as a decimal fraction of a standard full-time schedule (e.g., 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time). Used for headcount planning, labor cost budgeting, and workforce capacity analysis.']
  h2a_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position qualifies for staffing under the DOL H-2A Temporary Agricultural Worker visa program, which allows agricultural employers to bring foreign nationals to the U.S. to fill temporary or seasonal agricultural jobs. Required for DOL H-2A job order filings.']
  housing_provided boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided housing as required under DOL H-2A regulations, which mandate that agricultural employers provide free housing to H-2A workers and domestic workers who are not reasonably able to return to their residence within the same day.']
  job_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the duties, responsibilities, and working conditions for this position, as published in DOL H-2A job orders, internal job postings, and USDA labor compliance documentation.']
  job_family varchar [note: 'Broad functional grouping that classifies the position into an agricultural job family for workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agronomy|livestock|equipment_operations|food_processing|administration|supply_chain|quality_compliance|research_development — promote to reference product]']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this position record was most recently updated, supporting change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  min_education_level varchar [note: 'Minimum educational qualification required for this position, used in job postings, H-2A job order filings, and candidate screening within SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting.']
  min_experience_years varchar [note: 'Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this position, as specified in job postings and DOL H-2A job order filings.']
  min_wage_tier varchar [note: 'Applicable minimum wage tier for this position, distinguishing between federal minimum wage, state minimum wage, DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for H-2A positions, piece-rate compensation structures common in agricultural harvesting, or negotiated collective bargaining rates.']
  pay_grade varchar [note: 'Compensation pay grade band assigned to this position, used for salary range management, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost budgeting within the enterprise pay structure.']
  physical_demands_rating varchar [note: 'DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT) physical demands rating for this position, classifying the level of physical exertion required. Used for ADA accommodation assessments, OSHA ergonomic risk evaluation, and H-2A job order physical requirements disclosure.']
  position_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the position within the enterprise, used in DOL H-2A job order filings, USDA labor compliance reporting, and integration with SAP SuccessFactors and payroll systems.']
  position_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the authorized position indicating whether it is active and available for staffing, frozen due to budget constraints, pending organizational approval, or eliminated from the headcount plan.']
  remote_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Most field operations, livestock handling, and equipment operation positions are not remote-eligible; administrative and analytical roles may qualify.']
  requires_cdl boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position requires a valid Commercial Driver\'s License (CDL) for operating agricultural transport vehicles, grain trucks, or heavy equipment on public roads, as regulated by FMCSA.']
  requires_gap_training boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position requires completion of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) training as part of USDA GAP/GHP certification requirements and FSMA Produce Safety Rule compliance. Applicable to field workers, supervisors, and food handling personnel.']
  requires_haccp_certification boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position requires HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) food safety certification, applicable to roles in food processing, packing, and quality assurance functions subject to FDA FSMA and USDA FSIS regulations.']
  requires_osha_certification varchar [note: 'Specifies the OSHA safety training certification required for this position: OSHA 10-hour General Industry or Construction, OSHA 30-hour for supervisory roles, OSHA Agriculture standard (29 CFR Part 1928), or none required. Used for workforce compliance tracking and training planning.']
  requires_pesticide_license boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position requires a valid state-issued pesticide applicator license as mandated by the EPA Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) and state pesticide regulations. Positions such as Pesticide Applicator and Crop Protection Specialist typically require this certification.']
  seasonal_end_month varchar [note: 'Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically conclude staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition duration, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop harvest completion and post-harvest handling.']
  seasonal_start_month varchar [note: 'Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically begin staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition timing, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop planting and harvest cycles.']
  soc_code varchar [note: 'U.S. Department of Labor Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code assigned to this position, required for DOL H-2A job order filings, OSHA recordkeeping, and USDA labor compliance reporting (e.g., 45-2041 for Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products).']
  title varchar [note: 'Official human-readable job title for the position as it appears in organizational charts, offer letters, and DOL H-2A job order filings (e.g., Field Crew Supervisor, Pesticide Applicator, Irrigation Technician, Livestock Handler, Grain Elevator Operator, Food Safety Auditor).']
  transportation_provided boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided transportation between housing and the worksite, as required under DOL H-2A regulations for guest worker positions and migrant labor compliance.']
  union_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) applicable to this position, if any. Used for wage rate determination, benefit entitlement, and labor relations compliance tracking.']
  wbs_element varchar [note: 'SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code for project-based labor cost allocation, used when the position supports specific capital projects (CAPEX) such as facility construction, irrigation system installation, or precision agriculture technology deployment.']
  work_schedule_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the standard work schedule pattern for this position, distinguishing between standard daytime schedules, rotating shifts for processing facilities, seasonally variable hours common in agricultural operations, on-call arrangements, and piece-rate flexible schedules.']

  Note: 'Authorized headcount positions within the agricultural enterprise organizational structure, including job classification taxonomy. Defines each budgeted role — field crew supervisor, pesticide applicator, irrigation technician, livestock handler, grain elevator operator, food safety auditor — including position code, job family (agronomy, livestock, equipment operations, food processing, administration), pay grade band, FTE allocation, FLSA exemption status, DOL occupational classification (SOC code), H-2A eligible flag, minimum wage tier, physical demands rating, required certifications (pesticide applicator license, OSHA 10/30, HACCP), organizational unit assignment, and the farm operation or processing facility to which the position belongs. SSOT for position definition and job classification taxonomy. Supports workforce planning, DOL H-2A job order filings, USDA labor compliance, and labor cost allocation.'

Business justification: H-2A labor contracts are filed under a specific legal entity for DOL job order purposes, workers\' comp coverage, and surety bond requirements. Multi-entity ag operations need entity-level contract tra']

  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary farm, facility, or processing plant where the contracted worker is assigned to perform duties.']
  farm_unit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: H-2A labor contracts must identify the specific agricultural establishment (farm unit) where workers will be employed — a DOL regulatory requirement. Farm-unit-level contract tracking enables complian']

  contract_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the labor contract. Draft: being prepared; active: currently in force; suspended: temporarily halted; terminated: ended before expiry; expired: reached end date; pending_approval: awaiting DOL or management authorization.']
  contract_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the labor agreement governing the engagement. Values: permanent (year-round direct employment), seasonal (fixed-season direct hire), h2a_temporary (H-2A temporary agricultural worker visa contract), collective_bargaining (CBA — union-negotiated agreement), flc_agreement (Farm Labor Contractor mediated agreement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|seasonal|h2a_temporary|collective_bargaining|flc_agreement|piece_rate|apprenticeship — promote to reference product]']

  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the labor contract is scheduled to end. Nullable for permanent open-ended employment contracts. For H-2A contracts, must not exceed 3 years per DOL regulations.']
  gap_training_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the worker has completed required Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) food safety training as mandated by FSMA Produce Safety Rule for workers handling covered produce. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. and SQF certification compliance.']
  guaranteed_hours_per_week decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum number of work hours per week guaranteed to the worker under the contract. For H-2A contracts, DOL requires a three-fourths guarantee (75% of the total hours in the contract period). Critical for H-2A compliance and wage obligation calculations.']
  h2a_petition_number varchar [note: 'USCIS petition number (Form I-129) associated with the H-2A temporary agricultural worker visa application. Enables traceability from the labor contract to the immigration filing. Null for non-H-2A contracts.']
  housing_address varchar [note: 'Physical address of the employer-provided housing facility for H-2A workers. Required for DOL job order disclosure and OSHA housing inspection compliance. Null when housing_provided is False.']
  housing_provided boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employer is obligated to provide free housing to the worker under the contract terms. Mandatory for H-2A contracts where workers are not reasonably able to return to their residence each day. Compliance requirement under DOL H-2A regulations.']
  i9_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the worker\'s employment eligibility has been verified via USCIS Form I-9 (Employment Eligibility Verification). Mandatory for all U.S. employers under the Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA). Must be True before contract activation.']
  inbound_transport_reimbursed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employer reimburses the worker for inbound travel costs from the worker\'s home country or state of recruitment to the worksite. Mandatory reimbursement obligation under H-2A regulations after 50% of the contract period is completed.']
  job_title varchar [note: 'The official job title or position designation as stated in the labor contract (e.g., Crop Harvester, Irrigation Technician, Pesticide Applicator, Farm Laborer). Must match the DOL job order description for H-2A contracts.']
  osha_safety_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the worker holds a current OSHA safety certification relevant to agricultural operations (e.g., OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour General Industry or Construction card). Supports OSHA compliance tracking and incident prevention.']
  pesticide_applicator_license varchar [note: 'State-issued pesticide applicator license number for workers authorized to apply restricted-use pesticides (RUP). Required by EPA and state lead agencies under FIFRA. Null for workers not performing pesticide application duties.']
  season_type varchar [note: 'The agricultural season or operational phase for which the worker is contracted. Drives workforce planning cycles in Granular Farm Management and aligns with crop calendar scheduling.']
  signed_date date [note: 'The date on which the labor contract was formally signed by both the employer and the worker (or their authorized representative). Required for legal enforceability and DOL H-2A job order documentation.']
  soc_code varchar [note: 'Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code for the contracted job role. Required on DOL H-2A job orders to classify the agricultural occupation (e.g., 45-2092 for Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse).']
  termination_date date [note: 'Actual date the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date (scheduled end). Populated only when a contract is ended before its scheduled expiration.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for early contract termination. Required for H-2A compliance reporting to DOL when a worker departs before the contract end date. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|involuntary_termination|contract_completion|mutual_agreement|abandonment|visa_revocation|death|disability — promote to reference product]']
  total_contract_hours decimal(8,2) [note: 'Total number of work hours specified for the entire contract period. Used to calculate the three-fourths guarantee obligation for H-2A contracts and for labor cost budgeting in Granular Farm Management.']
  transportation_provided boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employer is obligated to provide or reimburse transportation costs for the worker. For H-2A contracts, employers must provide or pay for inbound and outbound transportation and daily transportation between housing and worksite.']
  union_code varchar [note: 'Identifier for the labor union or worker organization representing the employee under a collective bargaining agreement (e.g., UFW — United Farm Workers, UFCW — United Food and Commercial Workers). Null for non-union workers.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the labor contract record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail requirements under SOX and FSMA.']
  visa_type varchar [note: 'Immigration visa classification under which the worker is authorized to work in the United States. H-2A is the primary temporary agricultural worker visa. Drives compliance obligations and documentation requirements.']
  wage_rate decimal(10,4) [note: 'The agreed-upon base wage rate for the worker as specified in the labor contract. For H-2A contracts, must meet or exceed the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) published annually by DOL. Used for payroll processing and compliance audits.']
  wage_rate_unit varchar [note: 'The unit of measure for the contracted wage rate. Hourly is most common for H-2A and seasonal workers; piece_rate applies to harvest workers paid per unit of crop harvested (e.g., per bin, per bushel).']
  work_duties_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the specific agricultural duties, tasks, and responsibilities the worker is contracted to perform. Must be disclosed in the DOL job order for H-2A contracts per FSMA Worker Protection Rule requirements.']

  Note: 'Employment and labor agreements governing workforce engagement — individual employment contracts, collective bargaining agreements (CBA), H-2A temporary agricultural worker contracts, and seasonal labor agreements with farm labor contractors (FLC). Captures contract type, effective dates, wage rates, housing and transportation obligations (H-2A), work location, hours guarantees, and DOL job order reference number. Critical for H-2A compliance and FSMA worker protection rule adherence.'

  pay_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which the employee is paid. Determines pay period boundaries and is critical for H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations and FLSA overtime compliance.']
  pay_period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the payroll processing period. Defines the boundary for wage calculations, overtime determination, and H-2A three-fourths guarantee assessment.']
  pay_period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the payroll processing period. Used for DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation.']
  pay_type varchar [note: 'The compensation structure applied to this payroll record. Piece-rate is common for harvest operations; hourly applies to FLSA overtime calculations; salary for permanent staff.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date on which wages were disbursed to the employee. Required for DOL wage payment timeliness compliance and state wage payment law adherence.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is standard; check and pay card are common for seasonal and H-2A workers without bank accounts.']
  payroll_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the payroll record within the SAP SuccessFactors payroll processing lifecycle, from initial calculation through final payment or reversal.']
  piece_rate_earnings decimal(12,2) [note: 'Total earnings derived from piece-rate compensation (harvest pay) for the pay period, calculated as piece_rate_units multiplied by piece_rate_per_unit. Supports harvest labor cost analysis.']

  certification_received boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required supporting certification documentation has been received (e.g., DOL WH-380 medical certification for FMLA, military orders for military leave, jury summons for jury duty). True = certification on file.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System audit timestamp recording when the leave request record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage and Silver layer audit requirements.']
  decision_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time the supervisor or HR rendered a final approval or denial decision on the leave request. FMLA requires written notice within 5 business days of the eligibility determination (29 CFR 825.300).']
  denial_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation provided by the supervisor or HR when a leave request is denied or partially denied. Required for FMLA denial notices (29 CFR 825.300) and supports employee grievance and appeal processes. Null when approval_status is not \'denied\'.']
  fmla_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria at the time of the request: 12 months of employment and 1,250 hours worked in the preceding 12-month lookback period at a covered employer location (50+ employees within 75 miles). True = eligible; False = not eligible.']
  fmla_entitlement_used_days decimal(6,2) [note: 'Cumulative FMLA leave days consumed by the employee in the current 12-month FMLA measurement period prior to this request. The FMLA entitlement is 12 weeks (84 calendar days) per year; military caregiver leave allows up to 26 weeks.']
  fmla_hours_worked_lookback decimal(7,2) [note: 'Total hours worked by the employee in the 12-month period immediately preceding the leave request date, used to determine FMLA eligibility (threshold: 1,250 hours). Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors time and attendance records.']
  h2a_contract_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this leave request involves an H-2A visa worker and may impact the three-fourths guarantee calculation (the employer\'s obligation to offer at least 75% of the contracted work hours). True = H-2A contract obligations are affected by this leave.']
  h2a_early_departure_date date [note: 'For H-2A visa workers requesting early departure before contract completion, the date the worker intends to depart. Used to calculate the impact on the three-fourths guarantee and to initiate contract completion documentation with APHIS/DOL.']
  harvest_critical_window boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the requested leave dates fall within a designated harvest-critical or planting-critical operational window where discretionary leave approvals may be restricted due to operational necessity. Populated from the farm operations calendar. True = leave overlaps a critical window.']
  intermittent_frequency varchar [note: 'Describes the expected frequency and duration of intermittent leave episodes as certified by a healthcare provider (e.g., \'2 episodes per month, 1-3 days each\'). Required for scheduling and FMLA certification documentation when is_intermittent = True.']
  is_intermittent boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently or on a reduced schedule rather than as a continuous block. Common for chronic conditions under FMLA. True = intermittent/reduced schedule; False = continuous leave block.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System audit timestamp recording the most recent update to the leave request record. Tracks amendments, status changes, and date modifications throughout the leave lifecycle.']
  leave_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative or coded reason provided by the employee for the leave request (e.g., serious health condition, childbirth, family care, military deployment, bereavement). Treated as confidential HR data. For FMLA leaves, this field supports the qualifying reason determination per 29 CFR Part 825.']
  leave_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the leave request by policy category. Covers FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), state-mandated paid sick leave, personal leave, vacation/PTO (Paid Time Off), bereavement, jury duty, military leave, H-2A early departure, and agricultural seasonal layoff. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|paid_sick|personal|vacation_pto|bereavement|jury_duty|military|h2a_early_departure|seasonal_layoff — promote to reference product]']
  medical_clearance_received boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required fitness-for-duty or medical clearance documentation has been received from the employee prior to return to work. True = clearance documentation received and on file.']
  medical_clearance_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employee must provide a fitness-for-duty certification from a healthcare provider before returning to work. Applicable for FMLA medical leaves and roles with physical demands (e.g., pesticide applicators, equipment operators). True = clearance required.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for HR or supervisor comments, special accommodations, or additional context related to the leave request. May include ADA accommodation notes or operational coverage arrangements. Treated as confidential HR data.']
  pay_impact_type varchar [note: 'Indicates the payroll treatment for the approved leave period. Determines whether the employee receives full pay, no pay, partial pay, state-mandated paid leave benefits, or short-term disability benefits during the absence. Drives payroll processing in SAP S/4HANA Payroll.']
  request_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the leave request (e.g., LR-2024-000123). Used in employee communications, HR correspondence, and compliance documentation.']
  requested_days decimal(6,2) [note: 'Total number of calendar or working days requested by the employee, as submitted. Supports FMLA 12-week entitlement tracking and H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations. Decimal to accommodate partial-day requests.']
  requested_end_date date [note: 'The date the employee requested their leave to end, as submitted in the original leave request. May differ from the approved end date.']
  requested_start_date date [note: 'The date the employee requested their leave to begin, as submitted in the original leave request. May differ from the approved start date if the supervisor modifies the leave window.']
  return_to_work_date date [note: 'The actual or expected date the employee is scheduled to return to active duty following the leave. Critical for labor scheduling during planting and harvest windows. May be updated if leave is extended.']
  seasonal_layoff_rehire_date date [note: 'For seasonal agricultural workers on planned layoff, the anticipated rehire or recall date for the next growing season. Supports seasonal workforce availability forecasting and rehire eligibility tracking in SAP SuccessFactors.']
  submission_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time the employee formally submitted the leave request in the system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle. Used to measure HR response time KPIs and FMLA notice compliance (29 CFR 825.302).']
  successfactors_absence_code varchar [note: 'The native absence record identifier from SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management module. Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the Databricks Silver layer and the system of record for HR audit and payroll integration.']
  work_location_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the farm unit, processing facility, or operational site where the employee is assigned at the time of the leave request. Used for labor scheduling impact analysis by location and for state-specific leave law applicability determination.']

  Note: 'Employee leave and absence management records covering FMLA (including intermittent leave for chronic conditions), state-mandated paid sick leave, personal leave, vacation/PTO, bereavement, jury duty, military leave, agricultural seasonal layoff periods, and H-2A worker early departure or contract completion requests. Captures leave type, requested start/end dates, approved start/end dates, leave reason, FMLA eligibility flag (12-month/1,250-hour lookback), intermittent leave flag, approval status, approving supervisor, return-to-work date, and medical clearance flag. Tracks harvest-critical leave restriction windows where operational necessity may limit discretionary leave approvals, H-2A early departure impact on three-fourths guarantee calculations, and seasonal layoff-to-rehire cycles. SSOT for all employee absence and leave data. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management and supports FMLA compliance, labor scheduling during critical planting and harvest windows, and seasonal workforce availability forecasting.'
}

  wps_handler_training_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether crew members require EPA Worker Protection Standard pesticide handler training. Mandatory for spray crews and any crew working in fields during or after pesticide application within the REI window.']

  Note: 'Master record for agricultural work crews and gangs — the fundamental operational unit for field labor deployment in row crop, specialty crop, and livestock operations. Captures crew code, crew name, crew type (planting crew, harvest crew, spray crew, irrigation team, livestock handling team, packing line crew, equipment maintenance team), assigned supervisor/crew leader (employee reference), home farm operation or facility, default shift pattern, target crew size, current active member count, active status, seasonal validity start/end dates, and primary language spoken. Crews are the primary unit of labor scheduling, field assignment, productivity tracking, and piece-rate pay calculation in agricultural operations. SSOT for crew identity and composition. Supports H-2A crew-based housing and transportation management, piece-rate pay calculations by crew, DOL crew disclosure requirements under MSPA, and crew-level safety briefing documentation. Crew membership is tracked via employee-to-crew assignment with effective dates to support seasonal rotation and mid-season crew reassignment.'
}

Table workforce.shift {
  shift_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for shift']
  facility_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the facility, farm, or processing plant where this shift operates. Used for location-based workforce planning.']
  org_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the department or operational unit responsible for this shift. Used for organizational reporting and labor allocation.']
  parent_shift_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on shift (parent_shift_id)']
  position_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the role or position responsible for supervising this shift. Used for accountability and escalation.']
  break_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total allocated break time within the shift in minutes. Includes meal breaks and rest periods as required by labor regulations.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Financial accounting code for labor cost allocation. Used to track shift-related expenses to specific farm operations, processing facilities, or business units.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this shift record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the shift purpose, responsibilities, and operational context. Used for workforce communication and training.']
  duration_hours decimal(5,2) [note: 'Total duration of the shift in hours, including any built-in break periods. Used for labor cost calculation and compliance tracking.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date when this shift definition is retired or replaced. Null for currently active shifts. Supports historical tracking.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date when this shift definition becomes active and available for scheduling. Supports shift configuration versioning.']
  end_time varchar [note: 'Standard end time for the shift in HH:mm format (24-hour clock). Represents the scheduled conclusion of the work period.']
  h2a_visa_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shift is eligible for H-2A temporary agricultural workers under U.S. Department of Labor regulations. Critical for migrant labor compliance.']
  hazard_level varchar [note: 'Risk classification for this shift based on exposure to hazards (machinery, chemicals, weather, livestock). Used for safety planning and insurance.']
  labor_category varchar [note: 'Classification of labor type for cost accounting. Direct labor is production-related, indirect supports operations, administrative is overhead, supervisory is management.']
  maximum_crew_size varchar [note: 'Maximum number of workers that can be accommodated during this shift based on facility capacity, equipment availability, or operational constraints.']
  minimum_crew_size varchar [note: 'Minimum number of workers required to operate this shift safely and effectively. Used for workforce planning and scheduling.']
  modified_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that last modified this shift record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this shift record was last updated. Used for change tracking and synchronization with SAP SuccessFactors.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional operational notes, special instructions, or scheduling considerations for this shift. Free-text field for planners and supervisors.']
  overtime_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether hours worked during this shift qualify for overtime compensation under labor regulations.']
  paid_break_minutes varchar [note: 'Portion of break time that is compensated. Used for payroll calculation and labor cost allocation.']
  required_certifications varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of required certifications or licenses for workers assigned to this shift (e.g., Pesticide Applicator License, Forklift Certification, HACCP, GAP). Used for compliance verification.']
  safety_training_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether workers must complete specific safety training before being assigned to this shift. Used for OSHA compliance and risk management.']
  season_end_date date [note: 'Last date this shift is active for seasonal operations. Null for year-round shifts.']
  season_start_date date [note: 'First date this shift becomes active for seasonal operations. Null for year-round shifts.']
  seasonal_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shift is only active during specific seasons or harvest periods. Used for workforce planning and H-2A visa scheduling.']
  shift_category varchar [note: 'Operational category indicating the primary work area or function for this shift.']
  shift_code varchar [note: 'Business identifier code for the shift (e.g., DAY1, NIGHT, HARVEST-A). Used for external reference and scheduling systems.']
  shift_differential_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Additional pay rate multiplier or percentage applied to this shift (e.g., 1.15 for 15% night differential). Used for payroll calculation.']
  shift_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the shift (e.g., Morning Shift, Night Harvest, Processing Day Shift).']
  shift_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the shift based on operational purpose. Regular for standard operations, seasonal for peak periods, harvest for crop collection, processing for facility operations, maintenance for equipment service, emergency for unplanned needs.']
  start_time varchar [note: 'Standard start time for the shift in HH:mm format (24-hour clock). Represents the scheduled beginning of the work period.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the shift. Active shifts are available for scheduling, inactive are temporarily disabled, suspended are on hold pending review, archived are historical records.']
  weather_dependent_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this shift is subject to cancellation or modification based on weather conditions (e.g., field harvest shifts).']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User or system identifier that created this shift record. Used for accountability and audit purposes.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for shift. Referenced by shift_id.'
}

  normal_balance varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry bookkeeping rules.   sort_key varchar [note: 'Three-digit code that determines the assignment field populated in line items posted to this GL account (e.g., 001=posting date, 003=document number, 009=external document number, 014=assignment field).   tax_category varchar [note: 'Specifies the tax relevance of the GL account for input/output tax determination (e.g., input tax, output tax, not tax-relevant, tax-exempt).   Note: 'General Ledger (GL) chart of accounts master — the authoritative SSOT for all GL account definitions across the agricultural enterprise.   Note: 'Tax transaction and compliance record capturing tax postings, filings, and obligations for the agricultural enterprise including sales tax, use tax, excise tax on agricultural chemicals, property tax on farmland, income tax provisions, and agricultural-specific exemptions (farm fuel tax credits, ag sales tax exemptions). Table finance.commodity_hedge {

  farm_unit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: Commodity hedges are placed to protect anticipated production from specific farm operations. ASC 815 hedge effectiveness testing requires matching hedges to the hedged item (anticipated crop productio']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'FK to finance.gl_account']
  herd_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: Livestock producers place live cattle and feeder cattle futures hedges against specific herds for price risk management. Linking commodity_hedge to herd enables hedge effectiveness testing, P&L attrib']

  basis_risk_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The monetary value of the basis differential between the local cash price and the exchange-traded futures price for the hedged commodity. Represents residual price risk not eliminated by the hedge. Critical metric in agricultural commodity marketing and grain merchandising.']
  broker_account_number varchar [note: 'The account number assigned by the futures commission merchant (FCM) or broker for the trading account under which this hedge position is held. Used for margin account reconciliation and position reporting.']
  contract_expiration_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the futures or options contract expires or the forward contract matures. Used for position management, roll scheduling, and hedge effectiveness testing timelines.']
  contract_month varchar [note: 'The delivery/expiration month of the futures or options contract expressed in standard exchange notation (e.g., Z24 = December 2024, H25 = March 2025). Critical for managing basis risk and roll strategy in agricultural commodity marketing.']
  counterparty_name varchar [note: 'The name of the broker, dealer, or OTC counterparty for the hedging instrument. For exchange-traded instruments, this is typically the futures commission merchant (FCM) or clearing broker. For OTC forwards, this is the counterparty financial institution or grain merchandiser.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this commodity hedge record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and hedge accounting documentation per ASC 815/IFRS 9.']
  effectiveness_test_date date [note: 'The date on which the most recent hedge effectiveness test was performed. Required for hedge accounting documentation and SOX audit trail.']
  effectiveness_test_method varchar [note: 'The methodology used to assess hedge effectiveness as required by ASC 815/IFRS 9. \'dollar_offset\' compares changes in fair value; \'regression\' uses statistical analysis; \'hypothetical_derivative\' compares to a perfect hedge; \'critical_terms_match\' applies when key terms of hedging instrument and hedged item match.']
  effectiveness_test_result varchar [note: 'The outcome of the most recent hedge effectiveness assessment. \'highly_effective\' qualifies for hedge accounting treatment (80-125% offset range per ASC 815); \'ineffective\' requires de-designation and P&L recognition of ineffective portion; \'not_tested\' for instruments not yet assessed.']
  exchange_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the exchange on which the futures or options contract is traded. CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange) for livestock; CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade) for grains and oilseeds; ICE (Intercontinental Exchange) for cotton and sugar; NYMEX for energy-related agricultural inputs.']
  forward_price decimal(18,6) [note: 'For forward contracts, the agreed-upon price at which the commodity will be bought or sold at the future settlement date. Expressed in currency per unit of measure. Null for exchange-traded futures and options.']
  futures_price_at_entry decimal(18,6) [note: 'The exchange-quoted futures price at the time the hedge position was established. Used as the reference price for basis calculation (local cash price minus futures price) and hedge effectiveness testing.']
  hedge_designation varchar [note: 'Formal hedge accounting designation per ASC 815 (US GAAP) or IFRS 9. \'fair_value\' hedges offset changes in fair value of a recognized asset/liability; \'cash_flow\' hedges offset variability in future cash flows; \'net_investment\' hedges offset foreign currency exposure in net investments; \'not_designated\' instruments are economic hedges not qualifying for hedge accounting treatment.']
  hedge_end_date date [note: 'The date on which the hedge relationship is expected to end or was terminated. Used for hedge accounting de-designation and effectiveness testing period boundaries.']
  hedge_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the hedging instrument, typically assigned by the treasury management system or SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM module (e.g., HDG-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.']
  hedge_ratio decimal(8,4) [note: 'The proportion of the hedged item\'s exposure covered by the hedging instrument, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% coverage). Required for hedge accounting documentation under ASC 815/IFRS 9 and used in hedge effectiveness testing.']
  hedge_start_date date [note: 'The date on which the hedge relationship formally begins for hedge accounting purposes per ASC 815/IFRS 9. May differ from trade_date if formal designation documentation is completed after execution.']
  hedge_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the hedging instrument. \'open\' indicates an active position; \'closed\' indicates the position has been offset or settled; \'expired\' indicates the contract reached maturity; \'cancelled\' indicates early termination; \'pending_designation\' indicates awaiting formal hedge accounting designation per ASC 815/IFRS 9.']
  hedged_item_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific exposure or hedged item being protected by this instrument (e.g., \'Forecasted corn purchase Q3 2024 - 500,000 BU\', \'Soybean inventory held at Decatur elevator\'). Required for hedge accounting documentation under ASC 815/IFRS 9.']
  initial_margin_required decimal(18,4) [note: 'The initial margin deposit required by the exchange clearinghouse when the futures position is established. Expressed in the transaction currency. Monitored daily against margin calls for cash flow management.']
  instrument_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the hedging instrument. \'futures\' are standardized exchange-traded contracts; \'options\' grant the right but not obligation to buy/sell at a strike price; \'forward\' contracts are OTC bilateral agreements at a fixed forward price; \'swap\' contracts exchange cash flows based on commodity price differentials.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this commodity hedge record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  mark_to_market_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'The current fair value of the hedging instrument based on the latest available market price. Positive values indicate an unrealized gain; negative values indicate an unrealized loss. Updated daily for exchange-traded instruments per GAAP/IFRS fair value measurement requirements.']
  mtm_valuation_date date [note: 'The date as of which the mark-to-market value was last calculated. Ensures financial reporting accuracy and supports period-end close processes in SAP S/4HANA FI.']
  notional_quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total quantity of the underlying commodity covered by the hedging instrument. Expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the commodity (e.g., bushels for grain, hundredweight for livestock, metric tons for oilseeds). Drives exposure calculation and hedge ratio determination.']
  number_of_contracts varchar [note: 'The count of standardized exchange contracts comprising the hedge position. Each exchange contract represents a fixed notional quantity (e.g., 5,000 BU per CBOT corn contract). Used for margin calculation and position limit monitoring.']
  option_premium_paid decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total premium paid to acquire an options contract, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the maximum loss exposure for long option positions. Recorded as an asset under ASC 815/IFRS 9 hedge accounting. Null for futures and forward contracts.']
  option_type varchar [note: 'For options instruments, specifies whether the contract is a call option (right to buy) or put option (right to sell) the underlying commodity. \'not_applicable\' for futures and forward contracts. Agricultural producers typically purchase put options to establish price floors.']
  quantity_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit of measure for the notional quantity. BU (Bushel) for grains; MT (Metric Ton) for oilseeds and international contracts; CWT (Hundredweight) for livestock; LB (Pound) for cotton and sugar; TON for domestic bulk commodities.']
  realized_gain_loss decimal(18,4) [note: 'The actual gain or loss recognized upon closing, expiration, or settlement of the hedging instrument. Positive values indicate a gain; negative values indicate a loss. Recorded to the appropriate P&L or OCI account per ASC 815/IFRS 9 hedge accounting treatment.']
  settlement_date date [note: 'The date on which the hedging instrument was or is expected to be settled. For closed/expired positions, the actual settlement date. For open positions, the expected settlement date based on contract terms.']
  settlement_type varchar [note: 'The method by which the contract is settled at expiration. \'cash\' settlement uses the final settlement price without physical delivery; \'physical_delivery\' requires delivery of the actual commodity; \'offset\' indicates the position was closed by an opposing trade before expiration.']
  strike_price decimal(18,6) [note: 'For options contracts, the price at which the holder has the right to buy (call) or sell (put) the underlying commodity. Expressed in the currency per unit of measure (e.g., USD per bushel). Null for futures and forward contracts.']
  trade_date date [note: 'The date on which the hedging instrument was executed or entered into. Represents the principal business event date for the hedge transaction, used for mark-to-market valuation and hedge accounting documentation.']
  transaction_currency varchar [note: 'The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the hedge instrument is denominated (e.g., USD for CME/CBOT contracts, GBP for ICE London contracts). Used for multi-currency consolidation and IFRS/GAAP foreign currency translation.']
  variation_margin_balance decimal(18,4) [note: 'The cumulative daily settlement amount reflecting gains and losses on the futures position since inception. Positive indicates net gains credited to the margin account; negative indicates net losses debited. Critical for daily cash flow management and liquidity planning.']

  Note: 'Commodity price hedging instrument record capturing futures contracts, options, and forward contracts used to manage price risk for agricultural commodities including grain (corn, wheat, soybeans), oilseeds, cotton, sugar, and livestock (feeder cattle, lean hogs). Captures hedge ID, commodity type, instrument type (futures, options, forward), exchange (CME, CBOT, ICE), contract month, notional quantity (BU/MT/CWT), strike/forward price, premium paid, hedge designation (fair value, cash flow per ASC 815/IFRS 9), effectiveness test result, mark-to-market value, margin requirements, and settlement status. Essential for managing basis risk between local cash prices and exchange-traded futures in agricultural marketing.'
}
