Table finance.loan {
  loan_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each loan or credit facility record in the agricultural enterprise debt portfolio.']
  bank_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Loans are disbursed to and repaid from specific bank accounts. Linking loan to bank_account enables cash management integration, showing which bank account receives loan proceeds and from which accoun']
  collateral_herd_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: Livestock herds are pledged as collateral for FSA operating loans and commercial lines of credit. Linking loan to herd (as collateral) supports lender reporting, collateral valuation updates, and cove']
  commodity_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: CCC commodity loans, FSA marketing assistance loans, and operating lines secured by grain inventory are tied to specific commodities. Linking commodity_id supports commodity loan balance reporting, co']
  company_code_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the legal entity (company code) under which this loan is held, supporting consolidated financial reporting per GAAP/IFRS.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the cost center responsible for servicing this loan (e.g., farm operations, equipment division). Enables interest expense allocation by business unit in SAP S/4HANA CO for EBITDA reporting.']
  farm_unit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: FSA operating loans and farm lines of credit are issued to specific farm operations. Farm financial managers track debt-to-asset ratios and loan covenants by farm unit. FSA loan number on loan table m']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: loan has gl_account_code as a STRING. Loan balances and interest are posted to specific GL accounts (long-term debt, interest expense). Normalizing to a FK to gl_account links the loan to the authorit']
  parcel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to land.parcel. Business justification: Agricultural real estate loans and FSA guaranteed loans are collateralized against specific parcels. Lenders and farm financial managers track which parcels secure which loans for lien management, tit']
  parent_loan_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on loan (parent_loan_id)']
  accrued_interest_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Interest expense accrued since the last payment date but not yet paid. Required for period-end accrual journal entries in SAP S/4HANA FI and accurate EBITDA reporting.']
  available_credit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Undrawn portion of the credit facility available for future draws (credit_limit_amount minus outstanding_balance). Critical for seasonal liquidity planning and crop input purchasing decisions.']
  capex_opex_indicator varchar [note: 'Classifies the loan proceeds as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX — land, equipment, infrastructure), Operational Expenditure (OPEX — seasonal inputs, operating costs), or mixed. Drives GL account assignment and financial statement classification.']
  collateral_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific assets pledged as collateral (e.g., \'Section 14 T2N R5E 320 acres farmland\', \'John Deere 8R 410 tractor SN XXXXXXX\'). Supports lien filing and asset encumbrance management.']
  collateral_type varchar [note: 'Primary category of assets pledged as security for the loan. Agricultural loans are commonly secured by farmland, equipment, standing crops, or livestock. Drives lender risk assessment and asset encumbrance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: land|equipment|crop|livestock|accounts_receivable|blanket_lien — promote to reference product]']
  collateral_valuation_date date [note: 'Date on which the collateral was most recently appraised or valued. Lenders typically require periodic revaluation; this date triggers renewal workflows.']
  collateral_value_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Appraised or estimated market value of the pledged collateral at the most recent valuation date. Used to calculate loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and assess collateral coverage adequacy.']
  covenant_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current compliance state with respect to all financial covenants on this loan. A breach status triggers escalation to CFO and legal counsel and may require SOX disclosure. Monitored at each period close.']
  covenant_description varchar [note: 'Summary of key financial covenants attached to the loan agreement (e.g., minimum current ratio of 1.25:1, maximum debt-to-asset ratio of 0.50, minimum working capital of $500,000). Covenant breaches can trigger acceleration clauses.']
  covenant_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent covenant compliance review or test. Lenders typically require quarterly or annual covenant testing; this date drives the next review scheduling.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this loan record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  credit_limit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum authorized borrowing capacity under a revolving line of credit or operating line. Applicable to operating lines and seasonal crop production facilities. Null for fully-drawn term loans.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this loan record (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency consolidation in IFRS reporting.']
  draw_period_end_date date [note: 'Last date on which the borrower may draw funds under a revolving credit facility or operating line of credit. After this date, the facility enters repayment-only mode. Specific to revolving and seasonal crop production lines.']
  fsa_guarantee_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the loan principal guaranteed by the USDA Farm Service Agency under the Business and Industry (B&I) or Farm Loan Programs (e.g., 90.00 = 90%). Null for non-guaranteed loans. Reduces lender risk and may affect interest rate terms.']
  fsa_loan_number varchar [note: 'USDA Farm Service Agency assigned loan identifier for FSA direct or guaranteed loans. Required for federal program reporting, subsidy tracking, and USDA compliance filings. Null for non-FSA loans.']
  interest_rate decimal(8,5) [note: 'Annual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.06500 = 6.5%). For variable-rate loans, this reflects the current effective rate including the benchmark plus spread. Used for interest expense accrual in SAP S/4HANA CO and EBITDA reporting.']
  interest_rate_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the interest rate is fixed for the loan term, variable (tied to a benchmark such as SOFR or Prime Rate), or hybrid (fixed for an initial period then variable). Drives interest expense forecasting and hedge accounting decisions.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this loan record. Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit trail requirements.']
  lender_name varchar [note: 'Name of the lending institution providing the debt facility (e.g., Farm Credit Services of America, Rabobank, Wells Fargo Agribusiness, USDA Farm Service Agency). Essential for counterparty risk management and lender relationship tracking.']
  lender_type varchar [note: 'Category of the lending institution. Farm Credit institutions are government-sponsored enterprises; FSA loans carry federal guarantees; commercial banks and cooperatives operate under standard banking regulations. Informs interest rate benchmarking and covenant expectations.']
  loan_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known loan reference number assigned by the lender (e.g., Farm Credit loan number, commercial bank reference, FSA loan number). Used for lender correspondence and payment remittances.']
  loan_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the loan. Drives financial reporting classifications (current vs. non-current debt), covenant monitoring, and SOX control checkpoints.']
  loan_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the debt instrument. Operating lines of credit fund seasonal inputs; term loans finance equipment or land; FSA guaranteed loans are backed by the USDA Farm Service Agency; crop production loans are secured against future harvest revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_line_of_credit|term_loan|fsa_guaranteed|crop_production|equipment_loan|real_estate_mortgage — promote to reference product]']
  maturity_date date [note: 'Contractual date on which the full outstanding principal and any accrued interest are due. Drives current vs. non-current debt classification on the balance sheet and triggers covenant review processes.']
  next_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of the next scheduled payment including both principal and interest components. Supports cash flow planning and AP payment run preparation in SAP S/4HANA.']
  next_payment_date date [note: 'Date on which the next scheduled principal or interest payment is due to the lender. Used for cash flow forecasting, AP payment scheduling in SAP S/4HANA, and covenant compliance monitoring.']
  origination_date date [note: 'Date the loan agreement was executed and funds were first made available. Establishes the start of the amortization schedule and the effective date for interest accrual. Aligns with GAAP ASC 470 initial recognition.']
  outstanding_balance decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current unpaid principal balance as of the last payment or draw event. Critical for balance sheet reporting, debt covenant compliance monitoring, and EBITDA-to-debt ratio calculations.']
  payment_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency of principal and/or interest payments. Agricultural loans often use seasonal or annual schedules aligned with harvest revenue cycles rather than standard monthly amortization.']
  principal_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Original face value of the loan at origination. Used as the baseline for amortization schedules, interest calculations, and CAPEX/OPEX debt tracking in SAP S/4HANA FI.']
  purpose_description varchar [note: 'Business purpose for which the loan proceeds are used (e.g., \'Purchase of 640-acre irrigated corn ground\', \'Seasonal operating inputs for 2024 corn/soybean crop\', \'John Deere combine acquisition\'). Required for CAPEX/OPEX classification and USDA program eligibility.']
  rate_benchmark varchar [note: 'Reference rate index used as the base for variable-rate loans (e.g., SOFR — Secured Overnight Financing Rate, Prime Rate, Farm Credit index). Null for fixed-rate instruments. Required for interest rate risk management and hedge effectiveness testing.']
  rate_spread_bps decimal(8,2) [note: 'Margin added to the benchmark rate expressed in basis points (e.g., 150 = 1.50%). Combined with the benchmark to derive the effective interest rate for variable-rate loans. Used in interest expense modeling and commodity hedge accounting.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this loan record was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle NetSuite, Granular Farm Management). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  sox_control_relevant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this loan is subject to SOX internal control requirements (True = in-scope for SOX 302/404 controls). Material debt instruments require documented controls over completeness, accuracy, and valuation of the liability.']

  Note: 'Loan and credit facility master tracking all debt instruments held by the agricultural enterprise including operating lines of credit, term loans for equipment/land, FSA guaranteed loans, and seasonal crop production loans. Captures loan ID, lender (Farm Credit, commercial bank, FSA), loan type, principal amount, outstanding balance, interest rate (fixed/variable), maturity date, collateral (land, equipment, crop), covenant requirements, payment schedule, and draw/repayment history. Essential for ag financial planning where seasonal borrowing against future crop revenue is standard practice.'
}

Table finance.payment_run {
  payment_run_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for payment_run']
  approved_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who approved this payment run. Ensures segregation of duties per SOX requirements.']
  bank_account_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the corporate bank account from which payments in this run will be disbursed.']
  company_code_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payment runs are executed within a legal entity context. Currently denormalized as company_code (STRING). Normalizing to company_code_id FK enables referential integrity and proper consolidation. Remo']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary cost center responsible for the payments in this run. Used for cost allocation and management reporting.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who created this payment run. Required for audit trails and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.']
  parent_payment_run_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on payment_run (parent_payment_run_id)']
  approval_workflow_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the approval workflow instance that governed the authorization process for this payment run. Supports multi-level approval requirements.']
  approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the payment run was approved by an authorized approver. Required for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance and audit trails.']
  batch_reference varchar [note: 'External batch or file reference number assigned by the banking system or payment processor when the payment file was transmitted.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this payment run record was first created in the system.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all payments in this run (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). All payment amounts within a single run must be in the same currency.']
  description varchar [note: 'Free-text description providing additional context about the purpose or scope of this payment run (e.g., \'Weekly vendor payments for harvest supplies\', \'Monthly grower settlements for corn crop\').']
  error_message varchar [note: 'System-generated error or exception message if the payment run encountered processing failures. Used for troubleshooting and operational support.']
  execution_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the payment run was executed and payments were transmitted to the banking system or payment processor.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this payment run is assigned.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year to which this payment run is assigned for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.']
  is_recurring boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payment run is part of a recurring schedule (e.g., weekly payroll, monthly rent). True if recurring, False if ad-hoc.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this payment run record was last modified.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Internal notes or comments added by treasury or accounts payable staff regarding special handling, exceptions, or other operational details.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The payment instrument or mechanism used for disbursements in this run (e.g., Automated Clearing House (ACH), wire transfer, physical check, Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT)).']
  payment_priority varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to this payment run for processing and cash management purposes. Urgent payments may require expedited approval and same-day execution.']
  payment_terms varchar [note: 'Standard payment terms applied to this run (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Immediate). Inherited from vendor master data but captured here for reporting consistency.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The accounting date on which the payment run transactions are posted to the General Ledger (GL). Used for period-end close and financial reporting.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'The date on which the payment run was reconciled with bank statements.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the payment run has been reconciled against bank statements and whether any discrepancies were identified.']
  recurrence_pattern varchar [note: 'Describes the recurrence schedule if is_recurring is True (e.g., \'Weekly on Friday\', \'Monthly on 15th\', \'Bi-weekly\'). Null for ad-hoc runs.']
  run_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the payment run, formatted as PR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trails.']
  run_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the payment run based on payee category. Determines routing, approval workflows, and compliance requirements.']
  scheduled_date date [note: 'The date on which payments in this run are scheduled to be executed. Used for cash flow planning and vendor communication.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The originating system or module that generated this payment run (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle NetSuite AP, custom grower settlement system).']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the payment run. Tracks progression from draft through approval, processing, and completion or cancellation.']
  total_deduction_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The sum of all deductions applied across payments in this run, including tax withholdings, advances, and other adjustments.']
  total_gross_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The sum of all gross payment amounts before any deductions, adjustments, or fees. Represents the total obligation to payees.']
  total_net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The sum of all net payment amounts after deductions. This is the actual cash outflow from the corporate bank account.']
  total_payment_count varchar [note: 'The total number of individual payment transactions included in this payment run.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for payment_run. Referenced by payment_run_id.'
}

Table finance.profit_center {
  profit_center_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for profit_center']
  business_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the business unit or division that owns and manages this profit center for strategic planning and performance evaluation.']
  company_code_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the legal entity company code under which this profit center operates for financial accounting purposes.']
  controlling_area_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the controlling area (CO) organizational unit that manages cost accounting and profitability analysis for this profit center.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the default cost center associated with this profit center for overhead allocation and cost tracking.']
  created_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'User identifier of the person who created this profit center record, used for audit trail and accountability.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the employee or manager who is accountable for the financial performance and operational results of this profit center.']
  last_modified_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'User identifier of the person who last modified this profit center record, used for audit trail and accountability.']
  parent_profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent profit center in the organizational hierarchy for roll-up reporting and consolidated financial analysis. Null for top-level profit centers.']
  budget_allocation_method varchar [note: 'Method used to allocate corporate overhead and shared service costs to this profit center for budgeting and variance analysis.']
  closure_date date [note: 'Actual date when this profit center was closed or deactivated, preventing further financial postings. Null if still active.']
  closure_reason varchar [note: 'Business justification or reason for closing this profit center, used for audit trail and organizational change tracking.']
  cogs_allocation_basis varchar [note: 'Basis used to allocate cost of goods sold to this profit center for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis.']
  commodity_type varchar [note: 'Primary agricultural commodity or product category that this profit center focuses on for revenue generation and cost of goods sold (COGS) allocation.']
  consolidation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center is included in consolidated financial statements and regulatory filings.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the primary country of operation for this profit center, used for tax jurisdiction and regulatory compliance.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this profit center record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the local operating currency for this profit center used in financial transactions and reporting.']
  geographic_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region or territory where this profit center operates, used for regional profitability analysis and market segmentation.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this profit center record, used for change tracking and audit compliance.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-form text field for additional business context, special instructions, or operational notes related to this profit center.']
  profit_center_code varchar [note: 'External business identifier code for the profit center used in financial reporting and consolidation. Typically alphanumeric format aligned with chart of accounts structure.']
  profit_center_hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'Numeric level in the profit center organizational hierarchy, with 1 being the top consolidated level and higher numbers representing more granular operational units.']
  profit_center_name varchar [note: 'Full business name of the profit center used for identification in financial statements and management reports.']
  profit_center_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the profit center by operational function within the agriculture business (e.g., crop production, livestock operations, processing facilities, distribution centers).']
  revenue_recognition_method varchar [note: 'Accounting method used to recognize revenue for this profit center in accordance with GAAP/IFRS standards and agriculture industry practices.']
  segment_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center represents a reportable segment under ASC 280 or IFRS 8 segment reporting requirements.']
  short_name varchar [note: 'Abbreviated name or acronym for the profit center used in condensed reports and dashboards.']
  sox_control_scope boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center is within the scope of Sarbanes-Oxley Act financial controls and audit requirements.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the profit center indicating whether it is operational and available for financial postings.']
  transfer_pricing_method varchar [note: 'Method used to price inter-company or inter-profit-center transactions for internal management reporting and tax compliance.']
  valid_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this profit center became active and available for financial postings and reporting.']
  valid_to_date date [note: 'Date until which this profit center remains active. Null indicates no planned end date. Used for historical analysis and period-based reporting.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for profit_center. Referenced by profit_center_id.'
}

Table finance.wbs_element {
  wbs_element_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for wbs_element']
  commodity_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the agricultural commodity (crop type, livestock category) for which this WBS element tracks costs. Used for COGS allocation by commodity.']
  company_code_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the legal entity company code for financial consolidation and statutory reporting per GAAP/IFRS requirements.']
  controlling_area_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the controlling area for management accounting, cost allocation, and internal reporting purposes.']
  created_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who created this WBS element record. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the employee or manager accountable for delivering the WBS element scope and managing its budget.']
  functional_area_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the functional area for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense classification per GAAP/IFRS requirements.']
  investment_program_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the multi-year investment program or capital plan to which this WBS element contributes. Used for long-term CAPEX tracking.']
  last_modified_by_user_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the user who last modified this WBS element record. Required for change tracking and SOX compliance.']
  parent_wbs_element_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent WBS element in the hierarchical project structure. Null for top-level WBS elements.']
  plant_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the agricultural production facility, processing plant, or operational site associated with this WBS element for location-based cost tracking.']
  profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the profit center for internal profitability analysis and segment reporting. Used for EBITDA and ROI tracking by business unit.']
  project_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent project to which this WBS element belongs. Links WBS element to the overarching project structure.']
  responsible_cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the cost center responsible for managing and executing activities under this WBS element. Used for cost center accounting and budget control.']
  account_assignment_element_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this WBS element can be used as an account assignment object for purchase orders, invoices, and other financial documents. True if account-assignment-relevant, False otherwise.']
  actual_cost_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total actual costs posted to this WBS element from invoices, payroll, and other financial transactions. Used for budget variance reporting.']
  applicant_name varchar [note: 'Name of the person or department who requested the creation of this WBS element. Used for audit trail and approval workflows.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when the WBS element and its budget were formally approved by authorized management. Required for SOX compliance and financial controls.']
  billing_element_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this WBS element is used as a billing element for customer invoicing. True if billing-relevant, False otherwise.']
  budget_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the WBS element budget as capital expenditure (CAPEX), operational expenditure (OPEX), or mixed for financial statement categorization.']
  committed_cost_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total amount of purchase orders and commitments issued against this WBS element but not yet invoiced. Used for funds availability checking.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this WBS element record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts associated with this WBS element. Used for multi-currency consolidation.']
  end_date date [note: 'Planned or actual completion date for activities under this WBS element. Used for project milestone tracking and schedule variance analysis.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this WBS element record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance per SOX requirements.']
  planned_budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The original approved budget amount allocated to this WBS element for planning and variance analysis purposes.']
  planning_element_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this WBS element is used for project planning and scheduling activities. True if planning-relevant, False otherwise.']
  results_analysis_key varchar [note: 'Configuration key controlling revenue recognition method and work-in-progress calculation for this WBS element per GAAP/IFRS revenue recognition standards.']
  revised_budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The current revised budget amount after approved budget changes, supplements, or reallocations. Used for current-period budget control.']
  settlement_profile varchar [note: 'Configuration key defining how costs accumulated on this WBS element are settled to receiving cost objects (assets, GL accounts, cost centers) at period-end.']
  start_date date [note: 'Planned or actual start date for activities under this WBS element. Used for project scheduling and timeline tracking.']
  statistical_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this WBS element is used only for statistical reporting purposes without actual cost postings. True if statistical, False if operational.']
  wbs_element_code varchar [note: 'The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the WBS element in project management and financial systems. Used for cost allocation and project tracking.']
  wbs_element_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the WBS element\'s scope, purpose, and deliverables within the project hierarchy.']
  wbs_element_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or title of the WBS element describing the project phase, deliverable, or cost object.']
  wbs_element_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the WBS element indicating its operational state within the project execution workflow.']
  wbs_element_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the WBS element by its functional purpose: planning (for project planning), billing (for customer invoicing), account_assignment (for cost allocation), or statistical (for reporting only).']
  wbs_level varchar [note: 'Hierarchical level of the WBS element within the project structure. Level 1 represents top-level elements, with increasing numbers for deeper nesting.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for wbs_element. Referenced by wbs_element_id.'
}

Table finance.close_calendar {
  close_calendar_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for close_calendar']
  parent_close_calendar_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on close_calendar (parent_close_calendar_id)']
  actual_close_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the close process was completed and the period was closed. Null if the period is still open or in progress.']
  adjustment_posting_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether adjustment entries (journal entries, accruals, reclassifications) are allowed during soft close or after reopening. Supports controlled close process.']
  audit_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which external audit procedures for this period were completed and the audit opinion was issued. Null if audit is not required or not yet complete.']
  audit_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this close period requires external audit review (typically true for annual and quarterly reporting periods).']
  calendar_month varchar [note: 'The calendar month (1-12) in which this close period ends. Used for calendar-year reporting alignment.']
  calendar_quarter varchar [note: 'The calendar quarter (1-4) in which this close period ends. Used for calendar-year reporting alignment.']
  calendar_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year in which this close period ends. May differ from fiscal year for organizations with non-calendar fiscal years.']
  close_due_date date [note: 'Target date by which the close process for this period must be completed. Used for close calendar planning and compliance tracking.']
  close_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the close period: open (accepting transactions), soft_close (preliminary close, limited posting allowed), hard_close (final close, restricted posting), closed (finalized, no posting), reopened (closed period reopened for adjustments), locked (permanently closed per SOX controls).']
  consolidation_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which consolidation of all entities for this period was completed. Null if consolidation is not required or not yet complete.']
  consolidation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this period requires consolidation of subsidiary and business unit financial results into consolidated financial statements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this close calendar record was first created in the system.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the close period, including any special circumstances, adjustments, or notes relevant to this period (e.g., \'Includes acquisition of XYZ Corp\', \'Restated for accounting policy change\').']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly, 1-13 for 4-4-5 calendar). Represents the sequential period within the year.']
  fiscal_quarter varchar [note: 'The fiscal quarter within the fiscal year (1, 2, 3, or 4). Null for annual or monthly periods that do not align to quarters.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year to which this close period belongs (e.g., 2024).']
  hard_close_date date [note: 'The date on which the period entered hard close status, restricting most posting activities and finalizing preliminary results.']
  is_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this close calendar record is currently active and in use. False for deprecated or historical periods no longer referenced.']
  lock_date date [note: 'The date on which the period was permanently locked, preventing any further posting or adjustments per SOX compliance requirements.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this close calendar record was last modified or updated.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional operational notes or comments related to the close process for this period, such as delays, issues encountered, or special approvals required.']
  period_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code identifying the close period, typically used in financial systems (e.g., \'2024-01\', \'Q1-2024\', \'FY2024\').']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date included in this close period. Transactions on or before this date belong to this period.']
  period_name varchar [note: 'Business-friendly name for the accounting close period (e.g., \'January 2024 Close\', \'Q1 FY2024 Close\', \'Year-End 2023\').']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date included in this close period. Transactions on or after this date belong to this period.']

  science_based_target_aligned boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the emissions reduction trajectory reflected in this assessment is aligned with a Science Based Target (SBT) approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). True = SBTi-approved target alignment confirmed.']

  scope2_emissions_co2e_mt decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total indirect greenhouse gas emissions from the generation of purchased electricity, steam, heat, or cooling consumed by the farm enterprise.   scope3_emissions_co2e_mt decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total indirect greenhouse gas emissions occurring in the value chain outside of Scope 1 and 2, including upstream inputs (fertilizers, pesticides, seeds, feed) and downstream processing, transport, and end-of-life.   total_emissions_co2e_mt decimal(18,4) [note: 'Gross total greenhouse gas emissions across all applicable scopes (Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3) for the reporting period, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT).   total_land_area_ha decimal(14,4) [note: 'Total agricultural land area in hectares covered by this carbon footprint assessment boundary. Used as the denominator for emission intensity per hectare calculations and land-use reporting.']
  uncertainty_percentage decimal(6,2) [note: 'Quantified uncertainty of the total GHG emissions inventory expressed as a percentage (±%).   updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this carbon footprint assessment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  verification_body varchar [note: 'Name of the accredited third-party organization that conducted the independent verification or assurance of the GHG emissions inventory (e.g., Bureau Veritas, SGS, DNV, SCS Global Services). Required for regulatory filings and voluntary certification claims.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the third-party verification or assurance engagement was completed and the verification statement was issued. Used for audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.']
  verification_statement_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number or document identifier of the official verification statement issued by the third-party verification body. Enables traceability to the source verification document for audit and regulatory purposes.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of independent third-party verification of the GHG emissions inventory. Distinguishes between unverified, limited assurance (review-level), and reasonable assurance (audit-level) engagements as defined by ISO 14064-3 and ISAE 3410.']

  Note: 'Master record for enterprise-level and farm-unit-level carbon footprint assessments. Captures total GHG emissions inventory (Scope 1, 2, 3) per farm unit, growing season, or enterprise reporting period. Includes baseline year, measurement methodology (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064), total CO2e tonnes, emission intensity per hectare and per tonne of commodity produced, third-party verification status, and certification body. Serves as the SSOT for carbon accounting across the agricultural enterprise.'
}

  region_name varchar [note: 'Sub-national or supra-national region name for factors with regional applicability (e.g., \'US Corn Belt\', \'US Pacific Northwest\', \'Sub-Saharan Africa\', \'Southeast Asia\').   regulatory_framework varchar [note: 'Regulatory or voluntary reporting framework for which this factor is approved or mandated (e.g., \'EPA GHG Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98\', \'USDA COMET-Farm\', \'California AB 32\', \'EU ETS\', \'GHG Protocol\', \'CDP\', \'TCFD\', \'SBTi\').   scope_category varchar [note: 'GHG Protocol scope classification indicating whether the emission is direct (Scope 1), indirect from purchased energy (Scope 2), or value chain indirect (Scope 3). Required for corporate ESG and CDP reporting.']
  soil_drainage_type varchar [note: 'Soil drainage classification relevant to N2O and CH4 emission factors for managed soils (Well-drained, Poorly-drained, Flooded, Organic). Applicable to soil-based emission factors per IPCC Tier 1 methodology.']
  source_category varchar [note: 'IPCC Activity Data source category classifying the emission source (e.g., \'3A1 - Enteric Fermentation\', \'3C4 - Direct N2O Emissions from Managed Soils\', \'1A2 - Manufacturing Industries and Construction\').   source_document_reference varchar [note: 'Specific citation or document reference for the source publication (e.g., \'IPCC 2006 Vol.4 Table 10.11\', \'EPA AP-42 Table 2.4-2\', \'USDA 2023 Ag GHG Inventory Table A-180\').   source_publication_year varchar [note: 'Calendar year in which the source document or dataset was published. Used to assess factor currency and to manage periodic updates as new IPCC or EPA guidance is released.']
  uncertainty_high_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Upper bound of the uncertainty range for this emission factor expressed as a percentage of the central factor_value (e.g., +30 for ±30% uncertainty). Required for Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis and IPCC-compliant inventory reporting.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this emission factor record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale factors and trigger recalculation workflows when factors are updated in the sustainability domain.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Verification status of the emission factor indicating whether it has been independently validated. \'third_party_verified\' factors are required for GFSI, SQF, BRC, and voluntary carbon market submissions.   version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this emission factor record following semantic versioning (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\', \'3.0.1\').   Note: 'Reference catalog of GHG emission factors used in agricultural emission calculations.   buffer_pool_contribution_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Percentage of gross VCUs withheld and contributed to the registry\'s buffer pool (risk buffer) to account for reversal risk. Reduces net VCUs available for sale. Required by Verra VCS and other registries.']
  bulk_density_g_per_cm3 decimal(8,4) [note: 'Soil bulk density measured in grams per cubic centimetre (g/cm³) at the time of sampling. Required for converting SOC concentration (%) to SOC stock (t C/ha) and for equivalent soil mass corrections.']
  carbon_credit_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the SOC change recorded in this measurement event qualifies for carbon credit issuance under the applicable registry protocol. True when SOC change exceeds the minimum threshold and all additionality criteria are met.']
  co2_equivalent_t decimal(14,4) [note: 'SOC change expressed in tonnes of CO2 equivalent (t CO2e), converting carbon mass to CO2e using the molecular weight ratio (1 t C = 3.667 t CO2e). Standard unit for GHG reporting and carbon market transactions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this soil carbon sequestration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.']
  esg_reporting_period varchar [note: 'Fiscal or calendar year reporting period (e.g., \'2024\', \'FY2024\') to which this measurement contributes for ESG disclosure purposes. Aligns soil carbon data with corporate sustainability reporting cycles.']
  laboratory_name varchar [note: 'Name of the accredited analytical laboratory that performed SOC concentration analysis on the collected soil samples. Laboratory accreditation is required for registry-compliant measurements.']
  laboratory_report_number varchar [note: 'Unique report or certificate of analysis (COA) number issued by the analytical laboratory for the soil sample batch associated with this measurement event. Provides traceability to raw analytical data.']
  land_use_type varchar [note: 'Current land use classification for the measured area at the time of measurement. Land use type is a primary driver of SOC dynamics and is required for IPCC Tier 2/3 accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cropland|pasture|agroforestry|cover_crop|fallow|wetland|rangeland|orchard — promote to reference product]']
  measurement_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the soil sample was collected or the model run was executed to estimate soil organic carbon stock. Principal real-world event date for this record.']
  measurement_method varchar [note: 'Technique used to quantify soil organic carbon stock. Direct sampling involves physical soil core collection and laboratory analysis; DNDC, RothC, and CENTURY are biogeochemical simulation models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_sampling|DNDC_model|RothC_model|CENTURY_model|remote_sensing|hybrid|IPCC_tier1|IPCC_tier2 — promote to reference product]']
  measurement_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this soil carbon measurement event, used for cross-referencing with laboratory reports, registry submissions, and audit documentation.']
  measurement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the soil carbon measurement record, tracking progression from initial data capture through third-party verification and registry submission.']
  monitoring_period_end date [note: 'End date of the monitoring period covered by this measurement record. Together with monitoring_period_start, defines the interval over which SOC change is quantified.']
  monitoring_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the monitoring period covered by this measurement record. Defines the temporal boundary for SOC change calculation relative to the baseline.']
  net_vcu_quantity decimal(14,4) [note: 'Net VCUs available for issuance and sale after deducting buffer pool contributions and uncertainty deductions from gross VCUs. Represents the monetizable carbon credit volume from this measurement event.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for agronomist or data steward annotations regarding anomalies, field conditions, deviations from standard protocol, or other contextual information relevant to interpreting this measurement record.']
  organic_amendment_applied boolean [note: 'Indicates whether organic amendments (compost, manure, biochar, or other organic inputs) were applied to the field during the monitoring period. Organic amendments are a key driver of SOC stock increases.']
  registry_name varchar [note: 'Name of the carbon credit registry under which this measurement is submitted for verification and VCU issuance (e.g., Verra VCS, Gold Standard, Climate Action Reserve Soil Enrichment Protocol). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Verra_VCS|Gold_Standard|CAR|ACR|BioCarbon_Fund|ISCC|Plan_Vivo — promote to reference product]']
  registry_submission_reference varchar [note: 'Unique reference number or project ID assigned by the carbon registry upon submission of this measurement for verification. Used for audit trail and tracking VCU issuance status in the registry system.']
  sample_count varchar [note: 'Number of individual soil core samples collected within the field or management zone for this measurement event. Higher sample counts reduce measurement uncertainty and support statistical validity of SOC estimates.']
  sampling_depth_cm decimal(6,2) [note: 'Depth of soil core or profile sampled for SOC analysis, expressed in centimetres. Standard depths are typically 0–30 cm or 0–100 cm per protocol requirements. Critical for comparability across measurement events.']
  soc_change_t_per_ha decimal(12,4) [note: 'Net change in SOC stock relative to the established baseline measurement, expressed in tonnes of carbon per hectare (t C/ha). Positive values indicate sequestration; negative values indicate carbon loss.']
  soc_concentration_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Measured SOC concentration expressed as a percentage of dry soil mass, as determined by laboratory analysis (e.g., Walkley-Black, dry combustion). Input to SOC stock calculation.']
  soc_stock_t_per_ha decimal(12,4) [note: 'Measured or modelled soil organic carbon stock expressed in tonnes of carbon per hectare (t C/ha) at the time of measurement. This is the principal quantitative fact for this record and the basis for carbon credit calculations.']
  soil_type varchar [note: 'USDA or FAO soil classification type for the sampled location (e.g., Mollisol, Vertisol, Alfisol). Influences SOC sequestration potential and model parameterisation.']
  total_soc_stock_t decimal(14,4) [note: 'Total SOC stock for the measured area, expressed in tonnes of carbon (t C). Calculated as soc_stock_t_per_ha multiplied by area_ha. Represents the absolute carbon pool for the management unit.']
  uncertainty_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Statistical uncertainty of the SOC stock or change estimate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95% confidence interval half-width as % of mean). Required by carbon registries for conservative crediting and buffer pool contributions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this soil carbon sequestration record. Tracks data revisions through the verification lifecycle and supports Silver Layer change detection in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  vcu_quantity decimal(14,4) [note: 'Number of Verified Carbon Units (VCUs) generated or estimated from this measurement event. One VCU represents one tonne of CO2-equivalent reduced or removed from the atmosphere. Used for carbon credit monetization.']
  verification_body varchar [note: 'Name of the accredited third-party validation and verification body (VVB) that independently verified this measurement event and approved VCU issuance. Required for registry submission.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the third-party verification body completed and approved the verification of this soil carbon measurement. Marks the transition to verified status for VCU issuance.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration measurements and estimates at the field or management zone level. Captures measurement date, field identifier, management zone, SOC stock (tonnes C/ha), SOC change from baseline, measurement method (direct sampling, modelling via DNDC/RothC/CENTURY), sampling depth, bulk density, carbon credit eligibility flag, verified carbon units (VCUs) generated, and registry submission reference (Verra VCS, Gold Standard, CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol). Core to carbon credit monetization.'
}

Informs USDA NRCS conservation practice planning.']
  regulatory_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the assessment findings were formally submitted to the relevant regulatory authority. Populated only when regulatory_submission_required is True. Supports compliance audit trail.']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this assessment must be submitted to a regulatory authority (e.g., EPA, APHIS, US Army Corps of Engineers) due to findings such as wetland presence, threatened species, or invasive species detection.']
  soil_biodiversity_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite score representing the diversity and abundance of soil organisms (bacteria, fungi, earthworms, nematodes) in the assessed area. Supports soil health monitoring and carbon sequestration assessments aligned with USDA NRCS soil health frameworks.']
  species_richness_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct species identified during the assessment survey. A primary biodiversity metric used in TNFD disclosures and biodiversity net gain calculations.']
  threatened_species_count varchar [note: 'Number of species identified during the assessment that are classified as threatened, endangered, or critically endangered per IUCN Red List criteria. Critical for TNFD nature-related risk disclosure.']
  threatened_species_names varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of common or scientific names of threatened or endangered species identified during the assessment. Supports conservation action planning and regulatory reporting to APHIS and EPA.']
  tnfd_disclosure_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this assessment record has been included in the enterprise\'s Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) annual report. Supports ESG reporting completeness tracking.']
  wetland_area_ha decimal(10,4) [note: 'Total area of wetlands identified within the assessed parcel, measured in hectares. Required for Clean Water Act Section 404 permit applications and USDA wetland conservation compliance.']
  wetland_present boolean [note: 'Indicates whether jurisdictional or non-jurisdictional wetlands were identified within or adjacent to the assessed parcel. Triggers Clean Water Act Section 404 compliance review and wetland delineation requirements.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of biodiversity surveys and ecological assessments conducted on farm land. Captures assessment date, field or parcel identifier, assessment type (habitat survey, species inventory, pollinator count, wetland delineation), methodology (USDA NRCS, IUCN, BirdLife), species richness count, threatened species identified, habitat quality score, pollinator index, assessment organization, and recommended conservation actions. Supports biodiversity net gain commitments and TNFD disclosure.'
}

  emission_factor_used decimal(18,8) [note: 'The emission conversion factor applied to calculate GHG metric values (e.g., kg CO2e per kWh of electricity consumed, or kg CO2e per liter of diesel). Null for non-GHG metrics. Required for audit trail and methodology transparency.']
  esg_pillar varchar [note: 'The primary ESG pillar this metric belongs to: Environmental (emissions, water, land, biodiversity), Social (labor, safety, community), or Governance (ethics, compliance, board oversight).']
  ghg_scope varchar [note: 'For greenhouse gas emission metrics, the GHG Protocol scope classification: Scope 1 (direct emissions from owned/controlled sources), Scope 2 (indirect emissions from purchased energy), Scope 3 (all other indirect value chain emissions). N/A for non-GHG metrics.']
  is_restatement boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents a restatement of a previously reported ESG metric value (True = restatement, False = original submission). Restatements occur due to methodology changes, data corrections, or boundary adjustments.']
  metric_category varchar [note: 'Sub-category within the ESG pillar classifying the metric topic (e.g., Greenhouse Gas Emissions, Water Stewardship, Soil Health, Biodiversity, Labor Practices, Food Safety, Supply Chain). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Greenhouse Gas Emissions|Water Stewardship|Soil Health|Biodiversity|Labor Practices|Food Safety|Supply Chain|Energy|Waste|Community — promote to reference product]']
  metric_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique business code identifying the specific ESG metric definition (e.g., GHG-SCOPE1-MT, WATER-WITHDRAWAL-M3, SOIL-CARBON-PCT). Used as the stable business identifier across reporting periods and frameworks.']
  metric_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the ESG performance metric (e.g., \'Scope 1 Greenhouse Gas Emissions\', \'Total Water Withdrawal\', \'Soil Organic Carbon Percentage\'). Used in ESG reports and dashboards.']
  metric_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this ESG metric record within the reporting workflow: Draft (data entry in progress), Submitted (submitted for review), Under Review (being verified), Approved (internally approved), Published (included in public ESG report), Restated (corrected restatement), Withdrawn (removed from reporting). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Draft|Submitted|Under Review|Approved|Published|Restated|Withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  metric_value decimal(28,6) [note: 'The quantitative measured or calculated value of the ESG metric for the reporting period and organizational scope (e.g., 12500.500000 metric tons CO2e for Scope 1 emissions, 85000.000000 cubic meters for water withdrawal). The principal quantitative fact of this record.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, caveats, or explanatory notes about this ESG metric record (e.g., \'Excludes leased equipment emissions\', \'Water data covers irrigated fields only\', \'Partial year due to farm acquisition in Q3\'). Supports narrative disclosure requirements.']
  org_scope_level varchar [note: 'The organizational boundary at which this metric is reported: Enterprise (consolidated), Region, Farm Unit (individual farm operation), Facility (processing/storage), or Field (individual crop field). Enables hierarchical ESG roll-up reporting.']
  org_scope_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the organizational unit for which this metric is reported (e.g., \'North America Operations\', \'Corn Belt Farm Unit 12\', \'Grain Processing Facility - Iowa\'). Supports reporting without requiring a join.']
  prior_period_value decimal(28,6) [note: 'The ESG metric value from the immediately preceding comparable reporting period, included for year-over-year or period-over-period comparison in ESG disclosures. Null if no prior period data exists or if this is the baseline year.']
  regulatory_program varchar [note: 'The mandatory regulatory program or rule requiring disclosure of this metric (e.g., \'EPA GHG Mandatory Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98\', \'FSMA Produce Safety Rule\', \'SEC Climate Disclosure Rule\', \'EU CSRD\'). Null if the metric is voluntary only.']
  reporting_framework varchar [note: 'The sustainability reporting framework or standard under which this metric is disclosed (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, IFRS S1/S2, CDP, GHG Protocol). Determines the disclosure methodology and calculation approach.']
  reporting_period_end date [note: 'The end date of the reporting period for which this ESG metric value is measured (e.g., 2024-12-31 for a calendar year). Together with reporting_period_start defines the measurement window.']
  reporting_period_start date [note: 'The start date of the reporting period for which this ESG metric value is measured (e.g., 2024-01-01 for a calendar year or crop season start). Aligns with fiscal or crop year boundaries.']
  reporting_period_type varchar [note: 'The temporal granularity of the reporting period (Annual, Semi-Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Crop Season, Custom). Determines aggregation and comparison logic in ESG dashboards.']
  restatement_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why a previously reported ESG metric value was restated (e.g., \'Methodology change to align with GHG Protocol Scope 3 Category 11\', \'Acquisition of new farm units\', \'Data correction from field sensor recalibration\'). Null if is_restatement is False.']
  submitted_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this ESG metric record was submitted for review or external disclosure. Captures the principal business event time for the reporting workflow lifecycle.']
  target_value decimal(28,6) [note: 'The committed or aspirational target value for this ESG metric for the reporting period, as set in the enterprise sustainability strategy or science-based targets (e.g., SBTi net-zero commitments). Used to measure performance against ESG goals.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which the metric value is expressed (e.g., MT CO2e for greenhouse gas emissions, m3 for water, hectares for land, percentage for soil organic carbon, kWh for energy). Aligns with framework-specified reporting units.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this ESG metric record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver layer, and audit compliance.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of individual ESG performance metric values reported for a specific period and organizational scope. Captures metric name, ESG pillar (Environmental/Social/Governance), reporting framework and disclosure code (e.g., GRI 305-1, SASB FB-AG-110a.1), reporting period, organizational scope (enterprise/farm unit/facility), metric value, unit of measure, data quality flag, restatement indicator, and prior period comparative value. Enables structured ESG data collection feeding into esg_report.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical_acute|physical_chronic|transition_policy|transition_technology|transition_market|transition_reputational — promote to reference product]']
  tcfd_pillar varchar [note: 'The TCFD disclosure pillar under which this risk assessment is primarily reported: Governance, Strategy, Risk Management, or Metrics and Targets. Enables structured mapping of risk records to TCFD report sections.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this climate risk assessment record was last modified. Supports audit trail, version control, and change management processes.']

  Note: 'Master record for physical and transition climate risk assessments conducted at the enterprise, farm unit, or asset level. Captures assessment date, risk horizon (short/medium/long-term), risk type (physical: acute/chronic; transition: policy/technology/market/reputational), climate scenario (IPCC RCP 2.6/4.5/8.5, IEA NZE), risk description, likelihood rating, financial impact estimate, affected assets or operations, adaptation measure planned, and TCFD disclosure alignment.   forest_cover_pct_before decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of the affected area classified as forest cover immediately prior to the land use change event, derived from satellite analysis. Used in EUDR deforestation determination and IPCC carbon stock baseline calculations.']
  gis_polygon_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or URI to the GIS polygon geometry defining the precise boundary of the land use change area in Esri ArcGIS or equivalent spatial data system. Supports EUDR plot-level geolocation requirements.']
  ipcc_tier varchar [note: 'Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) methodological tier applied to calculate the carbon stock change for this land use change event. Tier 1 uses default factors; Tier 2 uses country-specific factors; Tier 3 uses modelling or direct measurement.']
  latitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'WGS84 decimal degree latitude of the centroid or representative point of the land use change area, required for EUDR geolocation due diligence and GIS spatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS.']
  longitude decimal(10,7) [note: 'WGS84 decimal degree longitude of the centroid or representative point of the land use change area, required for EUDR geolocation due diligence and GIS spatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS.']
  new_land_use_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the land use category following the change event. Used in conjunction with previous_land_use_type to determine net carbon stock change and biodiversity impact under IPCC Tier 1/2/3 methodologies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: forest|grassland|wetland|cropland|pasture|shrubland|peatland — promote to reference product]']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional context, observations, or qualifications related to the land use change event, such as exceptional circumstances, data quality caveats, or pending regulatory actions.']
  previous_land_use_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the land use category prior to the change event. Critical for IPCC carbon stock change calculations and EUDR deforestation risk assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: forest|grassland|wetland|cropland|pasture|shrubland|peatland — promote to reference product]']
  protected_area_overlap boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the land use change area overlaps with a legally designated protected area (e.g., national park, wildlife refuge, Ramsar wetland, UNESCO biosphere reserve). True = overlap exists; False = no overlap. Critical for EUDR compliance and EPA regulatory review.']
  regulatory_permit_status varchar [note: 'Status of any required governmental or regulatory permit authorising the land use change, such as land conversion permits, wetland fill permits, or forestry clearance approvals from USDA, EPA, or equivalent national authority.']
  satellite_image_reference varchar [note: 'Unique reference identifier or URL for the satellite imagery record used to verify the land use change, enabling traceability back to the source image in Global Forest Watch, Planet Labs, or equivalent platform.']
  satellite_verification_date date [note: 'Date on which satellite imagery verification of the land use change was completed, establishing the temporal evidence chain for EUDR due diligence and GHG reporting.']
  satellite_verification_source varchar [note: 'Name of the satellite imagery or remote sensing platform used to verify the land use change event. Supports EUDR geolocation requirements and independent third-party verification of deforestation claims.']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of the corresponding record in the originating operational system (e.g., ArcGIS feature ID, Granular land event ID), enabling bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this land use change record originated, supporting data lineage and audit trail requirements. Primary sources include Esri ArcGIS for geospatial data, Granular Farm Management for land records, and John Deere Operations Center for field mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ArcGIS|John_Deere_Ops|Granular|FieldView|Trimble|manual|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  state_province_code varchar [note: 'Sub-national administrative code (state, province, or territory) where the land use change occurred, used for regional regulatory compliance, USDA FSA tract identification, and sub-national GHG inventory reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System-generated timestamp recording when this land use change record was most recently modified in the data platform, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements.']
  verification_body varchar [note: 'Name of the accredited third-party organisation that performed or is performing verification of the land use change GHG calculations and compliance documentation.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of independent third-party verification of the land use change carbon stock calculations and compliance claims, required for carbon credit issuance and ESG reporting credibility.']
  wetland_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the land use change involves conversion of or impact to wetland areas, triggering additional regulatory requirements under EPA Section 404 and USDA Wetland Conservation Provisions (Swampbuster). True = wetland impacted; False = no wetland impact.']
  change_date date [note: 'The principal real-world date on which the land use change event occurred or was initiated, used as the primary temporal anchor for GHG accounting and regulatory compliance reporting.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of land use change events that affect GHG emissions, carbon stocks, and biodiversity. Captures change date, parcel or field identifier, previous land use type (forest, grassland, wetland, cropland, pasture), new land use type, change area (hectares), driver of change (agricultural expansion, conservation set-aside, reforestation, rewilding), carbon stock change (tonnes CO2e), EUDR compliance flag, satellite verification reference (Global Forest Watch, Planet Labs), and regulatory permit status.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_safety|pesticide_application|water_quality|record_keeping|labeling|worker_safety|environmental|animal_welfare|organic_certification|traceability — promote to reference product]']
  finding_code varchar [note: 'Standardized regulatory or internal code identifying the specific type of deficiency or non-conformance observed. Sourced from the applicable regulatory agency\'s deficiency code library (e.g., FDA HACCP violation codes, USDA NOP codes, EPA inspection codes).']
  finding_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the deficiency, observation, or citation as documented by the inspector or auditor. Includes specific conditions observed, evidence collected, and context of the non-conformance.']
  finding_identified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time when this specific finding was formally identified and recorded during the inspection or audit process.']
  finding_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this finding, used in regulatory correspondence, corrective action plans, and audit reports. Follows the format AGENCY-YEAR-SEQUENCE (e.g., FDA-2024-00012).']
  finding_title varchar [note: 'Short, human-readable title summarizing the nature of the regulatory finding or deficiency (e.g., \'Inadequate Pesticide Application Records\', \'HACCP Critical Control Point Deviation\').']
  inspection_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the regulatory inspection, audit, or assessment was conducted and this finding was identified. Principal real-world event date for the finding.']
  inspection_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the inspection that generated this finding: \'routine\' (scheduled periodic inspection), \'for_cause\' (triggered by complaint or incident), \'follow_up\' (re-inspection to verify prior corrective actions), \'pre_certification\' (for certification renewal), \'third_party\' (conducted by GFSI-recognized body), or \'internal\' (self-assessment).']
  penalty_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Monetary penalty or fine assessed by the regulatory authority in connection with this finding, expressed in USD. Zero or null if no financial penalty was levied.']
  regulatory_citation varchar [note: 'Specific regulatory reference violated, expressed as the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) part and section, or equivalent standard clause (e.g., \'21 CFR 117.135(c)(2)\', \'40 CFR 152.500\', \'7 CFR 205.203\'). Enables precise legal traceability.']
  repeat_finding_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same facility or operation. Repeat findings trigger escalated regulatory scrutiny and are a key KPI for audit readiness programs.']
  resolution_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the corrective action was completed and the finding was resolved by the responsible party. Used to calculate days-to-close and assess timeliness of corrective action.']
  resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the finding through its corrective action lifecycle: \'open\' (finding issued, no action taken), \'in_progress\' (corrective action underway), \'resolved\' (corrective action completed by responsible party), \'verified\' (resolution confirmed by inspector or auditor), \'closed\' (formally closed in regulatory system), \'waived\' (formally waived by regulatory authority).']
  responsible_party_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the individual or organizational unit responsible for corrective action on this finding. Retained for audit trail and regulatory correspondence purposes.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Categorization of the root cause identified through corrective action root cause analysis (e.g., process failure, equipment malfunction, training gap, supplier non-conformance, documentation error, environmental factor). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: process_failure|equipment_malfunction|training_gap|supplier_nonconformance|documentation_error|environmental_factor|human_error|system_failure — promote to reference product]']
  severity_classification varchar [note: 'Risk-based severity level assigned to the finding: \'critical\' (immediate food safety or regulatory risk requiring urgent action), \'major\' (significant non-conformance with regulatory requirements), \'minor\' (low-risk deviation), or \'observation\' (noted for improvement, no formal violation). Aligns with GFSI and GLOBALG.A.P. severity frameworks.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this finding was originated or ingested (e.g., SAP S/4HANA QM module, Granular Farm Management, Oracle NetSuite, manual entry, GLOBALG.A.P. certification portal). Supports data lineage in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.']
  standard_program varchar [note: 'The specific food safety, environmental, or agricultural standard or certification program under which this finding was raised (e.g., HACCP, FSMA Preventive Controls, GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, BRC, NOP Organic, GAP, GMP, ISCC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HACCP|FSMA|GLOBALG.A.P.|SQF|BRC|NOP|GAP|GMP|ISCC|ISO_22000 — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this regulatory finding record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to finding details, corrective action status, or resolution information.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority, third-party auditor, or internal quality team verified and confirmed that the corrective action was effectively implemented and the finding is closed.']

  Note: 'Individual deficiency, observation, or citation identified during a regulatory inspection. Captures finding ID, parent inspection record reference, finding code, finding description, regulatory citation violated (CFR part/section), severity classification (critical, major, minor, observation), corrective action required, corrective action deadline, responsible party, resolution status, and resolution date. Enables granular tracking of each regulatory deficiency through to closure and supports repeat-finding trend analysis for audit readiness.'
}

  fda_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which this food safety plan or associated documentation was formally submitted to the FDA.']
  fda_submission_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the food safety plan\'s submission to the FDA. \'not_required\' applies to qualified facility exemptions; \'acknowledged\' indicates FDA receipt confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|pending|submitted|acknowledged|under_review|accepted|rejected — promote to reference product]']
  gfsi_certification_scheme varchar [note: 'Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI)-recognized certification scheme under which the facility is certified, if applicable.   last_reanalysis_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent formal reanalysis of this food safety plan was completed, as required by FSMA reanalysis provisions.']
  monitoring_procedure_summary varchar [note: 'Summary description of the monitoring procedures established for preventive controls in this plan, including what is monitored, how, frequency, and responsible personnel.']
  pcqi_credential varchar [note: 'Credential or training certification held by the PCQI, such as FSPCA Preventive Controls for Human Food training certificate number, demonstrating qualification to prepare the food safety plan.']
  pcqi_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) responsible for preparing or overseeing the preparation of this food safety plan, as required by FSMA.']
  physical_hazard_identified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the hazard analysis identified one or more physical hazards (e.g., metal fragments, glass, stones, bone) requiring preventive controls.']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the food safety plan, used in regulatory submissions, audit documentation, and cross-referencing with FDA records. Format: FSP-{FacilityCode}-{Year}.']
  plan_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the food safety plan. \'active\' indicates the plan is in force; \'superseded\' indicates a newer version has replaced it; \'withdrawn\' indicates the plan was retracted prior to activation.']
  plan_title varchar [note: 'Descriptive title of the food safety plan as it appears on the official plan document, typically including the facility name and scope (e.g., \'Grain Processing Facility — PCHF Food Safety Plan\').']
  plan_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the FSMA food safety plan by regulatory rule: Preventive Controls for Human Food (PCHF) per 21 CFR Part 117, Preventive Controls for Animal Food (PCAF) per 21 CFR Part 507, Produce Safety Rule (PSR) per 21 CFR Part 112, or COMBINED for facilities subject to multiple rules.']
  plan_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the food safety plan document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented upon each reanalysis or material revision as required by FSMA reanalysis provisions.']
  qualified_facility_exempt boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the covered facility qualifies for the Qualified Facility Exemption under FSMA, which modifies certain Preventive Controls requirements for very small businesses with limited food sales.']
  radiological_hazard_identified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the hazard analysis identified radiological hazards requiring preventive controls, as recognized under FSMA expanded hazard categories.']
  reanalysis_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled date by which the food safety plan must be reanalyzed per FSMA requirements (at minimum every 3 years, or sooner upon triggering events such as new hazard identification or process change).']
  record_retention_years varchar [note: 'Number of years that records associated with this food safety plan must be retained per FSMA requirements. Typically 2 years for most records; longer for certain process-related records.']
  sanitation_control_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether sanitation preventive controls are required under this food safety plan to address environmental pathogens or food contact surface contamination.']
  scope_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the food products, processes, and operations covered by this food safety plan, including commodity types, processing steps, and any exclusions.']
  supply_chain_control_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether supply chain preventive controls are required under this food safety plan for raw materials or ingredients with hazards controlled upstream by a supplier.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this food safety plan record, supporting audit trail requirements and change management tracking.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Current validation status of the process preventive controls in this food safety plan, confirming that the controls are capable of effectively controlling the identified hazards.']
  verification_activity_summary varchar [note: 'Summary of verification activities confirming that preventive controls are consistently implemented and effective, including calibration, product testing, environmental monitoring, and record review schedules.']

  Note: 'Master record for FSMA-mandated food safety plans including Preventive Controls for Human Food (PCHF), Preventive Controls for Animal Food (PCAF), and Produce Safety Rule (PSR) food safety plans. Serves as the regulatory SSOT for FSMA food safety plan management.'
}
