  customs_broker_license varchar [note: 'CBP-issued license number of the customs broker responsible for this trade compliance filing. Required for regulatory accountability and audit trail.']
  customs_broker_name varchar [note: 'Name of the licensed customs broker or freight forwarder engaged to manage the customs clearance and regulatory compliance filing for this shipment.']
  declared_value_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Declared customs value of the shipment in US dollars, as reported on the customs entry for duty assessment purposes. Used for tariff calculation and trade statistics reporting.']
  destination_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the agricultural commodity is being exported or imported.']
  duty_rate_pct decimal(8,4) [note: 'Applicable customs duty rate expressed as a percentage of the declared customs value, as determined by the HS code, trade agreement, and country of origin. Used for duty cost calculation and trade agreement benefit tracking.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory certificate or permit expires and is no longer valid for customs clearance or border inspection. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.']
  fda_prior_notice_number varchar [note: 'FDA-assigned confirmation number for the Prior Notice filing submitted before importation of food or feed products, as required under FSMA and 21 CFR Part 1. Null for non-food/feed shipments or exports.']
  hold_reason varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the reason for any customs or border inspection hold placed on the shipment. Captures the specific regulatory violation, documentation deficiency, or pest/disease finding that triggered the hold.']
  hold_release_date date [note: 'Date on which a customs or border inspection hold was officially released and the shipment was cleared for entry or export. Null if no hold was placed or if the hold has not yet been resolved.']
  hold_type varchar [note: 'Type of hold or detention placed on the shipment by a customs or border inspection authority. \'none\' indicates no hold. Used to track compliance issues and resolution timelines.']
  is_gmo boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commodity contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMOs). Relevant for import/export compliance in jurisdictions with GMO labeling or restriction requirements.']
  is_organic_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commodity covered by this trade compliance record is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) or an equivalent foreign organic certification recognized by USDA.']
  issue_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory certificate or permit was officially issued by the issuing authority. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.']
  issuing_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country whose authority issued the certificate or permit.']
  mrl_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commodity has been verified to comply with the Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs) for pesticide residues as established by the destination country\'s regulatory authority (e.g., EPA, Codex Alimentarius, EU MRL regulations).']
  net_weight_kg decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net weight of the commodity covered by this trade compliance record, expressed in kilograms. Used for customs valuation, duty calculation, and regulatory reporting.']
  origin_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the agricultural commodity was grown, produced, or substantially transformed. Required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance.']
  phytosanitary_cert_number varchar [note: 'Official phytosanitary certificate number issued by the national plant protection organization (NPPO) of the exporting country, certifying that plants and plant products meet the phytosanitary requirements of the importing country.']
  port_of_entry_code varchar [note: 'Official CBP or IATA port code identifying the port of entry or exit through which the shipment crosses the border (e.g., \'LAX\', \'2704\' for CBP port codes).']
  record_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this trade compliance record, used in correspondence with regulatory authorities, brokers, and trading partners. Format: TCR-{COUNTRY_CODE}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.']
  shipment_date date [note: 'Principal real-world date on which the agricultural commodity was shipped or departed from the origin point. Serves as the primary business event date for this compliance record.']
  trade_agreement_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the applicable free trade agreement or preferential trade arrangement governing this shipment (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, CAFTA-DR). Determines preferential duty rates and certificate-of-origin requirements.']
  trade_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the shipment is an import into the domestic market, an export to a foreign market, a re-export of previously imported goods, or a transit movement through a country.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this trade compliance record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit readiness, and Silver layer incremental processing.']

  Note: 'Transactional record managing cross-border agricultural trade compliance for import and export shipments — covering phytosanitary certificates, USDA APHIS export certificates, FDA Prior Notice filings, CITES permits for regulated species, country-of-origin documentation, and import/export license compliance. Captures record ID, shipment reference, trade direction (import/export), destination/origin country, commodity, applicable trade agreement (USMCA, CPTPP), certificate type, issuing authority, certificate number, issue date, expiration date, compliance status, and any holds or detentions by customs or border inspection. Complements supply.customs_declaration with the regulatory compliance dimension.'
}

  response_due_date date [note: 'Internal deadline by which the enterprise must complete its response actions (e.g., SOP updates, training, system changes). May be set earlier than the regulatory compliance_deadline to allow buffer time for implementation and verification.']

Values: quarantined (physically isolated), returned (sent back to supplier/manufacturer), destroyed (disposed of), reconditioned (reworked to meet standards), cleared (confirmed safe and released), pending_review (awaiting disposition decision).']
  distribution_channel varchar [note: 'The distribution channel through which this recalled lot was sold or transferred. Determines the notification strategy and regulatory reporting requirements for the recall action.']
  effectiveness_check_date date [note: 'Date on which the FDA or FSIS effectiveness check was completed for this recalled lot. Populated when effectiveness_check_status is \'completed\' or \'failed\'.']
  effectiveness_check_status varchar [note: 'Status of the FDA or FSIS effectiveness check for this specific recalled lot. Tracks whether the regulatory agency has verified that the recall notification reached the consignee and that the product has been appropriately handled.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The best-by, use-by, or expiration date printed on the recalled lot packaging. Used to assess consumer risk and prioritize notification urgency for perishable agricultural products.']
  grn_number varchar [note: 'Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number from SAP S/4HANA MM documenting the receipt of this lot into inventory. Provides the inbound traceability anchor for recalled lots sourced from external suppliers.']
  hazard_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the food safety hazard associated with this recalled lot. Aligns with HACCP hazard categories: biological (pathogens), chemical (pesticide residues, MRL exceedances), physical (foreign material), allergen (undeclared allergens), radiological, or undeclared ingredient.']
  lot_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional observations, special handling instructions, or regulatory notes specific to this recalled lot. May include reconditioning instructions, destruction method details, or consignee-specific circumstances.']
  lot_recovery_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the physical recovery or disposition of this recalled lot has been confirmed and verified. True when recovery is complete and documented; False when recovery is still in progress or unconfirmed. Used in FDA/FSIS effectiveness check reporting.']
  mrl_exceedance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the recall for this lot was triggered by a Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) exceedance for pesticide active ingredients (AI). True when MRL exceedance is confirmed; False otherwise. Relevant for EPA and FDA pesticide residue compliance.']
  organic_certified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this recalled lot was certified under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) at time of production or sale. Relevant for determining applicable organic certification implications and NOP reporting requirements during the recall.']
  po_number varchar [note: 'Purchase Order (PO) number under which this lot was procured or sold. Links the recalled lot to procurement or sales transaction records in SAP S/4HANA MM/SD for financial impact assessment.']
  production_date date [note: 'The date on which the recalled lot was manufactured, processed, or packed. Critical for determining the scope of the recall and identifying other potentially affected lots from the same production run.']
  quantity_affected decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total quantity of product in this lot that is subject to the recall. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in quantity_uom. Used for FDA/FSIS effectiveness check reporting and recovery tracking.']
  quantity_recovered decimal(18,4) [note: 'Actual quantity of the recalled lot that has been physically recovered, returned, or accounted for through disposition activities. Used to calculate recovery rate for FDA/FSIS effectiveness check reporting.']
  quantity_uom varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity affected field. Common agricultural units include pounds (LB), kilograms (KG), metric tons (MT), hundredweight (CWT), bushels (BU), cases (CS), each (EA), gallons (GAL), or ounces (OZ). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LB|KG|MT|CWT|BU|CS|EA|GAL|OZ — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  quarantine_date date [note: 'Date on which this lot was physically quarantined or placed on hold following identification as part of the recall scope. Establishes the start of the lot-level recall action timeline.']
  recovery_confirmation_date date [note: 'Date on which lot recovery was confirmed and verified by the responsible compliance officer or regulatory authority. Populated when lot_recovery_confirmed is True.']
  ship_date date [note: 'Date on which this lot was shipped or transferred to the consignee or distribution point. Used to establish the distribution timeline and scope of the recall for FDA/FSIS traceability reporting.']
  storage_location_code varchar [note: 'Warehouse or storage location code (bin, aisle, zone, or cold storage unit) where the recalled lot is physically held. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS or SAP MM storage location master. Enables rapid physical quarantine.']
  upc_code varchar [note: 'Universal Product Code (UPC) or Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) associated with the recalled lot, used for consumer-facing identification and retail notification during the recall.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this recall lot record. Tracks changes to disposition status, recovery confirmation, notification status, and effectiveness check results throughout the recall lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  Note: 'Association record linking specific commodity lots, product lots, or inventory positions to an active recall event. Captures recall lot ID, recall event reference, lot number, commodity or product reference, quantity affected, storage location, current disposition status (quarantined, returned, destroyed, reconditioned, cleared), customer notification status, and lot recovery confirmation. Enables granular lot-level traceability management during a recall and supports FDA/FSIS effectiveness check reporting.'
}

  reminder_lead_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days before the due date that automated reminders and notifications should be triggered. Enables proactive deadline management and workload planning. Sourced from compliance obligation default or overridden at entry level.']
  submission_method varchar [note: 'Method by which the compliance filing, renewal, or report was or will be submitted to the regulatory authority. Values: online_portal, email, mail, in_person, fax, edi (Electronic Data Interchange). Supports submission workflow planning.']

  last_amendment_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent amendment submitted to the FDA for this facility registration. Amendments must be submitted within 60 days of any change in required registration information.']

  qualified_facility_exempt boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this facility qualifies for the very small business (qualified facility) exemption under FSMA, which modifies certain registration and food safety plan requirements. Based on average annual monetary value of food sold.']
  registration_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the FDA facility registration. \'active\' indicates a valid, current registration; \'suspended\' indicates FDA has suspended the registration (facility cannot import/export food); \'cancelled\' indicates voluntary or involuntary cancellation; \'pending\' indicates initial submission awaiting FDA confirmation; \'expired\' indicates the biennial renewal window has lapsed without renewal.']
  registration_submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the initial FDA facility registration was submitted via the FDA Industry Systems (FIS) portal. Used to track the registration timeline and confirm compliance with pre-operation registration requirements.']
  renewal_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the biennial renewal process for this FDA facility registration. \'not_due\' indicates the renewal window has not yet opened; \'submitted\' indicates the renewal has been filed with FDA; \'confirmed\' indicates FDA has confirmed the renewed registration; \'overdue\' indicates the renewal deadline has passed without confirmation; \'waived\' indicates a regulatory exemption applies.']
  renewal_submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the biennial renewal application was submitted to the FDA. Used to confirm timely filing within the October 1 – December 31 renewal window of even-numbered years.']
  source_system_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier from the originating operational system of record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA QM module compliance record ID, or Granular Farm Management compliance tracking ID) from which this registration record was sourced or synchronized.']
  suspension_date date [note: 'The date on which the FDA suspended this facility registration. A suspended registration prohibits the facility from importing food into the US and triggers immediate operational and supply chain impacts. Null if registration has never been suspended.']
  suspension_lifted_date date [note: 'The date on which the FDA lifted the suspension of this facility registration, restoring the facility\'s authorization to operate. Null if the registration has never been suspended or if suspension is still active.']
  suspension_reason varchar [note: 'Description of the reason provided by the FDA for suspending the facility registration. Typically references a credible threat of serious adverse health consequences or death to humans or animals. Null if registration has never been suspended.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this bioterrorism registration record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect stale records, trigger renewal reminders, and support audit trail requirements.']
  us_agent_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the designated US Agent for a foreign food facility. Used for FDA communications and emergency notifications. Required only for foreign facilities.']
  us_agent_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the US Agent designated by a foreign food facility as required under the FDA Bioterrorism Act. The US Agent serves as the FDA\'s primary point of contact for the foreign facility. Required only for foreign facilities (is_foreign_facility = true).']
  us_agent_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number of the designated US Agent for a foreign food facility. The US Agent must be reachable by the FDA at all times during business hours. Required only for foreign facilities.']

  Note: 'Master record for FDA Bioterrorism Act facility registrations required for food facilities that manufacture, process, pack, or hold food for human or animal consumption in the United States. Captures registration ID, FDA registration number, facility name, facility type, food categories handled, registration effective date, biennial renewal date, renewal status, emergency contact information, US agent information (for foreign facilities), and registration suspension status. Manages the full lifecycle of FDA facility registration compliance including biennial renewal tracking.'
}

Table compliance.outfall {

  regulatory_agency_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_agency. Business justification: Outfalls are regulated by specific agencies (EPA, state environmental departments). Currently tracked as string field \'regulatory_authority\' which should be normalized to FK. Adding regulatory_agency_']
  activation_date date [note: 'Date when the outfall became operational and began discharging under permit authorization.']
  average_flow_rate_gpm decimal(12,2) [note: 'Typical or average flow rate through the outfall under normal operating conditions, measured in gallons per minute.']

  elevation_meters decimal(8,2) [note: 'Elevation of the outfall discharge point above sea level, measured in meters.']

  monitoring_parameters varchar [note: 'List of water quality parameters that must be monitored at this outfall (e.g., pH, BOD, TSS, nitrogen, phosphorus, pesticides).']

  pipe_diameter_inches decimal(6,2) [note: 'Internal diameter of the outfall discharge pipe or conduit, measured in inches.']
  pipe_material varchar [note: 'Material composition of the outfall discharge pipe (concrete, PVC, steel, HDPE, cast iron, or other).']
  receiving_water_body varchar [note: 'Name of the water body (river, stream, lake, ocean, groundwater) that receives the discharge from this outfall.']
  receiving_water_classification varchar [note: 'Regulatory classification or designated use of the receiving water body (e.g., Class A, Class B, fishable/swimmable).']
  total_maximum_daily_load_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this outfall is subject to a Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) allocation for the receiving water body.']
  treatment_system_type varchar [note: 'Type of wastewater treatment system upstream of this outfall (e.g., primary, secondary, tertiary, lagoon, constructed wetland).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this outfall record was last modified in the system.']
  violation_count varchar [note: 'Total number of permit violations or exceedances recorded for this outfall during the current reporting period.']
  watershed_code varchar [note: 'Hydrologic unit code (HUC) identifying the watershed in which this outfall is located.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for outfall. Referenced by outfall_id.'
}
